tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sgrol dkar jo bo lugs kyi mngon rtogs tshe sgrub dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /sgrol dkar jo bo lugs kyi mngon rtogs tshe sgrub dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ¿༄༅/ /sgrol dkar jo bo lugs kyi mngon rtogs tshe sgrub dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

dge legs 'dod pa'i 'bras stsol ma/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal sbyin ma// srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun sel ma/ /'phags ma sgrol mas shis par mdzod/ / 'dir thog mar skyabs sems spyi dang mthun/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs/ nyid jo bo'i gsung yin nges kyi yid ches chog shel 'tshal/ de nas swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las bsrung 'khor/ paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ rang sems ut+pal dkar po tāṃḥgis mtshan pa las/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pal dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mu tig dkar po gtso bor gyur pa'i dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad 'dab ltar rab tu yangs pa'i spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su tāṃḥye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ ྄baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ spro na skabs 'dir mchod bstod bya/ snying gar 'khor lo gsal btab la thun gyi thog mtha' gnyis su/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye dzñā na puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci rigs dang*/ bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi yi ge bcu pa nyid la byed/ de bzlas pa'i sgo nas tshe bsring pa'o/ / snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dkar po phyogs thams cad du 'phros/ rang gi phyi rol 'doms gang tsam du gur khyim dkar por gyur pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar bsam/ de bzhin du ser pos tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam/ dmar pos thams cad dbang du bsdus par bsam/ /sngon pos dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ ljang khus las thams cad 'phral du 'grub/

mchin khas las 'grub pa la bar chad bsal/ 'od zer 'khor lo de rnams so so'i bar la 'doms gang tsam re yod pa/ bar mtshams thams cad ut+pal gsar du kha bye bas gang bar bsam la/ bzlas pa ci rigs bya/ mthar 'od zer 'khor lo phyi ma phyi ma nang ma la thim pa mthar snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la bsdu/ bsrung 'khor gyi tshe bsring pa'o// snying ga'i 'khor lo'am sa bon las 'od 'phros/ 'byung bzhi'i bcud thams cad bdud rtsir bsdus/ rang nyid la thim pas lus kyi zungs dang sems kyi rten du gyur pas sra brtan rdo rje'i tshe thob par mos shing*/ bzlas brjod ci rigs bya/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang*/ bsod nams gnod pa med par blangs nas snga ma ltar bya ste/ bcud bsdu bas tshe bsring pa'o/ / snying gar zla ba la tāṃḥlas dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'od zer spro/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe bsdu/ gnas pa'i tshe tāṃḥl sems gtad pa'i lan brgya phrag tsam sgom pa ni rdo rje'i bzlas pas tshe bsring pa'o/ /rang lus kyi dbus su srog rtsa shel gyi ka ba btsugs pa lta bu yas sna thig le dkar po dang*/ mas sna thig le dmar pos bkag pa/ nang snying ga'i tāṃḥlas byung ba'i srog gi rlung sngo dmar gyis 'gro 'ong med par gang ba la sems gtad de/ rlung bum can ci rigs su 'dzin pa ni snying gar tshe phur gdab pa la brten nas tshe bsring pa'o/ /phyi ma bzhi po de gang yang rung bar byas pas chog /snying gar 'khor lo sgom tshul ni zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mtha' mar mu khyud dang bcas pa/ lte ba'i dbus su hā tāṃḥ.oṃ gsum yas rim gyis brtsegs pas/ de'i mtha' la ma ma ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod cig /rtsibs brgyad la tā re tut+tā re tu re swā zhes pa'i yi ge brgyad po thams cad kha nang bltas mgo gyen bstan/ 'od zer dkar po 'bar ba sgom pa yin/

/tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'o/ / zhus dag/maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /gsang ba spyi'i cho ga zhi ba las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'bring po bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru/ 'dir gsang ba spyi'i cho ga las brtsams te/ zhi ba las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di ltar bya'o/ / bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo hūṃ mdzad rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūṃ/ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa hūṃ/ grih+ṇa pā ya grih+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun tsam bzlas/ rang rang gi lugs ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa lan mang du bzla/ de rjes sa gzhi der/ brkos thab byed na/ stegs bu mtho gang gi dpangs dang ldan pa byas la/ sgom don dang mthun par rtsig pa dang sa brko dgos shing*/ bris thab tu byed na/ tshang thig zur thig btab/ dbus su thig skud mtho gang gis zlum por bskor/ de nas sor bzhi pa gnyis rim can du bskor te/ thab dang mu ran dang kha khyer rnams so/ /lte ba nas mu ran gyi mthar gzung ba nyis gyur zur thig gi steng du bya rjes byas pa'i steng nas/ phyogs bzhir gru bzhir btab/ de la slar yang sor gnyis bsnan/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang*/ mu ran la ze'u 'bru/ kha khyer la pad+ma 'dab brgyad rnams 'bri/ de dag gi bar rnams dkar po 'gengs/ /stegs bu ser po zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dkar po/ de dag gi bcad mdzes tshon/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar rdo rje sor brgyad pa/ lha gtso bo gang yin gyi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i kha tog can 'bri/ 'dab ma brgyad la mtshan ma ma bkod kyang chog /yang na rigs dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan dbus su bris kyang rung ba yin no/ /de nas zlum thig nang ma'i nang nas/ dri zhim po'i bud shing gis zlum por brtsigs/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su bsreg rdzas rnams rim can du sgrigs/

de rnams kyi bar gyi cha nas/ ci rigs pa re blangs nas snod gcig tu bsres/ g.yon gyi cha la/ mchod yon kyi snod che chung gnyis dang*/ bsang gtor gyi snod cig bshams/ de'i 'phro mthud nas nyer spyod sogs mchod pa rnams phyi nang rim pa gnyis kyang bshams/ rang dang thab kyi bar du me yol brtsig /me yol dang rang gi bar du dril bu dang*/ de'i mdun du rdo rje gzhag /rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blug kyang bzhag/ mar khu dang yam shing yang g.yas phyogs su 'jog ste/ ji ltar bde bar yang bya'o/ /de nas yi dam gang yin gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms pa yin na rang la bsdu'o/ / ku sha nas bzung*/ bsang chu la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+da li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod dgos pa'i rigs yin zhing*/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs grub na des chog ma grub na skabs 'dir rang rang gi lugs kyi nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ de nas a mṛ ta bzla shing*/ bsang chus gnas khang dang yo byad kun la gtor/ nang mchod dgos pa'i rigs yin na des kyang gtor la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan mang du brjod/ de nas rang rang gi lugs bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ sreg rdzas rnams la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya gtad nas oṃ swāhā/ lan gsum gyis/ ma dag pa bkrus par bsam/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ gsum gyis yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrī swāhā/ gsum gyis zhun mar dang*/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhā/ gsum gyis 'bru thams cad dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ gsum gyis rdzas gzhan rnams byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis me blangs/ sgron me sbar/ a mṛ ta sa de la bsang chus gtor/ a mṛ ta bzla bzhin tu thab la g.yas bskor bya/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ/ zhes me sgron thab nang du gzhug hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod cing*/ rlung g.yab kyis me sbar ro/

/thab khung a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la hūṃ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po khru gang ba/ mu ran dang kha khyer gyis bskor zhing*/ stegs bu'i grwa la zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa pad+ma rgyas pa'i dbyibs can/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ de'i nang du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor raṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zhi ba'i me lha dkar po/ phyag g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rang 'od kyi rig ma dang gnyis su med pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ me lce dkar po'i 'phreng ba dkrigs shing*/ ra skyes dkar po'i steng na rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te byon par gyur/ skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya las mthe bong rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dza/ zhes spyan drangs/ bsang chu gtor zhing a mṛ ta sa bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ku sha'i chun pos bsang gtor byed pa dang lhan cig tu/ mchod yon kyi snod chung ba nas bzed zhal du blug ste/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+ka rā r+thaṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis nyer spyod phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ / ces pas bstod/ oṃ badz+ra a na la mahā bhū ta dz+wa la dz+wa la sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṣ+tan hūṃ phaṭa/

dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ zhes lan gsum gyis dam la bzhag /de nas/ me lha'i thugs kar hūṃ/ ljags la rdo rje rtse gcig pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dgang blugs kyi kha la yang hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ akan ye/ ā dī bya ā dī bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha mahā shri ye ha bya ka bya wā hā nā ya/ bdag gi sdig sgrib bar chad nad gdon bkra mi shis pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis dgang blugs 'bul/ de bzhin du sngags de nyid kyis/ yam shing lan gsum phul/ slar yang sngags de nyid lan ji ltar 'os pas/ sreg rdzas thams cad bsreg pa de nas ci rigs par 'bul lo/ / oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar blugs gzar gang thab du phul 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ / slar yang bsangs sbyangs/ me lha'i thugs kar rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su zhes/ mtshams sbyar nas/ lhag gang la mchod pa 'bul rgyu'i lhag pa'i lha de nyid kyi mdun bskyed mchod pa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du bskyed nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab la sogs pa yang rang rang gi lugs bzhin du bya/ rig bdag rang chas su bsgoms nas/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab mi dgos so/ /mchod yon gyi snod gnyis pa nas/ ku shas bsang gtor 'bul bzhin du/ gzed zhal du blug la/ lha so so'i snying po'i mthar gong gi mchod yon gyi sngags/ sbyar bas mchod yon 'bul/ me tog nas rol mo'i bar gong bzhin du 'bul ba dang*/ bstod pa yang so so'i bstod pa sho lo ka re re tsam re byed pa'am/ so so'i cho ga las byung ba'i mchod 'phreng rgyas pa yod na/ de ltar mchod bstod phul na yang legs pa yin no/ / de nas sreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ thog mar lhag pa'i lha'i sngags rnams kyi mthar rdzas so so'i sngags sbyar la/ mjug tu las sngags sbyor ba yin te/ dper mtshon na/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rig sngags la bsreg rdzas lan bdun 'bul na/

oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa lan gcig oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun/ bdag gi sdig sgrib bar chad nad gdon bkra mi shis pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa lan gcig spel ba lta bu'o/ /de la/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pa ni mar khu'i sngags so/ / oṃ bho dhi prik+ṣa ya swāhā/ yam shing gi sngags so/ / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ til dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+tā ye swāhā/ 'bras ma grugs pa dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zho zan dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swāhā/ ku sha dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ 'bras so ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra mahā be ga ye swāhā/ nas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra mahā ba la ya swāhā/ sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swāhā/ gro dang*/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dha ye swāhā/ yungs dkar gyis sngags so/ /gzhan yang mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pas mchod par bya ste/ snying po'i sngags kyis 'bul bar bya'o/ /de la mar dang yam shing ni med du mi rung ba yin zhing*/ rdzas gzhan de dag ji tsam rnyed pa de tsam 'bul ba yin kyang*/ las thams cad pa la lta ci smos/ zhi ba rkyang pa la yang rdzas de dag 'dzom na legs shing*/ rab gnas dang*/ rang gzhan gyi zhi ba'i las spyi 'gro tsam sgrub pa la/ sreg rdzas so so re nas brgya phrag re re tsam dang*/ rdzas sngags kyang de tsam 'bul ba yin la/ tshe'i bar chad kho na zhi bar byed pa sogs/ zhi ba'i las nyi tshe ba la/ so so'i rdzas dang sngags sna re re de kho na byed pa sogs yod kyang*/ dngos grub kyi don dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong la thog mar mar khu/ yam shing mang tsam dang*/ lhag ma sreg rdzas so so la grangs mnyam pa mang nyung gang 'os re phul ba'i rjes su/ snying po'i sngags kho nas sreg par byed pa nyid la ji tsam dgos pa'i grangs 'dzin pa nyid bzang ba yin no/ / sreg rdzas rdzogs pa'i mthar/

so so'i mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba'i gtor 'bul mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams byas la/ yig brgya lan gsum bzlas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyed de ring bzod mdzad rigs/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /bdag la dngos grub mchog stsol lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsol/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa'ang stsol/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas gshegs badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba'am/ gnyis kar yang rang gi snying gar bsdu ba skabs su gang bab sbyor te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /de nas/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar blugs gzar gang phul/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyi mchod pa gong bzhin phul/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog

/'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghan dhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes pas bstod/ me lha'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī bya/ nas/ wā hā nā ya/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs sbyar ba lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ yang ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyon gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'phrin las bcol/ gong bzhin mchod yon phul/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ / sogs bzod par gsol/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su tshur byon zhing*/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i me'i ngang du thim par gyur/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya/ me rang bzhin gyis zhi bar ma gyur kyi bar du/ dkrug par mi bya la/ glo bur du las rjes bsdu dgos pa byung na/ 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chu la/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ta sid+dhi lo tsa ni/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas/

me la blug /rgyas pa la sogs pa gzhan rnams la yang cho ga 'dis rigs 'gre la/ lha nyung ngu'i dkyil 'khor dang cho ga bsdus pa'i rigs dang*/ sgrub thabs phra mo sogs la/ de dang 'brel bar mdor bsdus 'di tsam kho na legs shing gzhan gong ltar las/ dngos gzhi'i skabs rdzas sngags so so byed pa bor ba ni/ shin tu bsdus pa'i rigs su gtogs so/ /gsang ba spyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa la mngon par dga' na/ logs su 'bri bar yang 'gyur ro/ /zhi ba las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdo tsam 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// maṅgalaṃ// ༄༅/ /bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mchod pa'i gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / rgya gar skad du/ gu ru pū dzo pa yi kā pū dza nī dhā nā ma/ bod skad du/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mchod pa'i gter zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod 'os kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs pad la btud de/ /de nyid mchod par byed pa'i thabs/ /shin tu mos pa chen pos brtsams/ /de yang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ /shin tu khyad par gyur pa nyid/ /rtag par bla ma la yang dbul/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ sdom pa 'byung bar/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs pa thos shing tshe 'di nyid la 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa dag gis/ bla ma mchod cing mnyes par byed pa la brtson par byed dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni/ rang thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs bsal ba ni/ lha dang lha min gsang ba ba/ /lus sprul la sogs gang ci'ang rung*/ /lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje'i stobs/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas/

/rdo rje 'bar ba'i sku yis ni/ / lus gsum las skyes bags par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'//rnam par brlag 'gyur gzhan du min/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ ces lan gsum byed do/ /zhes pas bka' bsgos la/ sna tshogs 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ /phyogs kun rdo rje 'bar ba'i gur/ /phyi rol ye shes mi dpung 'bar/ /rab brtan bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa bh+rūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pas thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor bsgoms la/ gnas khang dag pa'i zhing du gsal ba'i dbus su seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la spyan drangs pa ni/ skyes mchog gnyis med ye shes spyan can rnams/ /chos kyi sku la gshegs 'byon mi mnga' yang*/ /gzugs sku brtse ba chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /dad ldan mchod pa'i zhing du gshegs su gsol/ /rat+na gu ru sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa 'phro ba'i sku can/ mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa nyan rang*/ chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ mgon po 'gro ba'i don la byon pa legs/ / bdag gi mchod yon 'di nyid bzhes nas kyang*/ /ji srid mchod pa'i bya ba ma rdzogs par/ /yid 'ong gdan la bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pra wa ra sa ka ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas mchod pa phul la/ oṃ pad+ma ā sa na s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan la bzhugs par bsam la/ yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pas/ /gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*/

/bdag blo'i rgud pa zhi mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /dri med yon tan rab rgyas pas/ /'gro kun gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa'i/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / blang dor rtogs pa'i snang ba yis/ /'gro kun mi shes mun sel ba/ /dri med nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams ye shes bsil zer gyis/ /phan bde'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad pa/ /rnam dag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /bla ma'i zhabs la= dam chos bdud rtsi'i sman mchog gis/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal nad sel ba/ /thabs mkhas 'gro ba'i sman pa mchog /bla ma'i zhabs la= thabs dang shes rab gru chen gyis/ /srid zhi'i rgya mtsho mthar sgrol pa/ /stobs ldan 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog /bla ma'i zhabs la= gnod pa kun las skyob byed cing*/ /phan pa dpag med sgrub mdzad pa'i/ / byams mgon 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig po/ bla ma'i zhabs la= zhes pas phyag 'tshal la/ mchod rdzas rnams dang zhing rgya che bar byin gyis brlabs la/ mdog bzang dbyibs legs tshim pa'i dri bsrung can/ /man+da ra dang ut+pal ku mud sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i me tog kun/ /skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /oṃ rat+na gu ru sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rgyu bzang mnams na zhim pa'i dri ngad can/ /a ka ru dang tsan+dan sprul snying sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i bdug spos kun/ /skyabs mchog= badz+ra dhu pe/ mun sel dngos kun gsal ba'i gzi brjid can/ /sgron me nyi zla lus kyi 'od la sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i snang gsal kun/ /skyabs mchog= badz+ra ā lo ke= dri zhim byug na bde ba'i reg mchog kun/ /ga bur gla rtsi nom pa'i dri la sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i dri mchog kun/ /skyabs mchog=

badz+ra gan+dhe/ mdog bzang myangs na bde ba'i ro bcud can/ /'bras chan ka ra rgya gtar khu ba sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i zhal zas kun/ /skyabs mchog= badz+ra nai we t+ya= /don zab thos na snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ /rnga chen dung dang pheg rdob rgyud mang sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i sil snyan kun/ /skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /shap+ta sa mchod la/ / ༈ nyes pa'i skyon kun rab spangs shing*/ /legs pa'i yon tan kun ldan pas/ /phan bde dpal 'byor kun 'byung ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyed la bstod/ /gdul bya smin zhing grol ba'i phyir/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /'dren pa'i tshul du rnam 'phrul pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ khyed sku sha dang rus bral yang*/ /ye shes gzugs su snang ba'i sku/ / dad pa'i mig rkyen mchog gyur pa/ /sku yi dbang phyug khyed la 'dud/ /brjod 'dod rtsol ba mi mnga' yang*/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /zab cing rgya che'i don ston pa/ /gsung gi dbang phyug khyed la 'dud/ /shes dang shes bya'i spros bral yang*/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thugs/ /snying rje'i gzungs spobs du ma'i gter/ /thugs kyi dbang phyug khyed= yon tan cha tsam 'gro kun gyis/ /bskal par brjod kyang mi zad pa'i/ /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /yon tan dbang phyug= mthong thos dran pas don ldan na/ / bsten nas 'gro ba ci smos pa/ /lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' ba'i/ /'phrin las dbang phyug= ces pas bstod/ / ༈ dpal 'byor phun tshogs dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /'khor tshogs yon tan 'phrin las dpag med can/ /sangs rgyas byang sems du mas rab gang ba'i/ /phun tshogs zhing khams kun gyis bla ma mchod/ /rab yangs 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor brtan pa la/ /bkod legs ri gling khor yug rgya mtsho spras/ / brtan g.yo'i dpal gyis phyur bur gtams pa yi/

/phun tshogs 'jig rten khams kyis bla ma= nyi zla rgyu skar rgyas pa dwangs pa'i mkha'/ /na bun 'ja' tshon sprin gyis mdzes gyur zhing*/ /nor bu'i mdangs 'phrog kun gyi go 'byed pa'i/ / phun tshogs nam mkha'i khams kyis= 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin chen ri bo dang*/ /rtsi sman rgyas pa'i nags ri gangs ri sogs/ /dbyibs legs lhun stug skye bo'i rten gyur pa/ /phun tshogs ri bo kun gyis= dri med rba rlabs g.yo ba'i chu klung dang*/ /yan lag brgyad kyis gang ba'i mtsho rdzing sogs/ /yid 'ong rnyogs pa med cing gdung sel ba/ /phun tshogs chu bo kun gyis= g.ya' med mtsho smad nags tshal thang dang ljongs/ /rwa ba 'obs bcas pho brang yul 'khor sogs/ / bde zhing nyams dga'i dpal 'byor gyis gang ba'i/ /phun tshogs bsti gnas kun gyis= mu tig man shel dung dang gser dngul sogs/ /'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin chen ji snyed dang*/ /gur gum gi haṃ tsan+dan dkar dmar sogs//nus ldan nad sel sman mchog kun gyis mchod/ /gzhan yang ro bcud ldan pa 'tsho ba'i rkyen/ /'bru bcud rtsi thog lo tog la sogs dang*/ /mdor na snod kyi dpal 'byor mchod 'os kun/ /blo yis blangs nas mnyam med bla ma mchod/ khams gsum dbang phyug tshangs pa brgya byin dang*/ /mi dbang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal klu dbang sogs/ /btsun mo sras sogs mnga' thang rab rgyas pa'i/ /yid 'ong skye dgu'i dbang po kun gyis mchod/ /rigs bzang 'byor ldan blon po khyim bdag dang*/ /yid 'ong klu len khye'u bu mo sogs/ /gzugs bzang snyan ngag yid gzhungs gos rgyan can/ /yid 'ong skye bo kun gyis bla ma mchod/ /ri ngos 'gying ba'i dung seng khyu mchog dang*/ /ri sul rgyu ba'i kṛṣ+ṇa e n+ya sogs/ /rtsal rgyas mdangs bkrag nges pa'i gom stabs can/ /yid 'ong ri dwags tshogs kyis bla ma mchod/ /nags rir snyan sgrogs ri skeg khu byug dang*/

/sa gzhi'i rgyan gyur bzhad dang khrung khrung sogs/ /skad snyan spu sdug mdzes pa'i gar stabs can/ /yid 'ong bya tshogs kun gyis bla ma mchod/ /mdor na snod kyi sa phyogs yid 'ong na/ /bcud kyi sems can mchod pa gang gnas pa/ /bdag pos gzung dang ma gzung de dag kun/ /blo yis blangs nas chos rje bla ma mchod/ / 'khor 'das phun tshogs ji snyed kun/ /dam pa'i chos las byung ba ste/ /de'ang khyed las byung gyur pa/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas khyed la bstod/ /ji lta ji snyed kun mkhyen gyis/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib spangs pas/ /rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyed la bstod/ khyed thugs rtogs pa'i dam chos te/ /gsung gi rgyu mthun lung gi chos/ /rnam grol 'jug ngogs mchog gyur pa/ /dam chos rin ched khyed la bstod/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mngon gyur zhing*/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa las grol bas/ /bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa/ /tshogs mchog gtso bo khyed la bstod/ /'dod pa'i 'ching ba kun spangs nas/ /dri med bslab gsum brtul zhugs can/ /sdom brtson ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /shākya'i sras mchog khyed la bstod/ /stong nyid snying rje'i sems mchog gis/ /gcig tu gzhan phan brtson pa can/ /rgyal sras sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/ /brtse ldan dpa' bo khyod la bstod/ /smin grol lam la rab sbyangs pas/ /rim gnyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug can/ /rig pa 'dzin pa kun gyi rje/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khyod la bstod/ /༈ dkon mchog mchod dang sems can don bsgrub phyir/ /bsod nams longs spyod bcas pa bdag gi lus/ /skyes mchog khyed kyi bran du legs phul nas/ /ji ltar bsgo ba'i don kun bsgrub bgyi'o/ /dri med baiḍūr sa gzhi yangs pa la/ /gser dngul rtsig pa ba gam dra ba can/ /rin chen ka bas bteg cing khyon yangs pa/ /yid 'ong pho brang gzhal med dam pas mchod/

/bla bre rgyal mtshan gdugs sogs steng nas mdzes/ /dar dpyangs lhab lhub yol ba'i logs nas brgyan/ khri dang gdan sogs 'og nas brjid gyur pa'i/ /phun tshogs nyer mkho'i gzims cha kun gyis mchod/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan chos gos ngur smrig dang*/ /srab 'jam yang ba'i pañtsa li ka dang*/ /rgyu bzang dri zhim ka shi'i ras la sogs/ /phun tshogs na bza' kun gyis bla ma mchod/ /rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dar gyi con pan dang*/ /mu tig do shal nor bu'i ga sha dang*/ / rin chen 'phra bkod gser gyi gdu bu sogs/ /phun tshogs rgyan mchog kun gyis= bsod nams du ma'i dpal las grub pa'i rdzas/ /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang*/ /glang po rta mchog dmag mi rin chen te/ /rgyal srid rin chen kun gyis= nye bar mkho ba'i 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rdzas/ /nags tshal ral gri khang bzang mal stan dang*/ /lha yi gos dang sbrul gyi pags pa lham/ /nye ba'i sna bdun kun gyis= skye dgu bde zhing dge bar byed pa'i rdzas/ dpal be'u 'khor lo pad+ma rgyal mtshan dang*/ /gdugs dang bum bzang dung dkar gser nya ste/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad kun gyis= mdor na 'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing*/ /ma rmos lo tog yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ /'chi med bdud rtsi ro brgya'i zas la sogs/ /longs spyod phun tshogs kun gyis bla ma mchod/ /

༈ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug pas/ /srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog brnyes pa/ /skyabs mchog khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu rdzogs shing*/ /nyer bzhi'i rtsa rlung dbang 'dus pas/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rnam 'gags pas/ /sa bcu'i mthar son khyod la bstod/ /yod min med min gnyis ka min/ /gnyis ka min pa'ang ma yin pa/ / rnam dag zag med chos kyi dbyings/ /spros bral chos sku khyed la bstod/ /mtshan dang dpe byas dpal 'bar bas/ /dag pa'i zhing gi gdul bya la/ /rtag par theg mchog chos ston pa/ /bde chen longs sku khyed la bstod/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i bsam pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul dpag med kyis/ /'gro kun phan bdes tshim mdzad pa/ /thabs mkhas sprul sku khyed la bstod/ /gzugs sku'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyang*/ /de yi rang bzhin 'gyur med pa/ /e ma ho brjod bral zung 'jug dngos /ngo bo nyid sku khyed la bstod/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas gyur zhing*/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa kun spangs pas/ /phung po lnga las yongs grol ba'i/ /ye shes lnga bdag khyed la bstod/ /so so rig bzhi'i thugs mnga' bas/ /stobs bcus bdud kyi dpung bcom nas/ /mi 'jigs bzhi yis chos ston pa/ /yon tan mnga' bdag khyed la bstod/ /spyod pa rtogs pa ye shes dang*/ /'phrin las gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bco brgyad can/ /mtshungs med dam pa khyed la bstod/ / ces pas phyi'i mchod bstod byas la/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ji snyed na/ kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs mchog mchod 'os kun/ /rab mdzes gzugs kyi lha mor blos sprul nas/ / mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i spyan la 'bul/ oṃ rat+na gu ru sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu na pū dza āḥhūṃ/ rab 'byams= zin dang ma zin sgra mchog mchod 'os kun/ / rab mdzes sgra yi lha mor blos sprul nas/

/mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i snyan la 'bul/ /shap+ta kā ma= rab 'byams= lhan skyes sbyar ba'i dri mchog ji snyed kun// rab mdzes dri yi lha mor blos sprul nas/ /mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i shangs la 'bul/ /badz+ra gan+dhe= rab 'byams= bza' bca' btung ba'i ro mchog mchod 'os kun/ /rab mdzes ro yi lha mor blos sprul nas/ /mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i ljags la 'bul/ /ra sa kā ma= rab 'byams= sems can sems can min pa'i reg mchog kun/ /rab mdzes rig bya'i lha mor blos sprul nas/ / mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ spar+she kā ma= zag med bde bas myos byed ma da na/ /stobs skyed go ku la sogs bā la dang*/ /bcud ldan bi ra shu sogs 'chi med ster/ /gsang ba'i dam rdzas kun gyis bla ma mchod/ gu h+ya pū dza= phyag rgya bzhi dang mnyam par sbyor ba las/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde ba'i ro/ /zag med phung khams skye mched brtas byed pa'i/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i mchod pa chen pos mchod/ /a nu rak+to pū dza āḥhūṃ/ /༈ bde dang stong pa dbyer med pas/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i dngos/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyed phyag 'tshal/ khyed sku'i phung po rigs lnga ste/ /'byung ba yum lnga'i lha mo dang*/ /zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i sku/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyed phyag 'tshal/ /dbang po rnams ni sems dpa' ste/ /yul drug sems ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i sku/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon= yan lag rnams ni khro rgyal te/ /bya ba rnam bcu'i khro mo dang*/ /zung 'jug= 'gro ba'i= khyed sku'i khams rnams dpa' bo ste/ /rtsa gnas dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /zung 'jug= 'gro ba'i= rtsa ba'i rlung rnams yab lnga ste/ /'byung ba lnga yi yum rnams dang*/ /zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i gsung*/

/'gro ba'i= khyed thugs ye shes rang bzhin te/ /snang yul chos kyi dbyings rnams dang*/ /zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i thugs/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyed la bstod/ /༈ yid 'phrog mtshan dpes spras pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /sku mdog sngon mo pi waṃ sgra sgrogs ma/ /mdzes ma rang 'dra du ma'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /yid 'ong mchod pa dam pas dges par mchod/ /oṃ bī ni badz+ri ni āḥhūṃ/ yid 'phrog mtshan= sku mdog ser mo gling bu'i sgra sgrogs ma/ /mdzes ma= yid 'ong = waṃ se badz+ri ni/ yid 'phrog= sku mdog sngon mo rdza rnga'i sgra sgrogs ma/ /mdzes ma= yid 'ong = murdzi badz+ri ni/ yid 'phrog= sku mdog dmar mo rnga zlum sgra sgrogs ma/ mdzes ma= yid 'ong = mṛ taṃ gi badz+ri/ yid 'phrog= sku mdog dmar mo bzhad pa'i phyag rgya can/ /mdzes ma= yid 'ong = ha s+ya badz+ri ni= yid 'phrog= sku mdog sngon mo 'gying ba'i phyag rgya ma/ /mdzes ma= yid 'ong= lā s+ya badz+ri ni/ yid 'phrog= sku mdog ljang gu snyan pa'i glu len ma/ /mdzes ma= yid 'ong = girti badz+ri ni naṃ= yid 'phrog= sku mdog ser mo mdzes pa'i gar sgyur ma/ / mdzes ma= yid 'ong = nṛ ti badz+ri ni/ yid 'phrog= sku mdog dkar mo me tog snod 'dzin ma/ /mdzes ma= yid 'ong= badz+ra puṣ+pe/ /yid 'phrog= sku mdog sngon mo bdug spos snod 'dzin ma/ /mdzes ma= yid 'ong = badz+ra dhu pe= yid 'phrog= sku mdog dmar mo snang gsal legs 'dzin ma/ /mdzes ma= ying 'ong = ā lo ka= yid 'phrog= sku mdog ljang khu dri chab snod 'dzin ma/ /mdzes ma= yid 'ong = oṃ badz+ra gan+dhai pū dza āḥhūṃ/ /bde gshegs snying po'i sa gzhi legs bstar bar/ /byang chub sems gnyis dri med yon chab gtams/ /dkar po dge bcu'i me tog sil mar bkram/ /sdom gsum rnam dag spos sprin bstibs pas mchod/ /spyan dang mngon shes rin chen sgron me dngar/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dri mchog kun nas 'khyil/

/snyaums 'jug rnam dgu'i ro brgya'i zhal zas spungs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sil snyan bsgrags pas mchod/ /thar pa'i rim gnyis 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor te/ /byang phyogs so bdun ri gling rab mdzes shing*/ /stong nyid snying rje'i nyi zla cher gsal ba/ /tshogs gnyis khor yug kun nas bskor bas mchod/ /tshe la dbang bcu rin chen gter phye zhing*/ /lam lnga sa bcu'i ma rmos lo tog rgyas/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i dpag bsam stong chen 'khrigs/ /bsdu dngos bzhi yi 'dod 'jo'i ba mos mchod/ /gzungs spobs mtshan dpe'i gos rgyan lhab lhub dpyangs/ /zag med phung po'i 'dod yon sna lnga bkram/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun rgyal srid rin chen mchog /rnam thar brgyad kyi bkra shis rdzas kyis mchod/ /sku bzhi'i tog ldan stobs bcu'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /mi 'jigs bzhi yi rin chen gdugs dkar 'khyil/ /ma 'dres bco brgyad sna tshogs ba dan 'phyar/ /zad par zil gnon rnga yab g.yo bas mchod// rim gnyis gsang sngags dpal gyis rab brjid pa'i/ /dga' ba bcu drug dpa' bo gar byed cing/ /bde stong rnam 'gyur du ma rab ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid bcu drug rig ma mdzes pas mchod/ /grub chen brgyad kyi rgyan gyis rab brgyan zhing*/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyi dpal la dbang 'byor ba/ /'phrin las bzhi yi 'khor bzang gis bskor ba'i/ /mchog gi dngos grub 'khor los bsgyur bas mchod/ /gzhan yang theg gsum gzhi lam 'bras bu yi/ /spangs rtogs yon tan ji snyed de dag kun/ /dad 'dun blo yis blangs shing sprul byas nas/ /chos kyi rgyal po bla ma mchod par bgyi'o/ /༈ khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ /sha dang rus pa khrag kyang med/ /nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ khyed kyi sku ni ston mdzad 'dud/ /sku la bsnyun med mi gtsang med/ /bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang*/ khyed ni 'jig rten rjes 'jug phyir/

/'jig rten bya ba ston mdzad 'dud/ /chu zla bzhin du gzung du med/ /chos rnams gang la'ang gnas pa med/ /nga rgyal med cing mi gnas pa/ / dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshegs dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims/ /spyod lam dag ni thams cad du/ /rtag par mnyam par 'jog gyur pa'i/ /dmigs med= sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdzu 'phrul che la rnam 'phrul zhing*/ /sna chogs min la snyoms 'jug pa'i/ /dmigs med= khams gsum las ni rnam grol zhing*/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur la/ /'dod pa rnams kyis ma gos pa'i/ /dmigs med= phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang*/ /skye mched rnams la mi brten zhing*/ /phyin ci log las rnam grol ba'i//dmigs= rnam rtog med cing kun rtog med/ /thugs ni rab tu mi gnas la/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ /dmigs= ji ltar nam mkha' gnas med cing*/ /spros med gos pa med pa ltar/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pas nang gi mchod bstod rnams byas la/ 'gro ba chu yi zla ba bzhin du lta ba dang*/ /thos pa brag cha dang ni mtshungs par yang dag 'jug /sems kyang mya ngan smig sgyu lta bur blta bya zhing*// 'di ltar bza' dang btung ba dag ni nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /dri ni nam mkha'i me tog mtshungs par mnam pa dang*/ /yid ni nyi ma zla ba lta bur khyab pa nyid/ / yang dag gnas pa bde yang ri bo mchog dang mtshungs pa yin/ /gzhon nu ma yi rmi lam ji bzhin rmi bar bya/ /tha snyad dag ni sgyu ma mig 'phrul lta bur brjod/ / 'di ltar ji bzhin lhan skyes bde 'byung de bzhin te/ srid pa'i rang bzhin bral ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ /rtag tu 'char ba bde legs lam mchog dag gis mchod/ /༈ zab zhi spros dang bral ba gnyug ma'i don/ /snang dang stong pa gnyis dang gnyis min la/ /e ma ho 'di snyam bral ba'i lta ba can/ /bde chen lhan skyes rol ba khyed la 'dud/

/smra bsam brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /bde stong 'dzin pa med pa bde ba'i nyams/ /e ma ho rtsol bral lhug pa'i sgom pa can/ /bde chen lhan skyes= spang blang byar med rang bzhin 'od gsal la/ / gzung 'dzin glo bur dri ma rnam dag pa/ /e ma ho rang bzhin lhun grub 'bras bu can/ /bde chen lhan skyes rol ba khyed la 'dud/ / ces de kho na nyid kyi mchod bstod byas la/ / ༈ bla ma mchog dang phyag 'os thams cad la/ /zhing rdul grangs dang mnyam pa'i lus btud nas/ /yon tan brjod pa'i ngag gis bstod byed cing*/ / lhag bsam gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge ba sogs/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal 'byor kun/ /phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtshor blos sprul nas/ /mchod 'os dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /thog med dus nas nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /sgo gsum sgo nas rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig /bgyis dang bgyid stsal yi rang bgyis pa kun/ / gnong 'gyod sdom pa'i sems kyis mthol zhing bshags/ /skyes mchog sras dang bcas pa'i rnam thar dang*/ /gzhan yang 'gro kun sgo gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /byas dang byed 'gyur da lta mdzad rnams la/ /rab tu dga' pa'i yid kyis yi rang ngo*/ /'gro kun phan zhing dge bar bgyid pa'i slad/ /chos kyi rgyal po sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /gang la gang 'dul zab dang rgya che ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun du bskor du gsol/ /chos kyi sku la skye 'jig mi mnga' yang*/ / gzugs sku zhing gzhan don la mi gshegs par/ /mgon med snyigs ma'i 'gro la rjes brtse bas/ /mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par 'tshal/ /'gro kun bla med byang chub thob don du/ /skyabs mchog khyed la rtag par skyabs mchi zhing*/ /thun mong khyad par dam tshig sdom pa rnams/ /deng nas blangs te tshul bzhin bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /bdag gi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/

/'gro kun srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol te/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas/ /kun mkhyen mchog gi dngos grub myur thob shog ces pas yan lag bdun pa dang sdom gzung byas la/ yid la 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin po che/ / mgon po khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan dam pa'i chos/ /thos bsam sgrub pas rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /thar pa'i ded dpon bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen rnams/ /sku la bsnyun med 'phrin las rab rgyas pa'i/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i bde la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ /dam chos sgrub la brtson pa thams cad kyis/ / zab lam bla ma'i mos gus mthar phyin nas/ /spangs rtogs mthar son bla ma'i sa thob ste/ /gzhan phan tshad med 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /de ma thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du'ang*/ /bla ma mchog gis rtag tu rjes 'dzin zhing*/ / lus dang longs spyod dge bas mnyes byas te/ /brtse bas byin rlabs 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ / ces gsol ba btab la/ bdag ni mi shes bag med dbang gyur pas/ / : ma rigs [ ma rig ] nyes pa'i tshogs rnams gang bgyis pa/ / brtse ldan khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyi/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can gyis bzod par gsol/ /skyabs mchog khyed ni 'gro ba'i don rab mdzad/ / chos kyi sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang*/ /gzugs sku bdag gi lus la rab bskyod nas/ /brtse ba chen pos byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ / zhes pas bla ma rang la bstim mo/ / bdag blo dri med dad pa'i sa gzhi la/ /mi zad mchod pa'i gter 'di rab tu phye/ /nyes pa mchis na brtse bas bzod par gsol/ /dge bas 'gro kun bla med rjes 'dzin shog / de ltar bla ma sgrub pa'i tshul 'di ni dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lo tsā ba blo gros dpal gyis dad pas kun nas blangs te sbyar ba'o/ / zhus dag/shu bhaṃ// ༄༅/ /bla ma mchod pa bde legs rab rgyas zhes bya ba

bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥ bla ma mchod pa bde legs rab rgyas zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang rang bzhin/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma mchod pa'i thabs/ /thun mong mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /gnas khang bzang por sku gsung thugs kyi rten la sogs pa bzhugs su gsol te/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal med khang brtsegs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog/bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas bzang zhing dge ba nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃbadz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai we te/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/

zhes rol mo byin dbab/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang rgyan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ de'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan/ de'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od can/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis brtan par bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rang snang gi shes rab mchog gi bde bas thugs dgyes pa/ 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mdzad pa 'phrin las phyogs bcu dus gsum du khyab pa/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ sku'i mtha' skor du 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gtso bor gyur pa'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang gi tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'og gi cha la mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi mchod pa'i bkod pas nye bar brgyan pa dang bcas te bzhugs par gyur/ rnam dag sku ni skyon bral 'khrul ba med/ /phun tshogs gsung dbyangs shes bya ma lus khyab/ /zab dang rgya che'i de nyid mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /rdo rje gsum dngos dpal ldan bla mar 'dud/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa gtan nas spangs/

/dag pa gnyis ldan yon tan thams cad rdzogs/ /rang gzhan don gyur sku gnyis mngon mdzad pa/ /'khor 'das ma lus sprul par mdzad la 'dud/ /g.yo med sems kyis bsten na skad cig la/ /byin gyis brlabs pas bla med byang chub bam/ /yang na 'dod pa mchog dang thar pa yi/ /dam pa nges par sbyin mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /lhan skyes zung 'jug srid gsum bde chen dngos/ /dmigs med thugs rjes khams gsum 'gro kun sgrol/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan zad mi mnga'/ /chos dbyings rnam dag g.yo med khyod la 'dud/ /nyid kyi ye shes gcig gi rang snang las/ /ma lus rgyal ba sras bcas sprin spro ba/ /bden pa gnyis kyi rnam thar chad mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor 'dud/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /bdag ni skyabs gnas gzhan kun bas// ba spu'i khung bu gcig la yang*/ /lhag par yang ni dad lags pa/ /rmongs pas ma yin rgyu dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun las ches lhag par/ /rgyud sde kun tu rgyal bas bsngags/ /mdo sogs kun tu mtshungs par gsungs/ /rgyal bas nan tan bstod la 'dud/ /phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa sras bcas kyis/ /byang sems rdo rje bzhin du blta/ /thams cad nyin re dus bzhi ru/ /phyag 'tshal mchod nas 'di skad du/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /pha ma ston pa khyod ces sgrog /ston pa rdo rje 'dzin khyod la/ /skyob par bcas pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /grangs med bskal par rgyal rnams la/ /rin chen zhing mchog phul ba bas/ khyod kyi sku la til mar gyi/ /thigs pas mchod na'ang bsod nams mchog /ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes ma lus khyod las byung*/ /mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /rje btsun khyod la mchod cing 'dud/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub tshogs/ /nyid kyi sku gsung thugs la gnas/

khyod ni gang la'ang mi gnas te/ /mkha' mnyam 'od gsal rmad byung che/ /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir rdo rje sems/ /dngos su mthong ba'i skal med pas/ /slob dpon gzugs kyis sgrub rnams la/ /brtse bas mchod pa len la 'dud/ /rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor ye shes lnga/ /'gro ba 'dul phyir phung po lnga/ /tshad med lha mo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor/ /'byung bzhir ston pa ya mtshan rmad/ /spyan sogs yang ni sems dpa' brgyad/ /tshig sogs yang dag khro bo bcu/ /gzugs sogs yang ni rdo rje ma/ /ye shes sku la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skye 'chi can gyi sku'o zhes/ / log par bzung ba gnong zhing 'gyod/ /de bas bsam pa thag pas bshags// bdag kyang khyed ltar mngon gyur cig /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ / bcom ldan sku yi cha shas lags/ /cod pan rigs lnga ba spu rnams/ /dgra bcom lags te de bas 'dud/ /'jig rten lha rnams khyod kyi gdan/ /srid gsum bla ma khyod nyid lags/ khyod ni dkon mchog gsum lags shing*/ /rin chen gsum gyi byed por gsungs/ /g.yo rgyu tshig tsam ma yin par/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bsam pa thag pas skyabs su mchi/ /lhag par dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmangs rigs nyis stong bram ze gcig dang mnyam/ /de bzhin bram ze dge slong rdul med dang*/ /ye shes ldan rnams stong phrag gnyis gnyis su/ /bsgres pa'ang slob dpon gcig dang zhing mnyam par/ /gsungs phyir mgon po rdo rje slob dpon khyod/ /zhing gi rab mchog phul du dbyung med pas/ /rgyal khyod mnyes par byas na kun mkhyen mchog /ye shes bla med thob par yang yang gsungs/ /slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa des/ /bsod nams kun byas dka' thub thams cad bsten/ /sdig 'joms sdug bsngal zhi mdzad srid pa yi/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jings las sgrol mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ khyod la rje mthun gus pas yon phul na/ /rims sogs gnod pa mi 'byung phyogs bcu yi/

/rgyal ba kun la phul bar 'gyur bas na/ /dngos grub mchog ni nges par thob par gsungs/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba lus longs spyod/ /yongs su bzung ba med pa'i mchod rdzas dang*/ /smon lam sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis/ /rab bsgrubs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ khyod la brnyas par byed pa kun/ /rgyal po me dang dug dang rims/ /log 'dren rnams kyis bsad nas kyang*/ /rtag tu dmyal bar 'tshed par gsungs/ khyod la brnyas shing smad na ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la brnyas shing smad/ /gzims cha stan dang lham dang gdugs/ /'gom shing co 'dri byed pa ni/ /don ring dpal nyams nad kyis thebs/ /sku yi grib ma la 'gom pa/ /mchod rten bshig dang 'dra bar gsungs/de 'dra bgyis gang so sor bshags/ /snying nas slob dpon smod pa ni/ /rmi lam du yang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /slob dpon yon tan gzung bya yi/ /skyon ni nam yang ma yin no/ /yon tan bzung na dngos grub ste/ /skyon brjod pa las dngos grub nyams/ /bdag gi sgo gsum bag med pas/ /nyes par bgyis kun mthol lo bshags/ khyod kyi ba spu nyag re yi/ /bsod nams la yang dus gsum gyi/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las thams cad kyi/ /char yang bsgrun par mi nus pas/ /nyid dang nyid kyi rjes gzung dang*/ /nyid la mchod dang phyag 'tshal sogs/ /bsod nams mi zad byed pa la/ /lhag par dang bas yi rang ngo*/ / bskal pa bye bar mdo rgyud la/ /thos bsam sgom la rab sbyangs kyang*/ /bla ma'i man ngag med pa yis/ /byin rlabs rim pa mi rnyed gsungs/ /bla ma'i lung thob dngos grub mchog /'bad med thob par 'gyur bas na/ /bdag sogs 'ching ba las grol phyir/ /zab mo'i 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'od gsal lhan skyes bde ba che/ /thams cad stong pa bla ma yis/ /drin gyis gsal bar 'gyur bas na/ / bdag byin brlabs pa ma rnyed na/ /ngal ba 'bras med de bzhin du/ /bla mas 'phongs pa sngags dang ni/

/phyag rgya rnyed par mi 'gyur bas/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /mtho ris gnas su lha yi dbang*/ /sa steng 'khor lo bsgyur ba nyid/ /sa 'og gdengs can bdag po'i tshul/ /oṃ yig gtsang ma rig byed mchog /'gro ba'i bla ma pha ma gnyen/ /grogs dang mgon dang byed po dang*/ /skyon 'joms yon tan kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor can la 'dud/ /kun 'gro'i ye shes brtan g.yo can/ /'gro 'ong med par khyab mdzad pa/ skye bu'i khyu mchog thub dbang po/ /dbul dang mgon med thams cad kyi/ skyob pa yid bzhin nor bu la/ /mi zad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag /'di phyi kun du snying thag pas/ /sgo gsum dad pas khyod bsten no/ /rdo rje'i rigs la slob dpon bzung ba ni/ /dam tshig kun gyi rtsa bar yang yang gsungs/ /myos byed dman pa'i mchod dang sbyin sreg ni/ /mar dang bral na 'bras med rigs kyi chos/ /btang bas mi rigs don med de lta bur//slob dpon dang bral chos kyang don mi 'grub/ /de phyir dam tshig kun las khyad par du/ /slob dpon dam tshig 'bad nas bzung bar bgyi/ /dus dang gnas skabs dag ni thams cad du/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i 'phrin las bsgrub par shog khyod nyid gang la mnyes pa de sgrub na/ /mi mnyes byed pa thams cad spang bar shog khyod nyid dgyes pas gyur na bdag cag rnams/ /byang chub mchog thob las kyang lhag pa nyid/ /gal te khyod mi mnyes na tshe 'di la/ /byang chub thob kyang don mchog 'ga' ma mchis/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba ma lus pa/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i stobs las tshe 'di la/ /mchog gi dngos grub dam pa mngon 'gyur zhing*/ /rtag tu bla ma mnyes shing mchod byed shog /bdag cag 'khor ba'i btson rar chud rnams la/ /'dren pa khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /mos gus rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rjes g.yel ba med par gzigs su gsol/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku dang bdag gi lus/

/dbyer med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ldan bla : ma £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· mas £© ci gsung bsgrub pa dang*/ /gsung ngag dbyer med rdo rje'i gsung thob shog /thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dang*/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /bde stong zung 'jug stong nyid snying rje'i ngang*/ /thabs shes dbyer med bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mchog /skye med 'od gsal mngon sum mthong zhing rtogs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos khyod dang mtshungs par shog /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba dang*/ /zhi lhag dbyer med ting 'dzin rab 'byams can/ /sgo gsum spyod pa rnam dag dri med kyis/ /gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i gnas las grol bar shog /bsam yas brjod bral rlabs chen thabs mchog dpag med pas/ /da lta nyid du mchog gi dngos grub sku bzhi'i bdag /nam mkha'i mthar thug 'gro rnams theg mchog la bkod nas/ /myur du phan bde'i zhing kun khyab par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes dang*/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*/ / mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab rgyas shing*/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun du bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla ma mchod/ /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ sil snyan phal cher/ sogs brjod/ ar+ghaṃ gyi tshab tu/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ ne wi te/ shup+ta rnams bcug nas thog mtha'i sngags gong bzhin/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra was+t+ra ye āḥhūṃ swāhā/ mgon khyod bkres skyem mi mnga' yang*/

/'o thug bur khu bdud rtsi'i chu/ /bza' dang bca' ba rgya chen po/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos kyi mchog /kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/ /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dam pa dang*/ /blon po glang po rta mchog dmag dpon te/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dpag med kyang*/ /mngon par sprul nas bla ma mchog la 'bul/ /ral gri pags pa skyed tshal khang khyim dang*/ /gzims cha gos dang mchil lham rin po che/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i bde ster ma/ /me long pi wang spos khang bza' btung snod/ /ras phran bzang dang pad+ma bhañdza naṃ/ /cang te'i sgra sgrog kha ṭ+wāṃ la brten ma/ /dkar sngo ser dang dmar dang ljang ba'i gzugs/ /gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan dri ldan bcud ldan ma/ /bde ldan lang tshos dregs pa'i smin legs ma/ /nam mkha' gang bas bla ma lha tshogs mchod/ /bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs gsal ma/ /pi waṃ gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can/ /rgod dang sgeg dang glu len bro gar mkhan// me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog ma/ /gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos 'byung ma/ /bcu drug dga' ma'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma/ /rdo rje rig ma dga' bas rol ba 'di/ /he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang*/ /reg na bde ba lha yi gos/ /mkha' lding khyu mchog rma bya dang*/ glang po rta sogs theg pa'i mchog /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog dang*/ /dpag bsam shing dang 'bras bu'i mchog/bum bzang nam mkha' gang bas mchod/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba kun yang 'bul/ /gser dngul mu tig baiḍūr+ya/ /rin chen zhing rnams bkang nas 'bul/ /dbang sngon rdo rje pad+ma dmar/

/margad byu ru dzam bu'i gser/ /zla shel rin chen bdun gyi ri/ /zhing gi rdul snyed dbul bar bgyi/ / ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga/ /dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ /me tog kar+ṇi ka ra dang*/ / mā li ka dang yu thi ka /me tog kā ra wī ra yang*/ /bsam gtan stobs kyis khyed la 'bul/ /mi 'jigs seng ge rin chen khri/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan mchog dang*/ / rna rgyan dang ni gdu bu'am/ /mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang*/ /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ /dbu rgyan dar dpyangs do shal bcas/ /rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /dkar dang nag dang ser skya dang*/ /de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang*/ /me tog 'phreng ba du ma dang*/ /bla bre dag dang dar dpyangs pa'i/ /mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes/ /de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas mchod par bya/ /gser ni brgya stong du ma dang*/ /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang*/ / glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang*/ /chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid/ /bran pho bran mo sring mo dang*/ /blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dbul bar bgyi/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog

/sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gtso/ /nyes bral zhi ba'i btung ba mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dang shing*/ /bcos pa'i myos byed rnam pa lnga/ /shes rab rang bzhin dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ thabs shes lhan cig sbyor ba las/ /rang bzhin snang ba yongs dag pa'i/ /zhu bdes khams gsum kun khyab pa/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes par bgyi/ / bar 'dir bla ma spyi dang*/ sgos kyi gsol 'debs rnams dang*/ brtan bzhugs la sogs pa'i rim pa ci shes bya'o/ / de bzhin du rgyun bshags dang*/ yan lag bdun pa sogs gang 'grub bya'o/ / bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas/ /bdag lus gang bas bum pa'i dbang bskur thob/ /byang chub sems rgyun mkha' sgo'i lam nas thim/ /bdud rtsi myangs pas gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob/ /sku las rig ma spros te bdag la 'khyud/ /bde ba skyes pas sher dbang thob par bsam/ /bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ / dbyer med gyur pas bzhi pa thob par bsam/ /bsam med ngang du cung zad klod de bzhag /ma bcos so ma rang shar lhan ne ba/ /lhun grub 'bad rtsol med pa'i ngang du btang*/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dang bdag gi lus/ /dbyer med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ldan bla ma ci gsung bsgrub pa dang*/ /gsung ngag dbyer med gsung gi rdo rjer shog /thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dang*/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma dges pa'i bya ba kun bsgrubs nas/ /mdzad pa 'phrin las mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs// mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*/ /lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin*/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog / de nas tshogs kyi yo byad byin gyis brlabs shing tshogs kyi cho ga ni gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pas nyams chags bskang zhing*/ ye dharmas brtan bzhugs bya'o/

/mjug tu bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par byas te/ de ltar yang dang yang du bla ma mchod pa ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bsod nams kyi phung po ches cher 'phel ba yin no/ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen mnyes byed thabs/ / mdo tsam nye bar bkod pa gang yin 'di/ /tshogs gnyis rgya cher spel ba'i thabs mchog ste/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor mchog tu rgyas byed yin// // zhes bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bde legs rab rgyas zhes bya ba 'di/ sa skyong gzhon nu 'gur chen zhes bya bas nye bar bskul te/ tā ra nā thas nye bar sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig gcig zhus/ maṅgalaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /sku skyes bcu bzhi'i bkra shis bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ bkra shis gang zhig dpal ldan spyod pa'i rdo rje zhes / / 'dzam gling 'di na ma sbas gsal bar yongs grags pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug nag po spyod pa'i bkra shis gang*/ /bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol/ /ra tan bha la nges med spyod pa shugs 'byung skyong*/ /rong zom lots+tsha sgra bsgyur mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ /'bab rom dar ma phyag rgya che las ma g.yos la/ /bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol/ / a wa dhū tī ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang la bzhugs/ /zhang ston 'khrul zhig dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag las bsgrub/ /gnyos pan ras chen sna tshogs rten 'brel mig 'phrul can/ /bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol/ /saṅgha bha dra lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /'jam dbyangs chos rje gzhung brgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi nyin byed gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol/ /'jam mgon bla ma grub pa'i dpa' bo'i mtshan 'chang ba/ /dpal ldan kun tu dga' ba rang grol mchog gi rje/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde zhes 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gtso/

/ bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol/ /chos bzhin spyod pa rgyal po'i sras su sku 'khrungs nas/ /mtha' dag 'gro la chos kyi dga' ston spel byed pa/ /ngo mtshar mdzad pas sa skyong kun gyis grub par bsngags/ / bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu mkhas kun dga' bar byed pa gang*/ /snying po'i don ston bkra shis chos sgo 'byed pa'i phul/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal yon bzang po stsol mkhas pa/ /bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol// // maṅga laṃ// ༄༅ /bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru/ tshogs mchod ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs rdzas rnams kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i tshogs rdzas zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta ga na tsakra pañtsa khā hi/ na mo sogs/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa= 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa= dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa= mi 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang*/ /mos gus gzhom med pho brang du/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' drin mnyam med dam pa rje/

/rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin 'thibs/ /'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /gnas khang 'di la byin phob la/ /tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug /'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /stug po'i zhing khams 'jigs pa med/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum sde'i dbus/ /'khor lo sdom pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'dod chags rdo rje 'od dpag med/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ mi g.yo 'og min nyams dga'i zhing*/ /dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod gnas/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i bde skyed yum/ /rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ / rnam 'phrul sogs/ sa la spyod pa'i 'og min mchog /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing mchog nas/ /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yang*/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ bdud tshogs kun 'dul 'phrin las bzhi/ / dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /bgegs 'joms 'dod don kun bsgrub pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas kyang*/ rnam 'phrul sogs/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rigs kyi cod pan ldems se ldem/ /dar gyi cod pan pur ru ru/ /rgyan cha mang po khrol lo lo/ /rol mo mang po dir ri ri/ /glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /'khor tshogs 'bum sde shar ra ra/ /sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne/ /gtad med rigs pa sal la la/ /brjod med dbyings su thal la la/ /bde ba chen po khril li li/ /byin gyis brlab phyir bzhes su gsol/ / gnas khang 'di la byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol/ / bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /'khor gsum gnyis su med par 'dres/ /gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dzñā na a be sha ya a a/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes tshogs sha g.yas dang*/ /nang mchod g.yon du thogs te/ 'di skad ces/ kyai/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag

/rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ /a ho mahā su khaṃ/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med /'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /a ho mahā su khaṃ/ de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs dang*/ oṃ gu ru tsakra saṃ bha ra badz+ra yo gi ni bud+dha bo dhi satwa ḍā ki ni mahā ka la ya sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs kyis 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ phaiṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa un+ma da a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ grah+ṇān+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣān+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu*/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+taṃ/ bhūñdza tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar+tha yaṃ/ sad+su khaṃ/ bi shud+dha/ sa ha yi kā bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ mchod do/ / dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*/ nas/ bde ba chen po mnyes gyur cig de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams kha zas kyis tshim rjes/ tshogs lhag bsdus la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum/ phyi rol sgo drung na gnas pa'i 'byung po 'chol ba'i tshogs dam tshig gi cho ga lta bar mi dbang ba rnams la sbyin no/ /rdo rje theg pa la gsang ba mchog gi sgor spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ u tsiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ oṃ sum bha ni sogs dang*/ rdo rje'i glu sogs brjod// //ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas so/ / gcig zhus/ bkra shis par gyur cig / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / yid ma yengs pas 'di ltar brjod cing don bsam par bya ste/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems snang tsam/ / rang gi sems kyang gsal stong brjod du med/ /snang ba ma 'gags sna tshogs ci shar yang*/ /rang rig skad cig 'di las g.yo ba med/ /oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ rang sems dag pa'i snang ba 'og min zhing*/ /zhing 'di'i dbus su gzhal med khang pas mdzes/ /de dbus seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*/ / drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa bzhugs/ /gzi brjid dpag med gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs dang ldan/ /bdag la dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum dkar g.yo/ /steng gi phyogs la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /rdzu 'phrul bkod pa sna tshogs bcas pa dang*/ /sku yi mtha' skor phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo sogs/ /yi dam lha tshogs thams cad sprin ltar 'thibs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems phyogs bcu'i mkha' dbyings khyab/ /sprul pa'i dgra bcom sa gzhi khyab pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyang*/ /rang rang 'khor dang rdzu 'phrul dpag med bcas/ / bka' la nyan zhing gsung bzhin sgrub pas bzhugs/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs/ /glog ltar 'khyug cing bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin/ /sa dang bar snang ri klung med par khyab/ /thams cad sku ni bkrag mdangs 'od dang ldan/ /gsung ni theg chen dam pa'i chos sgra sgrogs/ /thugs ni 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ngang*/ /mdzad pa 'phrin las ma nges cir yang ston/ /kun kyang rje btsun bla ma'i sprul pa ste/ /gzhan yang 'khor 'das snang ba ma lus pa/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i ye shes cho 'phrul tsam/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod ci mchis dang*/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ci yod dang*/

/phyogs bcu'i zhing na bdag pos ma bzung ba'i/ /mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed mchis pa dang*/ /dgra gnyen bar mas bsdus pa'i sems can ni/ /'gro drug nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs ji snyed dang*/ /srid pa gsum gyi longs spyod gang mchis dang*/ /bdag gi yid kyi sprul dang smon lam mthu/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bcas/ /dus gsum phyogs bcur byung ba thams cad kyi/ /ye shes rang snang las grub mchod pa'i tshogs/ /grangs med tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /mchog tu brj-id bag chags pa'i tshul dang bcas/ /bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med pa/ /skye med chos sku'i cho 'phrul tsam du bsgom/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ /dam chos kun 'dus chos rje rin po che/ / dge 'dun kun 'dus 'dren mchog rin po che/ /bla ma kun 'dus gcig chog rgyal po khyod/ /yi dam thams cad khyod kyi sku la tshang*/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad pho nyar sprul/ /rdo rje 'chang chen khyod la gsol ba 'debs//mos pa'i bu la da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /stug po bkod pa'i zhing du rdo rje 'chang*/ / drag po 'dul tshe he ru ka dpal sku/ /chags bral rnams la shākya thub par bstan/ /dka' thub can la drang srong tshul 'dzin zhing*/ /theg gsum lam du zhugs pa'i sems can la/ /byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos tshul du ston/ / tshangs dang khyab 'jug 'dod lha dbang po dang*/ /dbang phyug la sogs lha yi gzugs su'ang ston/ kha cig tu ni rgyal srid spyod la dgyes/ /gzhan du rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad pa spyod/ /la lar ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyang 'chang*/ /gang la gang 'dul sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems can kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin du/ khyod kyi bstan pa 'di yang bsam mi khyab/ /ji ltar mkha' la sprin dang 'ja' tshon sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs brnyan snang na yang*/ /nam mkha' las byung nam mkha'i ngo bo dang*/

/nam mkha'i ngang du thim par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /spros bral ci yang ma yin chos kyi sku/ /'bad rtsol med kyang lhun grub 'phrin las can/ /gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa spyir bstan yang*// rang rig rang gsal spros bral dbyings kyi ngang*/ /skye 'gag med cing 'gro 'ong gnas dang bral/ /don dam sku can khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /mchod pa thams cad dbyer med ngang du 'bul/ /rang bzhin med kyang sdig kun mthol lo bshags/ /'khor 'das dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*/ / grags stong brjod bral gsung la chad pa med/ /chos kyi sku la skye 'chi mi mnga' yang*/ /chos 'khor rgyun mi 'chad par bskor ba dang*/ /'gro ba'i don la rtag tu bzhugs su gsol/ /thugs yid dbyer med don du bsngo bar bgyi/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyid/ /rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po khyod nyid kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par da lta bskur du gsol/ /lus la lhan skyes bde chen bskyed pa dang*/ /ngag la rig sngags nus pa brtan pa dang*/ /sems la 'od gsal ye shes 'char ba ru/ /

mtshan ldan bla mas da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma'i dpral mgrin thugs ka lte ba las/ /'od zer byung nas bdag gi gnas bzhir thim/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yi/ /byin gyis brlabs shing dbang bzhi thob par gyur/ /slar yang bum pa'i chu yis bum dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems kyis gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhing*/ /mnyam sbyor bde bas shes rab ye shes dang*/ /'dzin med phyag chen bzhi pa'i dbang yang bskur/ /re sa gzhan na med do chos kyi rje/ / skyabs gnas gzhan na med do rin po che/ /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du dbyer med cing*/ /'bral med gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsir zhu/ /rtsa 'khor bzhi po gang bas dbang bzhi thob/ /bla ma rang sems dbyer med chos sku'i ngang*/ /rtsa bral lhun grub chen po'i ngang du bzhag / ces pa 'di ni mchog tu gyur pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor te tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas ster bar the tshom med do/ /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la dpal bzang ldan du bris pa'o/ / bkra shis// ༄༅/ gdon 'grol gyi cho ga shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru/ 'dir gdon 'grol gyi cho ga shin tu bsdus pa la/ sdom ni/ dang po yo byad tshogs par byas/ /gnyis pa lha yi sgrub mchod yin/ /gsum pa gdon gyi bya ba dang*/ /bzhi pa rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /bris sku'am maṇ+ḍal bshams nas ni/ /mchod gtor bshams shing dkyil 'khor 'bri/ / bum pa bcas la klu gzugs bshams/ /klu gtor rtsi sman bum pa dang*/ /glud gzugs gzugs 'gros sna tshogs bshams/ /mchod dang cha gsum gtor ma'o/ /gnyis pa bdag mdun bskyed pa dang*/ /bum sgrub rdzas rnams byin rlabs dang*/ /klu yi dkyil 'khor cho ga'o/ /gsum pa dgug mchod bkru byabs dang*/ /mchod dang bsrung ba bya ba nyid/ /bsgrub bya la yang bkru byabs dang*/ / gdon la mchod cing bsrung bar bya/

/gtor sogs btang nas shis brjod byed/ /rjes ni klu la bzod gsol dang*/ /gshegs gsol byin rlabs mdun bskyed mchod/ /dngos grub blangs te yig brgya bzla/ /bzod gsol gshegs gsol bdag bsrung da nga*/ smon lam dang ni bkra shis bya/ / zhes pa'o/ /de la bshoms ni/ seng ge sgra'i bris sku yod na bgram/ med na maṇ+ḍal steng du tshom bu bshams pa mañdzi la bkod/ /rdul tshon gyi maṇ+ḍal byed srol yang yod/ de'i mdun du mchod pa dang dkar gtor gcig bzhag de'i g.yas su bum pa spyi dang mthun par bca'/ g.yon du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya/ gru bzhi mu khyud sbrul gyi rang bzhin/ phyogs bzhi'i dbus su mgo snol zhing*/ zur bzhir mjug ma snol ba'i tshul du bya/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad pad 'dab kyi phyi gru bzhi'i nang du chu ris 'bri/ 'dab ma brgyad la kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i tshom bu 'god/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ras bris su byas kyang rung ste/ de'i tshe 'dab ma la klu dgu zhal phyag tu byas kyang legs/ de'i steng du mañdzi la klu dgu'i rten gyi gtor ma bshams dgos te/ zangs gzhong ngam gtor gzhong gtsang ma'i nang du/ gru bzhi bang rim gnyis brtsegs kyi steng du/ gru bzhi mkhar stabs rtse mo phyogs bzhir glang gi mgo re phyir bstan pa/ dbus su glang gi mgo gyen du bstan par byed/ 'di chu bdag wa ru ṇa'i gzugs yin gsung*/ bang rim dang po'i phyogs mtshams brgyad la sbrul re re/ bang rim 'og ma sbrul sbal lcong nya sogs srog chags gnyan dgu'i gzugs 'god/ ras dmar po'i gdugs chung ngu zhig bang rim dang po'i rgyab kyi phyogs zhig tu 'god/ de la srad bu dmar po zhig kyang btags/ de'i mdun du'ang mchod pa rnams bskor ba'am/ phreng la sgrig pa gang bde yin/ snod che ba gcig tu dkar gtor bshams la bzhag /klu sman sna tshogs btab pas gang ba'i bum pa rtsi sman gyi bum par grags pa dang*/

'o mas gang ba'i bum pa dang*/ ka to ra gcig tu mtheb kyu gang mang dang*/ yang gzhan zhig tu phag /bya khyung*/ gla ba/ rma bya bzhi ma gtogs pa'i srog chags sna tshogs pa'i gzugs 'gros 'tshogs tshad bcug pa rnams go skabs gang yangs pa zhig tu bzhag /rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma yang phyogs bzhir bzhag /cha gsum gtor ma yang phyogs gang 'os zhig tu bsgrigs/ rdo dril la sogs pa yo byad gzhan dgos pa rnams kyang tshogs par bshams/ gnyis pa lha'i sgrub mchod la/ dang por mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥ de'i 'od kyis lus gang*/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ phyir 'phros te rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang rje btsun seng ge sgra 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo bhaṭ+ṭarā ga singha nā tha bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥ oṃ singha na dā sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang 'thun/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du/ seng las seng ge dkar po nyal stabs mgo g.yas su phyogs shing*/ gdong pa gyen du phyogs pa/ ral pa dmar ser thur du 'phyang zhing rin po che'i dra bas g.yogs pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba la hrīḥdakar po de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phangs la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo g.yas kyi steng du brkyangs shing*/ g.yon rgyab kyi char gdan la brten pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing ral pa'i thor tshugs can/

zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan spangs pa dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa dang ldan pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs dang/ ri dwags nag po'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ sku'i g.yas logs su tri shu la ljang khu la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa dang*/ g.yon logs su me tog pad+ma'i steng du thod pa me tog sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang*/ pad dkar gyi sdong po snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi ral gri me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la hrīḥ de las 'od 'phros rje btsun seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / zhes pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ spyi gtsug tu rnam snang*/ dpung pa g.yas la mi bskyod pa/ g.yon la 'od dpag med/ dpyi g.yas par rin 'byung/ g.yon par don grub rnams sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing bzhugs par gyur/ bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha nā da hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po ci 'grub dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ mahā satwa ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭi/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi ka ro ṭi/ ka ro ḍi/ bid+ye swāhā/ gzungs nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/

zhes pa nas/ bzhugs par gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ rang nyid ces pa bor ro/ / ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /yon tan dam pa kun gyis brgyan/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / bar 'dir bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ slar yang mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i chod yon 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ āḥhri singha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ad+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa ma ye shrī ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil dang*/ pād+yaṃ/ de bzhin du shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar/ mchod pa'i tshig mchod yon phal cher ma dang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma sogs spyi 'gro gang bdes chog mi 'jigs thogs med seng ge'i khri steng du/ /rnam dag 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes/ /sku mdog dkar gsal gangs ri'i phung po 'dra/ /rje btsun seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud kyi g.yul bzlog spyan dmar mtshan dpes spras/ /chos sku stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu la/ /gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don du cir yang sprul/ /dpa' bo seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas rtse gsum rgyal rigs sbrul gyis dkris/ /g.yon pa thod pa ral gri 'bar ba yis// sgrub pa po la dngos grub blo stsol ba'i/ /dam pa skya bas mchog khyed la= sku las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga spro zhing*/ /slob dpon 'od dpag med par dbu la brgyan/ /spyan gsum gzigs pas sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad/ rje btsun thugs rje can la= skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /grong gi cha dang yul ljongs spangs pa'i sar/ /bag med nyal dang spyod lam thams cad du/ /rje btsun khyod kyis thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ / zhes bstod/ skabs 'dir bum bskyed ni gong gi mdun bskyed sgrub tshul des rigs 'gre/

yang mdor bsdus pa'i tshe na mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed phyogs gcig tu sgrub pas chog ste/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po tshom bu can zhig bya/ phyogs gang yang rung bar bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ mchod pa dang dkar gtor gang 'os bsgrigs/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bum pa dang bcas pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal gyi steng dang bum pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar gong bzhin/ rten cing 'brel 'byung sogs kyis mchod/ mi 'jigs thogs med sogs kyis bstod cing gsol ba btab nas/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ bum pa'i lha la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de gnyis la thun mong du gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gzungs ring gi swāhā 'i gong du/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi bcug pa lan lngas mdun bskyed bum pa gnyis char la dmigs nas 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ chos sku mnyam nyid ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi ba'i phyir/ /klu 'dul byams pa'i rang bzhin gzugs skur bstan/ /'phags pa seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ mchod yon phul bas bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu bar bsam/ bar 'dir rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par gyur/ oṃ e h+ye hi tsa dur mahā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ oṃ dh+ri ta raṣ+ta ya/ bi ru ḍha ka ya/ bi ru pak+ṣa ya/ bai shra wa ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo nas/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ bā ling ta swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/

spro na re re'i mtshan sngags la nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya sbyar la lan gsum gsum gyis phul na shin tu legs so/ / tsa tur mahā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ / mar gad mdog can pi waṃ 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /yul 'khor bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang = mig mi bzang la= ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang = rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos zhal mthong zhing*// sgrub la brtson pas byang chub thugs su chud/ /thabs mkhas sny-i+-i+-ing rjes tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad pa/ /bdag dang gzhan don 'byor ba khyed la 'dud/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phul/ de nas cha gsum gtor ma gtong*/ rtsi sman gyi bum pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ de bya a mṛ te na pra tīts+tsha na ma swāhā/ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam dang*/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa nai sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes ci rigs par bzlas la byin gyis brlabs/ mtheb skyu dang gzugs 'gros la rgyas par na sngags drug phyag rgya drug dang*/ bsdu na/ na maḥsarba tā tha ga ta bh+yo bi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum gsum dang*/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags gsum gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ klu'i mchod pa byin rlabs kyang spyi dang mthun par byas la/ maṇ+ḍal dang rten gtor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus rin po che'i gzhal med khang gi nang du pad+ma dkar po'i lte bar baṃ dang*/

'dab ma brgyad la naṃ yig rnams las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su chu bdag wa ru ṇa/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ shar lhor pad+ma/ lho ru nor rgyas/ lho nub tu dung skyong*/ nub tu 'jog po/ nub byang du pad+ma chen po/ byang du mtha' yas/ byang shar du rigs ldan/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po lha'i lus can/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdeng ka dang sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ klu'i rgyal po rnams 'khor dang bcas pa e h+ye hi nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes lan gsum 'dod rgyal gyis phyag rgyas bkug dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur te 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa ni/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma 'i tshigs bcad la/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ sngags kyi skabs/ /oṃ wa ru ṇa/ pad+ma/ karko ṭa/ ba su ki /shaṅka pā la/ tak+ṣa ka mahā pad+ma/ ku li ka a nan+ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ
