sogs sbyar la rol mo'i bar du 'bul/ yang sngags de nyid la/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa thams cad sel mdzad cing*/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bstod pa 'bul/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /bdag dang bsgrub bya 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir klu gtor gyi rigs shes tshad btang bas kyang legs par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa gdon gyi bya ba la/ bris sku dang rten gsum yod na khrus gsol spyi dang mthun la rgyas bsdus gang rigs shig bya/ sku khrus gsol ba'i khrus chu de yang bum par blug la bzhag / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu'i tshogs dang*/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po sogs pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ sa bdag klu gnyan gyi rigs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du bsgrub bya la gnod cing lan chags pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan sogs gdon thams cad gnod sems zhi ste phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur te/ gnas 'di nyid du bkug cing 'ongs par gyur/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ bden brdar rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa brjod la/ bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gdon thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba la gnod cing lan chags pa dang sha 'khon gnyer ba'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas skad cig thang cig yud tsam la mchod pa'i gnas 'dir mchis par gyur cig yi dam gyi snying po'i mthar/ oṃ sarba nā ga nāṃ nā gi ni naṃ/ nā ga ku la naṃ/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun la sogs pas dgug /da dung zhe gnan pa rnams mi khugs pa srid pas/ rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te bkug par gyur/

oṃ tsu ru kun+da tsu ru kun+da sarba nā ga ā kar+ṣa ya hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis dgug sarba nā ga bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ gyis dam la bzhag bang rim 'og ma'i gzugs 'gros rnams la thim pas de rnams dngos su gyur/ sarba nā ga bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ zhes pa thams cad kyi mgor sbyar te/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ sa bdag klu gnyan la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad dang*/ bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba la gnod cing lan chags pa dang sha 'khon rigs rnams mchod gtor rgya chen po 'dis tshim par mdzod la/ phan pa dang bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas/ bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba'i nad gdon sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs gong bzhin 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slar yang me long la klu rnams kyi gzugs 'char bar byas la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis sogs kyi mthar gzung sngags dang snying po lan gsum gyis mthar/ sa bdag klu gnyan rnams kyis sdig sgrib thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ nad thams cad= yan lag nyams pa thams cad= dbang po nyams pa thams cad= longs spyod nyams pa thams cad= gnas khang nyams pa thams cad= 'khor g.yog dang nor nyams pa thams cad= gnad du phog pa thams cad= lus sems la sdug bsngal bar gyur pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes bkru/ shan+tiṃ ku ru 'i gnas su/ a pā na ya bcug pas byabs/ de nas snod gtsang ma zhig tu sngar gyi gzugs 'gros ci rigs pa dang*/ mtheb skyu ci rigs pa bcug /'o ma'i bum pa dang*/ rtsi sman nas blug nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brjod cing bsgrub bya'i lus la g.yas bskor du bskor/ klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ sa bdag klu gnyan la sogs pa gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang*/

khyad par du yang bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba la gnod cing lan chags pa dang*/ sha mkhon gnyer ba'i rigs rnams gzugs brnyan sna tshogs pa'i glud gzugs 'di dag dang*/ sman dang gtor ma dang mchod yon rgya chen po 'di dag 'bul bas/ lan chags byang bu lon khyer/ mkhon rnams zhi ste/ gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ma lus pa spangs te/ phan pa dang bde ba sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ / zhes brjod nas klu'i rten gtor gyi snod der blug /tshul des lan bdun nam bcu gcig gam nyi shu rtsa gcig gang rung la gzugs 'gros dang mtheb skya rdzogs par byed/ rtsi sman lhag ma cung zad gcig 'ong bar bya/ de'i phyed gnod byed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i tshul gyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ yi dam gyi snying po dang rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ wa ru ṇa pad+ma karko ṭa zhes pa nas/ ku li ka a nan+da ya swāhā/ zhes klu dgu'i sngags dang*/ oṃ in+d+ra ya zhes pa nas/ a dho pri thi wi swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar cha gsum gyi phyogs skyong gi mtshan sngags ltar brjod nas/ sarba nā ga du kha pra sha ma na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes brjod cing*/ klu'i rten gtor gyi mtha' la rtsi sman ldugs/ de 'dra lan gsum bya/ 'dis klu'i nad gdon rtsa ba nas dag par 'gyur ba yin/ slar mi ldog pa'i don du shan+tiṃ ku ru 'i gnas su rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bcug la rdo rje rgya gram 'jog tshul byas pas bsrung ba'o// de nas snod gcig tu glud gzugs bcug la/ de'i mgo steng du bsgrub bya khrus byas pa'i khrus khu 'dor du bcug /byabs pa yang de la bya ste/ bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad de la thim par mos su gzhug /bkru byabs kyi ngag 'don yi dam gyi sngags 'don pa spo ba ma gtogs tshe chog dang 'dra/ glud gzugs khrus khu dang bcas pa de/ phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa'i skyes bu'i lus su gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brgya lan gsum gyis gnod byed klu rnams la phul bar bsam/

klu gtor gyi mdun du bzhag /de nas bsgrub bya la bsrung ba bya ste bkru byabs kyi rigs 'gre/ de nas sngar gyi rtsi sman gyi 'phros de 'gro phyogs su gtor te/ chu bdag chen po wa ru ṇa/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma dang*/ /nor rgyas dung skyong 'jog po dang*/ /pad chen mtha' yas rigs ldan rnams/ /rigs bzhi gdug pa'i tshogs bcas dang*/ /gzhan yang gdol pa'i rigs rnams dang*/ khyad par bsgrub bya 'di nyid la/ /gnod par byed pa'i klu gnyan dang*/ /sa bdag gdon gyi tshogs thams cad/ /mchod pa rgya chen dpag med dang*/ /dam rdzas kun gyi bskong zin gyis/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi bar mdzod/ /thams cad dges shing tshim byas nas/ /rang gi dam tshig la gnas te/ /'di la bde legs mdzad pa dang*/ /so so'i gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ /bcings pa thams cad grol bar gyis/ /bzung ba thams cad btang bar mdzod/ /nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams stobs rgyas mdzod/ /gal te bka' las 'das gyur na/ khyed rnams dmod pas nyams par 'gyur/ /ci ste phan pa'i sems ldan na/ /bla med bde ba'i gnas thob shog / ces brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas klu'i rten gtor dang mchod gtor sbrags pa gtsang sbra dang bcas te rab tu mtsho'am chu bo chen por skyel/ de dag thag ring na chu phran rdzing bu chu mig sogs su skyel/ thang stong du sa dong brus nas sbas kyang rong ngo*/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor bskyur ba dang*/ bya rog dang khyis za ba sogs mi legs par bzhed do/ / de nas bsgrub bya de ras dkar sogs stan gsar pa la 'bru dkar gtor ba la bzhag gang la ser sna rnams chags pa sogs dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs par brjod/ gtsang sbra can gyi dga' ston bya'o/ /bzhi pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ de nas yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs/ de nas klu'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyis bris pa yin na/ oṃ sarba nā ga badz+ra muḥ

zhes gshegs su gsol nas dkyil 'khor bsdu'o/ /ras bris yin na gshegs su mi gsol bar/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan bzhugs byas nas sgril/ de nas yi dam gyi gtor ma khang thog tu skyal la/ mchod pa kha gsos/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ tshom bu yin na gshegs gsol/ bris sku sogs la brtan bzhugs/ rang gi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sogs bsrung ba rnams dran par bya/ bum chus bkru ba sogs rang la'ang bkru byabs srung gsum byed pa dang*/ smon lam dang bkra shis rnams byas te cho ga gzhan gyis rigs 'gre'o/ /de'i nyin mo rab tu lus ril po bkru/ de min yang gdong dang kha lag bkru/ khyad par bza' btung gi rjes su kha lag 'phral 'phral 'khrud/ dkar rdor byed pa gal che/ ma mtha' yang cho ga hril ma song ba la de rnams mi bya ba'i thabs med/ seṅge sgra'i bsnyen pa rgyas pa'am/ ma mtha' yang snying po la zhag bdun ma gcig song na/ byin rlabs yid ches rtags thon ma rang yong nges so/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad ldan kun chos pa'i don du/ cho ga zor yangs pa'i bya ba gtso bor ston to/ /tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// maṅga laṃ/ zhus dag / ༄༅/ /klu gtor ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ klu gtor gtong bar 'dod pas/ rin po che'i snod du chu gtsang ma 'o ma dang bcas pa la klu sman dang dar zab sna tshogs rin po che sna lnga 'bru sna lnga sogs btab pa bshams te/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid hrīḥyig dkar po ring cha tsha ེ ga drag dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa la rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon me tog pad+ma dkar po'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ ras bzang po'i sham thabs dang*/ ri dwags kyi pags pa'i nu ma bkab pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ ri bo po ta la nas rje btsun spyan ras gzigs la/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams rang la thim pas/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar yi ge drug mas bskor bar bsam/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes ci rigs bzlas/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod la/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan par bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥzhu ba las/ gnas yid du 'ong ba rin po che'i brag bya skyibs can mkha' lding gi gnod pa mi 'byung ba dang*/ mtsho dang rdzing bu dang ne'u sing dang*/ pho brang dang skyed mos tshal la sogs pa rnams su/ lha klu'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ klu nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar gyur/

dkar gsum mngar gsum yid 'ong mtsho/ /me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ /klu'i pho brang yid 'ong bar/ /dbus su pad sdong 'dab ma brgyad/ /phuḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ni/ /klu rgyal chu lha dkar po ni/ /sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs kas mdzes/ / phyag gnyis thal sbyar 'dzum bag can/ /lha lus rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba'o/ /shar du mtha' yas sngon po dang*/ /lho ru pad+ma : dkar £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· ser £© po dang*/ /nub tu 'jog po dmar po dang*/ /byang du nor rgyas ljang khu dang*/ /me ru dung skyong dung mdog dang*/ /bden bral karko ṭa ljang dang*/ /rlung du rigs ldan sngon po dang*/ /dbang ldan pad chen ser po sogs/ / thams cad sbrul mgo'i gdengs kas mdzes/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /lha lus rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba'o/ / 'khor du klu rigs kun gyis bskor/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig dang*/ /de rnams sku las 'od zer 'phros/ /klu chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs so/ /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shing*/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gzhan yang klu dang sa bdag sogs/ /zha bo dang ni 'theng po dang*/ /rgur po yan lag mdze can dang*/ /stong gsum gling gsum 'dzam gling dang*/ /ma dros gtsang po khron pa dang*/ /rtsi shing nags tshal skyed mos tshal/ /g.ya' ri gangs ri rdza ri dang*/ /spang ri nai gseng la sogs pa'i/ /rang rang gnas nas spyan 'dren gyis/ /dug gsum gdug pa'i sems bor la/ /dga' dang gus pa'i bsam pa yis/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ khyad par bdag dang sbyin bdag la/

/gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa yi/ /klu dang sa bdag ma lus pa/ /pad+ma'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ / klu rnams mtha' 'od kyi lcags ris bskor bar gyur zhes brjod/ des gtor ma bsngo ma zin gyi bar la phyi la yan 'gro sa med par bsam/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin mthil du ni/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /hrīḥlas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /gtor snod khengs shing phyir lud pas/ /sa bdag klu gnyan tshogs rnams kyis/ /'thung zhing legs par khrus byas pas/ /lus dang yan lag nyams pa rnams/ /gsos shing lha lus thob par gyur/ oṃ bā su ke maṃ swāhā/ brgya rtsa sogs ci rigs bzlas shing*/ oṃ hi li hi li mahā hi li phruṃ phuḥswāhā/ gsum/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma tiṣ+ṭha dzuṃ phruṃ phuḥhūṃ swāhā/ lan bdun sogs kyis phul na legs/ oṃ sarba nā ga rā dza bh+yaḥ.a kā ro btags/ oṃ sarba nā ga ra dzñi bh+yaḥ oṃ ā kā ro/ oṃ sarba nā ga ku mā re bh+yaḥ.oṃ a ka ro

nas/ oṃ sarba na ga ku mā ri bh+yaḥ.oṃ a kā ro= oṃ sarba nā ga prid+dhe bh+yaḥ.oṃ a kā ro= oṃ sarba nā ga prid+dhi bh+yaḥ.oṃ a kā ro= oṃ sarba nā ga ku li bh+yaḥ.oṃ a kā ro= oṃ sarba nā ga ku li bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro= btags te phul/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen mo dang*/ /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang*/ /lha mo lha mo chen po dang*/ /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*/ /sog ma med dang hu luṇ+ḍa/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*/ /gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*/ /lto 'phye chen po shī li dang*/ /shi li chen po rnams dang ni/ /klu chen 'khor bcas gtor ma bzhes/ / mdzes pa'i dkar gsum gtor ma 'di/ /mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che/ / rin chen phreng ba'i them skas can/ /klu'i gnod pa skyob byed pa/ /mthun pa'i rdzas su 'di gyur cig /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /klu las gyur pa'i gnod pa ni/ /mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug /bsam ngan dug dang kha rlangs dug /de la sogs pa'i dug rnams kun/ /yud tsam gyis ni zhi gyur cig/ bdag las gces pa'i rdzas khyer la/ /bdag la gnod pa ma byed par/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/ /pha ma lta bu'i sems kyis ltos/ / de nas/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung*/ nas/ rigs su skyes kyi bar gyi chos sbyin byin/ klu rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i ched du/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ kā ni kāṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tra sa ni tra sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me sarba satwa nañtsa swāhā/ ci nus bzlas/ sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad kyi/ /lus kyi na tsha gsos gyur cig

/sems kyi sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /yan lag nyams dang nying lag nyams/ /nyams pa'i lus rnams gsos gyur cig /mkha' las bye tshan 'bab pa dang*/ /sha khrag bu chung gcer bus 'jigs/ /gnod pa de rnams zhi gyur cig /sdug bsngal nad kyis zin pa la/ /sman gyi mchog tu 'di gyur cig /'jigs shing skrag pas dngangs pa la/ /mgon skyabs mchog tu 'di= dbul zhing phongs pas mnar ba la/ /'dod dgu'i dpal du 'di = bkres shing skom pas gdungs pa la/ /bza' btung mchog tu 'di= 'gro dus lam ngan rnyed pa la/ /lam mkhan mchog tu 'di= ma rig mun pas 'thibs pa la/ /snang gsal mchog tu 'di= gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la/ /'chi med mchog tu 'di gyur cig /mdor na gang la gang dgos pa/ /rgyun chad med par 'byung bar shog 'di yan byed na/ klu yi rigs ni khyed rnams kun/ nas/ gats+tsha yan no/ /rgyas par byed pa dang gshegs pa bstun no/ / klu gnyan sa bdag khyed rnams kyi/ / gnas dang pho brang bshig pa dang*/ /sa gnyan rkos dang rdo gnyan bsgul/ /shing gnyan bcad dang brag gnyan gshags/ /ne'u gsing brus dang chu mig bsubs/ /nya sbal bsad dang grog tshang bshig /yan lag breg dang rwa rmig gnad/ /mi gtsang dri ma phog pa sogs/ /nyes pa'i skyon gyi khyed rnams la/ / nad dang sdug bsngal ci mchis pa/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho yi/ /bdud rtsi'i sman 'dis gsos gyur cig khyed kyi gnas khang nyams pa na/ /rin chen sna lnga'i bdud rtsi yis/ /gnas khang nyams pa gsos gyur cig /gnas khang nyams pa gsos nas kyang*/ /klu rnams mdangs dang ldan pa dang*/ /nad med dpal 'byor rgyas par shog / ces pa rigs pas sbyar ba'ang bsdus kyang rung ngo*/ / 'o ma rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi yis/ /chu mig nyams pa gsos gyur cig/snyug ma ser po'i bdud rtsi yis/ /shing rnams nyams pa gsos gyur cig /nā ga pus pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /dbu skra nyams pa= rgya mtsho lbu ba'i bdud rtsi yis/

/klad pa nyams pa gsos gyur cig /ut+pal sngon po'i= mig gi dbang po= gur gum pri yang ku yis ni/ /sna dang rna ba= ut+pal dmar po'i= lce yi dbang = mgron bu dkar po'i bdud rtsi yis/ /so yi nad rnams zhi gyur cig /thal kar rdo rje'i= pags pa nyams pa gsos gyur cig /dbang po lag pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ yan lag nyams pa= chu srin sder mo'i= nying lag nyams pa= pu shel rtse'i= rtsa rgyus nyams pa= dung dkar g.yas 'khyil= rus pa nyams pa= mtshal dkar da chu'i bdud rtsi= sha khrag nyams pa= snying bu zho sha'i bdud rtsi= snying gi nad rnams= mkhal ma zho sha'i bdud rtsi= mkhal ma'i nad rnams zhi gyur cig /li khri dmar po'i bdud= mchin pa'i nad rnams zhi gyur cig /'om bu btsod kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /rgyu ma nyams pa gsos= gla gor zho sha'i= mtsher ba nyams pa= cu gang dkar po'i bdud rtsi yis= glo ba nyams pa= g.yu sgong 'bar ba'i= lgang ba'i nad rnams zhi gyur cig /gi haṃ ser po'i= tshad pa'i nad rnams zhi= dza ti pha la'i= rlung gi nad rnams zhi= dri zhim spos kyi bdud rtsi= mi gtsang dri ma dag gyur cig /snying po lnga yi bdud rtsi yis/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal zhi= sman sna lnga yis= nyon mongs dug lnga zhi= 'bru sna lnga yi= longs spyod phun sum tshogs gyur cig /dar tshon sna lnga'i= gos sogs skyabs dang ldan gyur cig /sa bdag klu gnyan khyed rnams la/ /bsad cing gnad nas rgol ba dang*/ /'khon zhing 'gras pa ci mchis pa/ /de ring 'khon sel 'gras pa sdum/ /mchod sbyin 'di yis tshim gyis la/ /klu yi rigs ni khyed rnams kun/ /sems dang shes pa gsal gyur cig /drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /shin tu khros pa zhi gyur cig /dbang po rnams kyi spyod yul du/ / mkho dgu'i longs spyod thams cad ldan/ /nyams pa'i lus rnams gsos shing rgyas/ /yan lag thams cad bde gyur cig /ngan song gsum las thar nas kyang*/

/tshangs ba'i bde dang ldan gyur cig /chos spyod dbang po phul nas kyang*// phyag na rdo rje'i zhal mthong shog /sngags dang sman sogs byin rlabs kyis/ / nad dang nyer 'tshe kun spangs nas/ /drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la/ /klu rnams rang rang gnas su gshegs/ /byang chub sems dang ldan par gshegs/ / skabs 'dir 'od kyi lcags ri mi dmigs par sgom/ rgyal rigs dkar po shar du gshegs/ /rje rigs ser po lho ru= dmangs rigs dmar po nub tu= bram ze sngon po byang du= gdol pa nag po mtshams bzhir= sa yi bdag po sa la= chu yi bdag po chu la= oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ gzhan yang las la grub pa yi/ /bka' dang dam las ma thogs pa'i/ /gdug pa can gyi klu rnams kun/ / rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs/ / bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ga ru ṭa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ zhes pas dkar phyogs kyi klu rnams gshegs su gsol/ nag phyogs kyi klu rnams bskrad nas/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor bar bya'o/ / dug gsum klu'i sdug bsngal dang*/ / dug gsum klu'i nad zhi nas/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis/ /sku gsum rdo rje 'dzin thob shog / ces smon lam bkra shis ci rigs bya'o// // klu gtor ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ gcig zhus// ༄༅/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa'i ngag 'don bzhugs so/ / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor mgron thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ / 'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni/ /sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum/

/yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'dir ru/ /gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po la/ /spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rang rgyal nyan thos dang*/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /bgegs rnams gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la/ /spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ / yo byad tshogs shing lag len ltar bshams la/ thams cad spyi mthun du/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhohaṃ/ gis stong par sbyangs/ zan bcu chus sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ zhes lan nyer gcig brjod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul lo/ /bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas gtso byas sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi t+ye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ bzhi pa yan chad la sngags nyer gcig res bsngo ba dang*/ de man chad la bdun bdun bsngo/ thog mar 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ bzhi pa yan chad la ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod pa yang gong gis rigs 'gre bar byas nas/ khyad par so so la gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ste/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ rdo rje nag po chen po dang*/ dpal lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/

lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ phyogs skyong bcu/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi ste/ dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lag na rdo rje lnga brgya la sogs te dkar phyogs skyong ba khyad par can bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la dbul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ bdag cag chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams dang*/ dge sbyong dang*/ bram ze dang*/ lha'i drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa ngag tshig gi mthu grub pa rnams la dbul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'phel ba dang*/ bdag cag la 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ mthu rkyen 'grub pa'i smon lam bzang po gdab tu gsol/ bzhi pa ni/ bdag cag 'gro ba rnams kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang*/ rnam thos sras la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang*/ bsrung skyob mdzad pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dbul lo/ / nad dang dbul 'phongs zhi zhing*/ 'jigs pa las bskyab pa dang*/ tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ 'di man chad la ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa mchod pa'i dod du/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes brjod dgos shing*/ lnga pa ni/ rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas 'dzam bu'i gling gi gzhi bdag rnams dang*/ khyad par bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ sgos yul phyogs 'di nyid la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i/ sde brgyad mthu bo che thams cad la dbul lo/

/'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'beb pa dang*/ nad dang mu ge dang 'khrug pa rnams zhi ba dang*/ khyad par du bdag cag gi mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i gnas po bzang po mdzad du gsol/ drug pa ni/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon chen po nor bu bzang po dang*/ 'brog gnas mched lnga dang*/ phyogs mtshams bsrung ba nyi shu £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡·+ rtsa brgyad/ stobs chen sum cu £© rtsa gnyis/ 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa sogs gnod sbyin mthu bo che 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /sems can la gnod tshe'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/ bdag cag la bar chad bsrung zhing*/ bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bdun pa ni/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad bdag rims bdag la sogs pa gnod sbyin thams cad la sbyin no/ /deng phyin chad bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba dang*/ gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /bdag cag la phan sems mchog dang ldan par gyur cig brgyad pa ni/ 'gro ba rigs drug / lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no// rigs drug so so'i lan chags bu lon byang zhing*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral nas/ pha rol du phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig dgu pa ni/ yi dwags kyi gtso mo kha la me 'bar ma la sogs te yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad la sbyin no/ /so so'i mdun du zas skom bdun rtsi'i char chen po babs nas/ bde bar longs spyod pas tshim par gyur cig / ser sna'i sdig sgrib byang zhing dbul 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar gyur cig bcu pa ni/ bdag cag la tshe rabs snga ma nas lan chags pa'i mgron bu lon ma khyer ba dang tshe 'dir yang thugs zur dang*/ sku zur dang spyan zur la phog pa rnams dang*/ gnod byed kyi gdon ngos ma zin pa rnams la sbyin no/

/lan chags byang zhing bu lon khyer bar gyur cig khyed rnams gtor ma 'dis tshim zhing*/ re ba thams cad skongs bar gyur cig bcu gcig pa ni/ mdang da nang bsad pa shi ba da lta srid pa bar dor 'khyams pa'i bar do'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /bar do'i 'jigs pa las grol nas/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku myur du thob par gyur cig bcu gnyis pa ni/ ma thob pa ma sleb pa khas zhan cing dbang chung ba/ lhag ma la dbang ba rnams dang*/ glo bur du lhag pa rnams la sbyin no/ /so sor zas skom gyis tshim pa dang*/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig paṃ aḥhrīḥhūṃ/ bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ /yi dwags rnams ni tshims byas nas/ khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog ma ṇi nyer gcig dang*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ zhes chu sbyin/ oṃ dz+wa la mi daṃ sarba pre ta bh+yaḥswāhā/ sa gtsang sar chu blugs/ se gol gcig gtogs/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /sems can kun la phan btags phyir/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams 'di ma lus par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig

/chos rnams gang dag nas/ nges par grol gyi bar dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ khams gsum dag pa'i zhing*/ /srid gsum snying rje'i mgron/ /ma lus khyab pa'i rdzas/ /chos nyid rtogs pa'i mthus/ /mi zad gter du bsngo/ /gtor ma mi zad pa'i gter la longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig / bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ dge ba bsngo/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa/ /'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*/ /gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*/ /sa blar 'khod pa gang yin pa/ /mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su/ /thams cad thams cad 'gro bar gyis/ /sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ sarba pre ta gats+tsha/ sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ / sogs smon lam dang bkra shis gang 'os bya// // gtor ma brgya rtsa'i ngag 'don rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / bkra shis/ zhus dag/ ༄༅/ /bsur gyi lag len zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bsur gyi lag len 'dod pas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i bsur snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las byung ba'i bsur lha rdzas las grub pa/ kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gsum brjod la/ oṃ a sa pra ti su ra phug pa swāhā/ zhes lan bdun/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/

/de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ / brjod la/ bsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa la sogs pa dri za zhing dri la longs spyod pa'i rigs su gtogs pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /dri'i 'dod pas tshim nas gnod 'tshe med cing gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /gzhan yang sems can mdang da nang shi ba bsad pa/ lcebs pa srid pa bar do na gnas pa/ lus snga lus bor nas/ phyi lus ma lon pa rig pa gtad med du 'khyams pa/ bar do'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba rnams la bsngo'o/ /bar dor bza' btung longs spyod char bzhin babs nas lus gzugs sku rnam gnyis dang*/ sems chos skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig /ngan song sdug bsngal ma myong zhing*/ / dka' ba spyad pa med pa yang*/ /lha bas lhag pa'i lus kyis ni/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni sogs brjod ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ zhus dag / ༄༅/ /chu gtor 'jam dpal ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ dug rigs med pa'i sman rnams dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sna dang*/ chu gtsang ma bshams te/ skyabs sems byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge maṃ las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas kyi phyag mthil/

pus mo g.yas la bkab pa'i tshul gyi 'gying bag dang bcas pa/ g.yon pa gdan la brten pas ut+pala'i sdong po snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba 'dzin pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs rgyal po rol ba'i stabs las g.yas rol gyis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ snying po ci rigs bzlas/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi mchod/ gzhon nu sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron mes rab brgyan zhing*/ / 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod do/ /de nas gtor ma sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya ni/ thal mo khong stong snying gar sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ stong pa nyid du bsam zhing*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya ni/ thal mo sbyar ba las tshigs bar pa gsum bcag pa dpral ba ru dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad rnams ni nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par bsam zhing*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya ni/

thal mo phyir bskyed mthe bong bsnol la kha'i thad du dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas thams cad kyang sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam zhing*/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya ni/ g.yon khu tshur dal steng du bzhag /g.yas khu tshur sdigs mdzub byas pas snod la bstad pa dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ zhes pas 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi spyod yul du 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar bsam zhing*/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya ni/ g.yas khu tshur/ g.yon snying gar 'degs tshul byas pa dang*/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūṃ/ zhes pas lus zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa 'phags pa rnams la phul bas mnyes shing*/ sems can rnams kyang yo byad la rtsod pa med cing mthun pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni/ sor mo nang du bsnol ba spyi bor bzhag pa dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza na mahā sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes pas thams cad kyang dam tshig la gnas pas phan pa dang bde ba'i 'phrin las 'ba' zhig sgrub par bsam zhing*/ phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan zhing sngags rnams lan gsum la sogs pa'i brjod par bya'o/ /de nas/ na mo bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de/ /'gro ba ma lus 'di dag sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni/ /sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /yid kyi sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru/

/gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po la/ /spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras nyan thos rang rgyal dang*/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'gro drug sems can dang*/ /bgegs rnams gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la/ /spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ / zhes pas spyan drangs te/ pad+ma ka ma la s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul la/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thad khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba ling ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'khor 'das kyi mgron thams cad la ye shes kyi bdud rtsi nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rgya che ba rgyun mi 'chad pa phul bas dgyes shing tshims par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis/ /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skongs gyur cig /rigs drug gtor mas tshim gyur cig /sha 'khon bu lon khyer ba dang*/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas 'phags pa rnams gshegs su gsol zhing*/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i/ /'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*/ /gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*//sa blar 'khod pa gang yin pa/ /mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su/ /thams cad thams cad 'gro bar gyis/ /sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/ zhes 'byung po rnams rang gi gnas su btang la/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bkod la bdag bsrung zhing bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis bya'o// //chu gtor ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /zhus dag/ bkra shis// ༄༅/ /dkar gtor cha bzhi bzhugs so dge / oṃ swā sti/ dkar gtor cha bzhi ni/ tho rangs la sogs pa bza' btung ma byas pa'i sngon du mdzad pa'i lag len yin/ gtor ma lcog zlum gsum dang zan ril gnyis bshams/ chu gtsang gis bran/ gtor ma dang po/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ

gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rje btsun gtum po sngon po khro rgyal mi g.yo 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam bdun bzlas nas/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pas phul/ oṃ ār+ya a tsa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis mchod/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang*/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*/ /srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad de/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems shing bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje'i mgon/ / rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan khro rgyal mi g.yo bas/ bdag cag gi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bdag cag bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal nas/ bdag cag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ / gtor ma gnyis pa yang*/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar gong bzhin byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ lho phyogs ri bo po ṭa la nas rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ po ṭa la yi gnas mchog na/ /tāṃḥyig ljang khu legs 'khrungs shing*/ /tāṃḥyig 'od kyis 'gro ba sgrol/ /sgrol ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wā re e h+ye he/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/

na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ/ ā pra ti ha ta shā sa nāṃ he he bha ga wa te mahā satwā sarba bud+dha a wa lo kī te/ mā bi laṃ ba mā bi laṃ ba/ i daṃ bā ling gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ sarba bi pañtsa re swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum la sogs pas gtor ma phul/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gong bzhin/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de/ /'phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ / sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag dang sems can ma lus pa/ /'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug las/ /rtag tu skyob cing bsrung ba dang*/ /gzhan yang bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal bskyed nas/ /'gro kun dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dngos grub kun/ /gegs med yid bzhin stsal du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab bo/ /gtor ma gsum pa gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ yang na rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ me'i phyag rgya dang*/ hūṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ā na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje bsdams pa dang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ brta li brta li mahā brtaṃ li hūṃ hūṃ dza dzaḥ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang*/ /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang*/ /lha mo lha mo chen po dang*/ /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*/ /sog ma med dang hu lun ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ / tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*/

/gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*/ /lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang*/ /tshi li chen po rnam dag ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha mahā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye/ sarba bhur bhu waḥphruṃ phuḥhūṃ swāhā/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ nā ga sogs de kho na bzhin sbyar la/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta swāhā/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong sgrengs pa'i khu tshur la g.yas pa'i lag mthil gtad de sor mo rnams bskyod pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phuḥswāhā/ zhes brjod cing*/ se gol gtogs pa lan gsum la sogs pa byas la/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dzuṃ phruṃ phuḥhūṃ swāhā/ lan gsum nas bdun gyi bar gyis gtor ma phul/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he dun+te ṣān ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/

/thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las rnam par grol/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ / zhes chos bshad/ klu chen po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du bdag cag rnams la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim zhing dgyes par gyur cig / gnod sems dang gdug pa'i bsam pa nye bar zhi nas/ phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sa pā ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes se gol phyi la gtogs/ /klu byings rnams rang gnas su gshegs par mos/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsā le tsā le swāhā/ zhes pas nag phyogs kyi klu rnams bskrad par mos/ /gtor ma bzhi pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ mthar se gol gdab pa dang bcas/ sngags 'dis gtor ma sbyin no/ / na maḥsu ru pā ya ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha he saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ su ru su ru/ pra su ru pra su ru/ ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ sma ra sma ra/ san+tar pā ya san+tar pā ya/ sarba pre ta nāṃ swāhā lan gsum nas nyer gcig gi bar ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ a pa sa ran+tu/ a pa tā ra/ sarba pre tak+ṣi ṇo/ da dā mya haṃ/ sarba lo ka dhā tu wa sī nāṃ/ pre ta nā ma hā raṃ swāhā/ yi dwags thams cad gtor mas tshim zhing*/ 'thab rtsod la sogs pa med par/ bde bar longs spyod cing tshim pa thob par gyur cig sarba pre ta gats+tsha/ zhes se gol gtogs/ /dkar gtor cha bzhi dngos ni de yan chad yin la/

de'i steng du/ gzhi bdag gtor ma yang bsnon pa'i lag len yin pas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs dang*/ hūṃ badz+ra dz+wa la sogs dang*/ oṃ a kā ro nas/ twad kyi bar gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gang rung gis phul/ gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun gyi gzhi bdag thams cad dang*/ sgos 'dzam bu gling gi spyi'i bdag po/¿yang sgos bod kha ba can gyi gzhi bdag bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ dge bsnyen mthu bo che nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa dang*/ khyad par du yang*/ yul phyogs dang sa phyogs 'di dag gi gnas bdag gzhi bdagagrong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bdag cag rnams kyi yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bsrung zhing*/ bar chad thams cad sel ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub pa'i gdong grogs dang gnas po bzang po mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /rigs drug kun la phan gdags phyir/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /thogs pa med par 'grub gyur cig / ces brjod do/ /dzam bha la ser nag gi chu sbyin byed par 'dod na/ gtor snod kyi 'gram du/ dzaṃ las 'phags pa dzam bha la ser po rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas shing thog bi dza pu ra ka dang*/ g.yon gter gyi ne'u le'i 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol ba'i stabs kyis dung dang pad+ma la sogs pa gter chen po rnams la zhabs brten pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin nor lha pho mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa dzam bha la 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang gi lag mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i bh+rūṃ hūṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ oṃ dzam bha la dza len dra ye swāhā/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu sbyin phul/ oṃ ār+ya dzam bha la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis mchod/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*/ /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam bha la/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdung ba bdag /skye ba skye bar khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /rin chen gter gyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad dbul 'phongs las grol zhing*/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub gegs med par stsal du gsol/ yang rang gi snying ga nas hūṃ spros pa/ gtor snod kyi steng du yongs su gyur pa la/ 'phags pa dzam bha la nag po gcer bu rigs ngan gyi cha lugs rna ba ma phug pa/ g.yas thod khrag dang*/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ gcer bu khro bo'i cha byad can sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rtags bsgreng ba/ pad nyi nor bdag gi gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas pa'o/ /baṃ las byung ba'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ in+d+ra ya ṇi mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swāhā/ lan bdun gyis zhal byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ swāhā/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu sbyin phul/ gong ser po'i skabs bzhin/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ mgon po nam mkha'i mdzod can nor gyi char 'bebs pa/ /ma skyes rang bzhin dag pas sku mdog sngon por bzhugs/

khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid de bdag mchod do/ /rtag tu yid la re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ser sna'i las kyi zhes pa nas/ stsal du gsol gyi bar gong bzhin no//thams cad kyi thun mong du yig brgya lan gsum bzlas la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'os pa brjod do/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / gcig zhus dag/maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /gtor ma chen po'i cho ga bar chad kun sel bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ bla ma ba ri bas bal yul du byon nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta zhig spyan drangs nas byon pa dang*/ gser med nas pu hrangs su phyin nas btsad po rtse sde dang mjal nas/ rgyal po la dbang bskur byas/ chos bshad pas rgyal pos gser srang brgya phul skad/ de rnams paṇ+ḍi tas tshags byas nas bla mas bdag la bag tsam zhig gnang ba zhu byas pas/ ma phyin par slar yang rgol ba dang khro ba la sogs pa byed du byung bas/ shin tu sun te paṇ+ḍi ta bal yul du skyel du phyin skad/ de nas bal yul du sleb pa'i lam du mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta gcig dang 'phrad nas/ kho na re/ khyod kyi nga yi lo tsā ba gyis la bod du 'gro dgos zer nas byung skad/ de la bla mas mi byed byas pas/ kho na re ngas mu stegs kyi chos mi 'chad par/ sangs rgyas pa'i chos bshad zer kyang bla mas ma gsan pas/ kho na re/ khyod la mthu byed zer ba la/ ngas khyod la nyes pa ma byas par mthu :bya ba'i £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· byas pas £© sha gas med byas nas/ rgya gar du byon skad/ de nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal nas chos gsan gyi yod tsa na/ rdo rje gdan pa na re/ khyod la mu stegs kyi gnod pa yong bar 'dug gsung bas/ /mi yong byas pas 'ong bar 'dug gsungs pas/ 'o na bal yul du mu stegs skal ldan rgyal po bya ba dang 'phrad nas 'di ltar byung lags zhus pas 'o na de ka'i yin gsung nas/ bla mas bha ya na'i sngags bzlas/

gtor chen lan gsum btang bas tha ma la shi skad/ des na 'di byin rlabs che ba yin gsung*/ rdo rje gdan pa/ bla ma ba ri ba/ bla ma chen po/ 'di lo rgyus dag pa yin gsung*/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams srid mtsho las bsgral zhes/ /blo chen dad ldan bla ma dang*/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug la//btud de gtor ma'i cho ga bri/ /ngan rtog smra ba'i dri bral zhing*/ /phan pa byin par byed pa 'di/ /gang zag gnas dus yo byad dang*/ /cho ga phan yon sdom drug yin/ /de la gtor ma gtong ba'i slob dpon dang*/ bum pa la bzlas pa byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa gnyis ni/ dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan zhing khro bo gang yang rung ba'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas bya'o/ /gtor g.yog kyang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan zhing srung ba dang ldan pa ste/ de ltar bzhi ka gtor ma'i bya ba ma tshar gyi bar du ngag bcad par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ mi dang dud 'gro la sogs pas dben pa/ gtsang ba/ sgo la gtor snod shong ba'i sa der phyag dar legs par bya ba dang*/ me tog la sogs pa dgram par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gza' dang skar ma bzang po 'dzom pa'i tshe bya'o/ /bzhi pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor phyogs re la khru bzhi bzhi yod pa gru bzhi pa/ de ma shong na yang khru gsum las chung ba mi rung*/ ba byung lnga dang tsan+dan gyis legs par byugs la/ de'i nang du chos 'byung rtse mo phar phyogs bsgrub bya'i phyogs su bstan pa/ dbus su gtor snod chen po rdza'am zangs gzhong du rung ba tshon rtsi re kha dkar pos bris pa rdo rje'i stegs la bzhag /mchod pa ni me tog sogs lnga'am bdun slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar du g.yon nas rim pa bzhin du bsham mo/ /gtor ma'i yo byad ni/ yul gang yin gyi bres bcal ba'i srad phyed legs par sbrus la/ phyed chan du btso/ /phyed zan du bya'o/ /de ma 'byor na bre bcu gnyis la snga ma bzhin bya'o/

/zan la mtheb skyu brgya rtsa brgyad du bya zhing*/ chan la'ang de bzhin du mnyam por snod gcig gis gzhal zhing bya'o/ /bum pa ni zag rdol med pa chu bre gsum shong ba/ de ma yin na yang chu bre gang shong pa de la mgul bcings sogs bum rdzas dang chus bkang bgegs bsal la/ de slob dpon gyi g.yas su dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs par bum mchog pa'i mdun du bzhag /bum pa la mchod pa rnams kyis skor/ bzlog glud ni rjen phye btsos pa la 'bru sna tshogs kyis brgyan te/ nad pa la sogs pa bsgrub bya gang yin gyi gru gang pa byas la/ lung thang gi mig dang*/ 'gron bu'i so dang*/ skra tshab dang*/ nor bu la sogs pas brgyan dang*/ zhwa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de chos 'byung gi rtse mor snod kyi nang mthong ba tsam du bzhag go /gzhan dag byed kha byed pa sogs yod na/ rang gi 'khor du yod pa la zan kham re gtad la bsrung ba bya'o/ / de ltar dkyil 'khor mchod pa bshams/ gtor ma'i yo byad bshams pa dang*/ bum pa bzlog pa'i glud bshams pa/ rnam pa lnga yi yo byad bshams/ lnga pa ni/ gang zag bzhi khrus legs par byas la/ slob dpon stan bde ba la 'dug /gtor g.yog gnyis bde chas su gzhug slob dpon dang bum chog pa gnyis kas bdag bskyed lhan cig rnam 'joms bsgoms/ gzungs ci rigs pa bzlas/ mchod bstod gtor bsdus bya/ de nas bum chog pas bum par lha bskyed bzlas pa sogs cho ga ltar byed cing*/ de nas g.yas kyi gtor g.yog gis 'bru chan blugs/ g.yon gyi gtor g.yog gis zan dang argas bkang*/ slob dpon gyis 'di la sbyin dang mi sbyin pa'i dmigs pa gang yang mi bya bar/ mdun gyi gtor ma chan sogs la dmigs nas/ lag g.yon rdo rje dang bcas snying gar khu tshur bcangs/ g.yas dril bu dang bcas gtor ma la brten mchog sbyin phyag rgya la mthe bong dkyil du bkug nas srin lag gi rtsa ba non pa'i chos sbyin gyi phyag rgya bya/

sems kyis lag g.yas mthil du raṃ dmar ro/ /de'i steng du a dkar po raṃ las me 'bar a zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsam/ sam+bha ra 'i sngags bdun re brjod/ lag pa g.yas kyi phyag rgya sngar gyi de kha phul la/ mchod pa rnams la rim pas reg ring so so'i sngags dang dharma ra ṇi ta brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan nas brjod pa med/ de nas gtor g.yog chan blugs pa ngos kyi snod chen por blugs la bshal lo/ /de lta bu lnga bcu rtsa bzhi btang la/ glud de snod de'i nang du gzhug /de nas yang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i bar du btang nas/ de nas dpang gzugs ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs thams cad/ /dpang por bzhugs la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi/ /bden pa'i don 'di 'grub gyur cig /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /dpang por =sogs tshig gsum 'dra/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams/ /dpang por sogs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro khro tshogs rnams/ dpang por sogs/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga rnams/ dpang por sogs/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ dpang por sogs/ dkar phyogs skyong ba mthu chen rnams/ /dpang por sogs/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag zhing skyong tshogs/ dpang por sogs/ mna' dang mtho yi shan 'byed pa/ /nyes med rnams kyi stangs 'dzin pa/ /nyes can kun gyi tshar gcod mkhan/ /legs nyes khrims kyi rjes gcod pa/ /srid pa'i zhal lce gcod pa kun/ dpang por sogs/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ yang na/ rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas zhes brjod/ lha ru dkon mchog gsum po mchod/ /lag len dge ba bcu dang 'brel/ /byams dang ngo tsha khrel yod bsgom/ /mi rigs ngan pa'i las kun spangs/ /bden tshig brgya dang ldan pa lags/ /ma rungs sdig can 'di pa ni/ /spyir gyi dge ba'i chos la smod/ /sdang zhing gtum la drag shul che/ /rdzun dang g.yo sgyus rang gzhan bslu/

/'jig rten phung byed ma gzigs sam/ /mthu rtsal can rnams rtags phyung shig /bdag cag sde dang bcas pa yi/ /mi mthun 'joms pa'i dus la bab/ /bar chad sel ba'i dus la bab/ /'dod don sgrub pa'i dus la bab/ / ces rol tshig dang bcas te/ dpon slob bzhi'am/ kun gyis mnyes pa'i dpang gzugs bya/ glud rabs/ glud bshad/ glud rdzongs/ bskul sogs spros pa byed na sdebs gcig la skabs 'dir byed pa thob thang yin par 'dug go /gtor bsngo'i sngon la byed pa ni mi legs/ yang na 'og tu bden brdar gyi gong la byas na'ang rung ngo*/ /glud rabs ni/ kyai glud byung dang po gang nas byung*/ / dang po lha'i yul nas byung*/ /lha dbang brgya byin snyung gis zin/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis/ /dar gyi glud chen btang ba yis/ /lha dbang brgya byin snyung las thar/ /glud byung bar pa gang nas byung*/ /bar pa rgya gar yul nas byung*// rgyal po dar ma 'dun rgyal ni/ /mi snyung de ni dgu ru snyung*/ /rje btsun byams pa mgon po yis/ /glud chen btang bas snyung las thar/ /glud byung tha ma gang nas byung*/ /tha ma bod kyi yul nas byung*/ /rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis/ /glud chen rgyan dang ldan pa 'di/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /sde brgyad rnams la btang ba yis/ /bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ /da lta sngags 'chang bdag cag gis/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po'i glud chen 'di/ /'dre srin rnams la bsngos pa yis/ /nad dang gdon las grol bar 'gyur/ /gnam sa gnyis la srid pa'i glud/ /glud kyi de ni pha smos pa/ /gnam gyi de ni ka yang rtse/

/glud kyi de ni ma smos pa/ /sa la srog mo glud kyi yum/ /de las dar gyi glud chen byung*/ /kyai snang srid lha 'dre tshur gson dang*/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas la/ /lan chags bu lon snyegs pa yis/ /sde brgyad 'dre srin thams cad kun/ /glud chen gzugs mchog rgyan ldan 'di/ /'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i glud/ /ting 'dzin rgyal pos dbang bskur bas/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po'i glud du gtong*/ /de skad de ni bgyis pa las/ /glud mchog gom gsum phar 'phar nas/ /slar yang log ste 'di skad smras/ /sngags 'chang rgyal po tshur gson dang*/ /'bru mchog dar gyi mi po che/ /mi yis glud du gtong lags na/ /'byung ba bzhi dang dbang po lnga/ / yan lag lnga dang tshogs drug dang*/ /phung khams skye mched kun dang ldan/ /gos dang rgyan dang dkor cha sogs/ /de rnams bdag la 'tshal lags na/ /skye 'gro'i glud du 'gro bar bgyi/ /de skad de ni zhus pa las/ /sngags 'chang rgyal po'i zhal na re/ /dar gyi glud chen tshur nyon dang*/ /'byung ba gzugs sogs khyod la tshang/ /sha med 'byung ba sa la byas/ khrag med 'byung ba chu la byas/ /drod med 'byung ba me la byas/ /dbugs med 'byung ba rlung la byas/ /dung phor dkar por rus par byas/ /rdo rgyus byang bal rgyas par byas/ /reg 'jam de ni lpags par byas/ /chag tshang ku ba khyod kyi mgo /mgo bsgyur de ni shigs se shigs/ /zer mo 'phan bzang khyod kyi skra/ /skra lo de ni shigs se shigs/ /lung thang 'bar ba blta ba'i mig /nag dang de ni hrigs se hrig /snyan cha bzang mo snyan du byas/ /sgra snyan de ni lhangs se lhang*/ /ka kol dri bsrung snom pa'i sna/ /dri bsrung ngad pa byings se byings/ /leb rgan dmar po smra ba'i lce/ /smras mkhas de ni thol lo lo/ /'gron bu thod dkar bzhad pa'i so/ /dkar dngas de ni khrigs se khrigs/ /dbang po lag pa g.yob pa'i lag

/sor bcu de ni khrabs se khrabs/ /rkang pa thabs shes zangs lcags byas/ /'gro mkhas de ni shams se shams/ /mon lug brla sgang khog pa'i snying*/ /dran pa de ni rgya cher ldan/ /gla gor zho sha glo bar byas/ /mkhal sran dre bo mkhal mar byas/ /pho long lgang pa mtshan mar byas/ /rnam shes brgyad dang tshogs drug dang*/ khams dang skye mched khyod la tshang/ /gos dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /mi nor sna dgu rgyab tu khur// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /'di 'dra'i glud mchog ya mtshan can// sgang bu de ni mtho mtho nas/ /gsung dbyangs de ni kyu ru ru/ /bshod bu de ni dma' dma' nas/ /'gro mkhas de ni shams se shams/ /lcags thag de ni brdar brdar nas/ /skyes pa dmag la chas pa 'dra/ /rgyan cha mang po pur ru ru/ / mo btsun bag mar chas pa 'dra/ /de tsam de ni 'tshal bas na/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi glud du song*/ /kyai snang srid lha 'dre tshur nyon dang*/ /de ring bden pa'i ngag nyon la/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas la/ /lan chags bu lon rnyog pa yis/ /'dre srin 'byung po'i tshogs bcas kun/ /glud chen gtor ma 'di long la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ / lam dang yul bstan pa ni/ sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs bcas kun/ /dar gyi mi chen zhal na re/ /'gro ba'i lam dang yul ston zer/ /kyai lto mkhan rgyal po'i zhal na re/ /dpyid zla gsum dang dbyar zla gsum/ /rlung dang char zil lto yi lam/ /ston zla gsum dang dgun zla gsum/ /lo tog gtsang chab lto yi lam/ /stong lam shul ring lto ba'i lam/ khyod kyi lam yang de ru bstan/ /glud chen 'dre srin der song zhig / ces bsngo zhing yul bstan pa ni/ phyogs phyogs bya ba pha gi na/ /nyi ma shar phyogs pha gi na/ /yul yang shel gyi yul la byas/ /mkhar yang shel gyi mkhar la byas/ /mi yang shel gyi mi la byas/ /smra re mkhas la ngag re 'jam/ /shel gyi rta chung rgo ba tsam/

/ 'gro re mkhas la bang re mgyogs/ /lha 'dre'i tshogs pa de na che/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi/ khyim sgo lam 'phrang 'di kun du/ /'dre srin sdod pa'i gnas ma mchis/ /de phyir dpon shong lags kyang g.yog mi shong*/ /rta bshong lags kyang sga mi shong*//mdzo shong lags kyang khal mi shong*/ /da rgyug de ni 'gro re ran/ /nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na/ /yul yang gser gyi yul la byas/ /mkhar yang gser gyi mkhar la byas/ /mi yang gser gyi mi la byas/ /smra re mkhas la ngag re 'jam/ /gser gyi rta chung rgo ba tsam/ /'gro re mkhas la bang re mgyogs/ /lha 'dre'i tshogs pa de na che/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor= khyim sgo lam 'phrang = 'dre gdon sdod pa'i= de phyir dpon shong = rta shong lags kyang = mdzo shong lags kyang = da rgyug de ni 'gro re ran/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na/ / yul yang zangs kyi yul la byas/ mkhar yang zangs kyi mkhar la byas/ /mi yang zangs kyi mi la byas/ /smra re mkhas la ngag re 'jam/ /zangs kyi rta chung sgo ba tsam/ /'gro re mkhas la bang re mgyogs/ /lha 'dre'i tshogs pa de na che/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi/ khyim sgo lam 'phrang 'di kun du/ /'dre srin sdod pa'i gnas ma mchis/ /de phyir dpon shong lags kyang g.yog mi shong/ /rta shong lags kyang sga mi shong*/ /mdzo shong lags kyang khal= da rgyug= nyi ma byang phyogs pha gi na/ /yul yang g.yu yi yul la byas/ /mkhar yang g.yu yi mkhar la byas/ /mi yang g.yu yi mi la byas/ /smra re mkhas la ngag re 'jam/ /g.yu yi rta chung rgo ba tsam/ /'gro re mkhas la bang re mgyogs/ /lha 'dre'i= sbyin pa'i= khyim= 'dre gdon= de phyir dpon= rta bshong = mdzo bshong = da rgyug= phrag dog rgyal po'i sde la 'bul/ /nad gtong ma mo'i sde= 'dod g.yeng lha yi= gti mug klu'i= sred len gnod sbyin= nga rgyal btsan gyi= btsun pa rmu yi= drang srong gza' yi=

ser sna yi dwags= sha yi glud 'di sa la gtong*/ /sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre kun/ /glud chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rgyu sbyor yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /gnod dang 'tshe ba ma byed cig khrag gi glud 'di chu la gtong*/ /chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre kun/ /glud chen gtor ma= rgyu sbyor= gnod dang = drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong*/ /me la gnas pa'i lha= glud chen= rgyu sbyor= gnod dang = dbugs kyi glud 'di rlung la gtong*/ /rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre kun/ / glud chen= rgyu sbyor= gnod dang = sems kyi glud 'di mkha' la gtong*/ /mkha' la gnas pa'i lha 'dre kun/ /glud chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod dang 'tshe ba ma byed cig / ces yul bstan no/ /kha 'bar ma'i glud rabs/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad par grags kyang*/ 'di 'dra'i rigs bon la rnying ma pas 'dra dpe blangs/ de gsar lugs la sbyar ba yin kyang*/ bod kyi sde brgyad mgu bar byed pas skyon med do//bskul ni/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ byams mgon thugs rje shākya thub pa yis/ /sras kyi thu bo par bu'i nang du sbas/ /gdung bas blang nas srog gi snying po phul/ /bka' gnyan kha 'bar chen mo las la bh+yoḥ sku mdog sngo nag du ba'i mdog 'dra la//bzhin 'dzum mi sdug khro gnyer mdzod spur bsdus/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /'jigs byed kha 'bar chen mo= sku mdog dmar mo bye ru'i mdog 'dra zhing*/ /bzhin 'dzum mi sdug khro gnyer= nad dang gnod dang dgra bgegs brlag par byed/ /brlag byed kha= kha nas me 'bar rgya mtsho gting nas skems/ /mig nas thog 'dzag ri rab thal par rlog/ skad cig tsam la khams gsum dbang du bsdud/ /gyad mo kha 'bar chen mo las la bh+yoḥ dbu skra ral pa khams nag brdzus pa yis/ /'jig rten lha chen brgyad rnams 'dar bar byed/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bgrad nas bzhugs pa yis/

/'jig rten klu chen brgyad rnams zil gyis gnon/ /zhal nas rngam pa'i nga ro sgrogs pa yis/ /gdon chen bco brgyad tshogs rnams 'bar bar byed/ / bdud dang 'dre rnams skad ngan tse re re/ /stobs chen kha 'bar chen= shangs nas yam dang nad kyi du ba 'thul/ /sbar khyim sdang nas dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod/ /za byed mche ba drag tu gtsigs pa yis/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs srog rtsa myur du gcod/ /srog gcod kha 'bar chen mo las la bh+yoḥ hūṃ bh+yoḥ bka' nyan pho nya lnga brgya las la bh+yoḥ legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma/ /dam tshig can la mthu dang sdong grogs mdzod/ /chos skyong kha 'bar= hūṃ bh+yoḥ gtsang rigs dpal mgon rnams kyi ded dpon mdzad/ /smon lam dbang gis sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung*/ /'phrin las dbang gis sgrub la dngos grub ster// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod yon lnga/ /bzhes nas kha 'bar= hūṃ bh+yoḥ bka' yi gtor ma rgya chen 'di bsnom las/ /'dren pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di/ / phyogs dus kun du dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ khams gsum sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /bla med byang chub thob pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung spel dang*/ /gtsug lag 'khor bzhi chos byed skyong bar chad/ /da dung sangs rgyas bstan pa ma nub pas/ /sngon gyi dam bcas khas blangs ma 'dor cig / rnal 'byor zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /las kyi 'bras bu myur du grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ bh+yoḥ bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /yas kyi bdud g.yos thams cad bzlog /mas kyi sri langs thams cad bzlog /pha rol rbod gtong = dam sri'i bar chad thams cad= rmi lam ngan pa thams cad= mtshan ma rtsub pa thams cad= ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi= bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu= nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi= gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu=

ye 'phrog sum brgya drug cu= dus min 'chi ba rnam dgu= drang srong dmod ngan 'dor ba= phur pa'i dbal khra 'phen pa= yungs kar thun zor 'phen pa= skyes pa'i mda' zor 'phen pa= bud med dmod zor 'phen pa= the'u rang tshe la rku ba= mu stegs bar chad byed pa= nad kha rims kha dal kha= snga dgra dar ba thams cad= phyi dgra sems pa thams cad= bdud kyi tho ngan byed pa= btsan gyi rta dre la 'khrab pa= klu'i byad du bcug pa= lo skeg zla skeg zhag skeg= chags che nyams nga thams cad= mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad= bzlog go bsgyur ro dgra la bsgyur/ / log 'dren bdud dang bar chad dang*/ /ltas ngan dgra bgegs bar chad rnams// 'di yis bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams sgrubs/ / mchod pa rnams dang zan dang ar+gha'i lhag ma thams cad snod der blugs la/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur cig / ces bden stobs lan gsum brjod de/ khyad par du klu'i nad sel na/ klu'i sman sna tshogs dang ba'i 'o ma gung du bshams la/ 'bras yos dang yos mar sbyar ba blug go /gzhan bgegs gang gnod kyang snga ma'i chog go /de nas slob dpon gyis 'khor rnams la bsrung ba byas/ gtor ma phyi la gtong bar bya ste/ de'ang gtor ma'i sngon du dung la sogs pa'i sgra 'gro/ gtor ma khyer ba dang bum chog pas g.yas ngos nas rang gi khro bo'i sngags drag tu bzlos shing*/ bum pa'i chu sgreng zhing 'gro'o/ / slob dpon gyis phyis nas rdo rje gsor zhing*/ dril bu sil zhing*/ na ma tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces sngags bzlas shing*/ rkang pa khro bo'i 'gros kyis 'gro bar bya'o/

/de nas gnod pa'i bgegs yod pa'i sa'am/ dgra'i yul mthong ba'i sar sleb pa dang*/ bum chus chos 'byung bris pa'i steng du gtor ma bzhag ste/ slob dpon gyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi= lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams kyi= theg pa gsum la gnas pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi= de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ /rdo rje dang*/ /rin po che dang*/ / pad+ma dang*/ /las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= snying po dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= don dam chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnam 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ /rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= khyad par du yang rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs dang ldan pa mthu stobs kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams kyi= las byed 'jig rten pho nya drag po'i mthu rtsal nus pa can rnams kyi= bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi= zhes spyir smos nas/ dgra yin na/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra/ dam pa'i chos kyi smod dgra/ dge 'dun tshogs kyi sdang dgra/ skye 'gro sems can yongs la 'tshe ba rnams dang*/ khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed cing*/

bsam sbyor phyin ci log byed pa'i byad ma 'di zhes sam/ snga dgra lag tu khyer ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da lta dngos su sbyor ba'i las ngan gyi dgra bo bsam pa ngan pa sbyor ba rtsub pa phod 'dzugs pa/ do bsdo ba 'di rnams kyi pho lha/ dgra lha/ zhang lha/ yul lha/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha/ srog gi lha/ bsrung skyobs rgyud bskul ba'i 'jig rten 'das ma 'das gang yin yang rung*/ mtho srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ dma' dmyal khams yan chod/ bar stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gang na gnas pa thams cad nyon cig /ces pa dang*/ nad yam sogs bgegs yin na/ bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod rnams kyi gnas lus longs spyod 'khor tshogs dang*/ chos spyod dang*/ dpal 'byor bde skyid la gnod par byed pa dang*/ bstan pa dang 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs/ lha klu gnod sbyin/ lha ma yin/ rgyal 'gong bdud/ btsan/ ma mo dal yams kyi bdag mo la sogs pa/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi rigs gang yin yang rung*/ zhes 'don pa spo/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di dang*/ bzlog glud phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang dbang po drug dang*/ yan lag nying lag don snying thams cad tshang zhing*/ gos rgyan sna tshogs dang bcas pa 'dis tshim par gyis la/ khyed rnams gnod cing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor nye bar zhi nas rang gi gnas su 'gro bar gyis shig

/gang dag bsam sbyor ngan pa de dag mi gtong na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje rab tu 'bar bas mgo bor bsnun zhing bskal pa'i mes tshig par gyur cig / bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod rnams kyi lus la gnod pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu/ nad yams dal kha thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig /sngon kyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa 'khon grib ltas ngan byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig /pha rol kyi mthu dang byad kha mnan gtad 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i rbod gtong thams cad phyir= des bzlas pa'i sngags dang byad kha rbad 'dre thams cad de nyid la bzlog par= rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ lo skeg zla skeg zhag skeg za ma'i skeg chags che nyams nga ba bkra mi shis pa thams cad phyir= gzhan yang sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs gza' dang rgyu skar/ dmu dang bdud/ btsan dang gshin rje/ klu gnyan sa bdag /rgyal 'gong the rang*/ dam sri sen mo'i rigs kyi gnod pa thams cad phyir= mdor na bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi nyon mongs bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig /med par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /mi 'byung bar gyur cig /dkon mchog bslu ba med pa dang*/ /chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog pa dang*/ / bsrung skyobs mthu dang ldan gyur cig /oṃ sarba duṣ+tan pra t+yaṅgi ra phaṭa/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/ zhes gtor ma drag tu 'phangs/ lhag ma ma lus par bya/ gtor ma kha phub ba la rdog pa g.yon pas mnan stangs tsam bya/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā na ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā daṃṣ+toṭa ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/

a si mu sa la/ ba ra shu pa hastā ya/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi spo ṭa ya bi spo ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nān/ bi nā ya kā na/ mahā ga na pa ti/ dzi wi ta/ an+ta ka ra ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzlas so/ /dgra la byed na/ mkhar ngos la rgyag /klu'i gnod pa bzlog na/ chu bor skyal lo/ /de nas kun gyi phyi mig mi blta bar slob dpon gyis rting mnan te/ bsrung ba'i sngags bzlos shing log la/ gong gi bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa phyung la mchod bstod bsdus pa byed/ ma phyung par rnal 'byor bla med ltar byed na/ rang nyid la mchod bstod byas la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya ba ci rigs bzlas nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ / zhes sogs bzod gsol dang*/ ye shes pa phyung na/ badz+ra muḥ nam mkha'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag/rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas/ / sogs dang*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs dang*/ zhi ba chags bral sogs/ / tshogs kyi dam pa sogs bkra shis bya'o// dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /phan yon ni nges par 'chi ba bslu ba dang*/ gzhan gyi rbod gtong phyir bzlog pa dang*/ gdug pa'i klu'i gnod pa sel ba dang*/ rims nad la sogs pa bsrung bar nus pa dang*/ sdang ba'i dgra brlag par byed pa la sogs pa phan yon dpag tu med kyang*/ 'dir gtso bor rang gi gnod pa bsrung zhing*/ gzhan gyi gnod pa bzlog pa yin no/ /de ltar gtor ma'i cho ga gsal bar byas pa yis/ /dge ba 'di yis 'di byed skye bo ma lus rnams/ /gdug pa'i gdon las rnam grol tshe ring nad med dang*/ /bde ba phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu myur 'byin shog

/ don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis nan gyis bskul ba la brten/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen gyi cho ga ba ri ba'i man ngag /slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos sbyar bar grags pa la yig nor dang lhad du mngon pa tsho spangs/ cung zad kha bskongs byas pa ni kun dga' snying pos yin no// // maṅga la ཾ// gcig zhus dag/ ༄༅/ /ja mchod bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas dang rigs kun khyab bdag bzhugs/ so/ / oṃ swā sti/ ja mchod bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rnam dag yid 'ong bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ /tha mal 'khrul ba'i snang ba rab sbyangs shing*/ /ye shes chen po'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas rgya cher spel/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'di ni yid la bsams pas kyang 'grub bo/ / rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas par/ /lha rdzas mchod pa dpag med sprul// tshad med mchod sprin gsang sngags dang*/ /yid sprul smon lam stobs las byung*/ /bdag pos yongs su ma bzung dang*/ /bdag gzhan longs spyod thams cad kyang*/ /mtshan 'dzin dri ma kun spangs nas/ /zhing kun gang bar byas te 'bul/ /kun bzang rnam 'phrul rjes 'gro ba/ kha dog dṛ ro reg bya'i mchog / spros bral zung 'jug bde ba'i ro/ /ye shes mchod yon bla na med/ khyab bdag rje btsun chos kyi rje/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar mchod pa 'bul/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*/ /mchod 'os rgya mtshor bzhes su gsol/ /mchod bya mchod byed ma dmigs kyang*/ /gnyis med ye shes rang snang du/ /zag med bde chen 'phel ba dang*/ /tshogs gnyis 'byor ba'i gtso bor shog / ces pa'ang rang gi slob ma grags pa bzang pos bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes drug la ding ri glang bskor du'o/ /dge legs 'phel// na mo gu ru/ rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /'khor lo sdom pa 'bar ba'i gtso/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/

/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /spyod pa'i rdo rje bha hu la/ /rong zom lots+tsha 'bam rong pa/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /a wa dhū tī zhang ston rje/ /gnyos chen saṅgha bha dra'i zhabs/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /'jam dbyangs chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ /grub pa'i dpa' po sa skyong mtshan/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /srid zhi'i dpal gyur 'gro ba'i mgon/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /'jam mgon kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud bla mar mchod pa 'bul/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho la'ang*/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// // maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /bsangs mchod bzhugs so/ / oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ hūṃ las byung ba'i bsangs mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma 'khor bcas dang*/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /nyan thos rang rgyal 'phags tshogs bcas/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*/ /sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes shig khyad par yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i/ /gzhi bdag mthu chen 'di zhes pa/ /'khor bcas rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /gzhan yang gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang*/ /grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang*/ /glo bur lhags pa thams cad kyang*/ /bsangs mchod 'di yis tshim par shog

/dngos bshams 'di la brten nas kyang*/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi byin brlabs dang*// chos nyid bden pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar shog /mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra/ /dri zhim bdud rtsi'i ro mchog brgya/ /sna tshogs reg bya'i bde mchog brgya/ khang bzang yul 'khor skyed mos tshal/ /sna tshogs zas dang sna tshogs gos/ /g.yog 'khor rnam pa mang po dang*// bang mdzod nor dang 'bru la sogs/ /rkang 'gro nor dang grogs la sogs/ / srid zhi'i mgron po khyed rnams la/ /gang la gang 'dod longs spyod ni/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar/ /mkho dgu thams cad 'byung bar shog /gnod pa thams cad zhi gyur cig /nyams pa thams cad gsos gyur cig /mthu stobs gzi brjid rgyas gyur cig /bde skyid thams cad 'phel gyur cig /mi gtsang grib sogs dag gyur cig /'khon dang 'khrug pa zhi bar shog /mdor na dpal 'byor gong 'phel bas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /mi mthun bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dang*/ /dbang thang yar ngo bzhin du 'phel/ /log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ khyad par dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang*//yul phyogs bde skyid 'phel ba dang*/ /chos grwa dge 'dun longs spyod sogs/ /rtag tu 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gnod pa thams cad sel ba dang*/ /lo tog la sogs phun sum tshogs/ /nad med bde ba'i gdong grogs mdzod/ /yid la bsam pa'i don kun 'grub pa dang*/ /srid gsum phan dang bde ba'i dpal 'bar zhing*/ /mi mthun rkyen kun dbyings su zhi ba dang*/ /chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /zhus dag/maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /seng gdong ma'i bzlog pa bzhugs so/

/ oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i dbyings su hūṃ las bsrung 'khor nang*/ /e las chos 'byung pad nyi dbugs bral steng*/ hūṃ las rang nyid khams gsum khyab pa'i sku/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mi mthun phyogs kun 'joms/ /sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /seng gdong mkha' 'gro'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor tshogs rnal 'byor ma ni bye bas bskor/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes sku gsung thugs rje rje/ /mi bskyod dbu rgyan dam ye dbyer med 'dres/ / mchod pa'i sprin dang bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos khyab/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥ raḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces nyer gcig sogs bzlas la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong ba can la 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyis bskor ba dang bcas pa rnams kyi= bden pa chen pos byis gyis brlabs kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad dang*/ nad rims dang*/ yams dang*/ sde brgyad 'byung po'i gnod pa dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ lo skeg /zla skeg zhag skeg /chags che nyams nga*/ /byad kha rbod gtong la sogs pa mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ / lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// // zhes pa 'di'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/

/gcig zhus// ༄༅/ /bar do'i ngo sprod mdo tsam brjod pa bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru/ bar do'i ngo sprod mdo tsam ni/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ 'jig rten pha rol du dus las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba nyon cig /spyir skyes pa'i tha ma ni 'chi/ 'dus pa'i tha ma ni 'bral/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin zhing*/ khyad par du 'di zhes bya ba khyod kyang*/ sngon gyi las zad pa'am 'phral gyi rkyen drag po la brten nas mdang zhag tshe'i dus byas te/ mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid bstan/ da lta srid pa bar do na yod tshod du gda'/ de la gdams pa zab mo'i gnad nas bzung ste/ cho ga dang ngo sprod ma tshar gyi bar du/ rig pa sems kyi rang so bzung*/ ming byang bris ma dang bcas pa 'di la rten bcas te/ lhan ne bag phab la legs par nyan 'tshal/ de yang bar do la bar dor shes pa gal che/ bar dor ngo shes nas kyang dge ba la 'dun pa bsgyur ba gal che/ 'dun pa de yang gnas lugs ngang : mu [ du ] 'byor ba gal che'o/ /'dir bar do'i gdams ngag bstan pa la/ bar do'i mtshan nyid/ bar do'i rtags/ bar do'i snang ba/ der gdams ngag ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul/ de las gnas lugs ngo 'phros nas grol ba'i tshul te lnga'o/ /dang po bar do'i mtshan nyid ni/ chos mngon pa mdzod las/ sngon dus srid 'byung sha tshugs can/ /de ni 'chi ba'i sngon rol te/ /skye ba'i skad cig phan chad do/ /rigs mthun lha mig dag pas mthong*/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu/ /mi ldog de ni dri za'o/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ 'dir sngon zhes bya ba/ sngar byung zin la mi zer/ rgya skad du purba zhes bya ba sngon dang shar dang mdun gsum la 'jug pa las/ 'dir lo tsā bas sngon zhes par bsgyur yang*/ don la mdun yin pas da phyin chad yong rgyu'i don yin la/ de yang gnas skabs gzhan du bar ma chod par 'phral du 'byung rgyu la zer ba yin no/
