/de la lus kyi rnam pa dbyibs kyi khyad par ni/ gang du skye ba len par 'gyur ba'i gzugs de 'dra ba ste/ mir skye na bar do yang mi'i gzugs dang*/ dud 'gror skye na bar do yang dud 'gro'i gzugs su 'byung ba sogs yin te/ 'on kyang skye ba snga ma'i bag chags kyis skye ba snga ma gang du skyes pa de'i gzugs su yod snyam pa dang*/ de dus kyi 'gro ba de ka yin pa'i rlom sems bar do rang la 'byung srid de 'khrul ba yin/ dus kyi khyad par ni/ 'chi srid ces bya ba dran med brgyal ba lta bu zhig yod pa la/ de sangs nas 'gro ba rigs drug tu skye ba ma blangs kyi bar der yin/ lus kyi khyad par ni/ 'byung lus rags pa med/ shin tu phra shing dwangs pa'i 'byung ba la brten pa yin pas/ 'dzam bu gling du skye 'gyur gyi bar do gcig gis 'dzam bu gling du skye bar 'gyur ba'i bar do gzhan mthong*/ ba lang spyod dang gling gzhan du skye bar 'gyur ba'i bar do mi mthong*/ des mtshon nas gzhan thams cad la yang 'dra ste/ gnas dang rigs mthun pa'i bar do nang phan tshun gyis mthong*/ gnas rigs mi mthun pa'i bar do dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can mngon shes ma thob pa rnams kyis mi mthong*/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes skyon bcu gcig dang bral bas mthong la/ de las gzhan pa'i mngon shes yod kyang mi mthong ngo*/ /shugs kyi khyad par ni/ las kyi rdzu 'phrul dang ldan zhes bya ste/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul med kyang*/ rdzu 'phrul yid mgyogs dang 'dra bar gang bsam pa'i gnas der skad cig gis phyin par nus pa'o/ /dbang po'i khyad par ni/ las dang mthun pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mtha' dag gsal bar mthong nus pas/ dbang po drug po kun tshang bar nus pa yin la/ gang du skye ba len par 'gyur ba'i lus de dbang po ma tshang ba 'byung

ba zhig yod kyang*/ bar do ni dbang po drug rtag tu tshang ba yin pas sha tshugs tsam dbyibs 'dra ba yin gyi/ dbang po tshang ma tshang gi sgo nas mi 'dra la/ 'on kyang sha'i srin bu sogs su skye ba na/ de'i bar do la de dang gzugs dbyibs 'dra ba'i phyir/ mig khra 'bur ba dang*/ rna ba krong por med kyi/ gzugs rnams mthong ba dang*/ sgra rnams thos pa'i dbang po 'byung lus yod pas de kho na mig dang rna ba'i dbang po yin no/ /rag pa'i khyad par ni/ gang du skye ba len par 'gyur ba'i skye gnas ma gtogs/ ri ra ba sogs thogs bcas kyi dngos po gang la yang thogs pa med par 'jug ste shin tu dwangs ba'i lus yin pas so// zas kyi khyad par ni/ dri za ba ste dri tshor bas tshim pa dang*/ tshe rgyas pa dang 'tsho bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /cho ga ji lta bas byin gyis brlabs shing bsngos pa'i mchod pa rnams kyang thob pa ni/ mdo nas ma bshad kyang sngags kyi che ba yin no/ /rten mi 'gyur ba'i khyad par ni/ mi ldog pa ste/ de yang spyir btang la/ dmyal ba'i bar do grub nas dmyal bar skye ste/ dmyal ba'i bar do'i mi'i bar dor bsgyur ba'am ldog tu med/ lha'i bar do grub na lha kho nar skye ste/ dmyal ba la sogs par bsgyur ldog med pa'i don yin la/ yang dmigs bsal la ci ste na ldog go zhes gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa'i nus mthu dang*/ thugs rje'i byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pas sngags dang cho ga la sogs pa'i nus mthu dpag tu med par dge bas ngan song gi bar do grub zin pa yang*/ dge ba de dag gi phan yon las/ lha'i bar dor 'gyur ba sogs ni yod do/ /gzhan yang tshe'i khyad par ni/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma gcig nas zhag bdun gyi bar ring thung ma nges par yod cing*/ de las lhag pa med par bshad/ zhag bdun lon nas kyang skye ba'i tshogs pa ma rnyed na/ bar do'i lus snga ma'i tshe zad de shi nas/

yang bar do'i lus phyi ma zhig 'grub/ tshul de lta bus bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du skye srid kyi tshogs pa ma rnyed pa yang srid/ de nas nges par rnyed pas de bas lhag pa med par grags te shas che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bar do'i rtags ni/ 'gro ba'i lam bzhi/ ya nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum/ nges pa'i rtags drug /ma nges pa'i rtags drug /'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi la sogs pa yin te/ gang du phyin pa'i gnas thams cad du 'od dkar po'i lam byung na/ lha dang lha min du skye/ nag po'i lam byung na dmyal bar/ dmar po'i lam byung na yi dwags/ ser po'i lam gyi mi dang*/ dud 'gro la sogs par 'jug pa yin no/ /de bzhin du 'dod chags kyi las shas che bas g.yang sa chen po dmar zang ngai ba dang*/ gti mug gi las shas che bas g.yang sa skya chad de ba dang*/ zhe sdang gi las shas che bas g.yang sa nag ngam pa mthong ste/ ngan song gsum du lhung bar 'gyur ba'i ltas yin/ sgra bzhi ni sngar gson po'i dus su 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung ma mchings shing*/ rlung dang rnam rtog tha mal par shor bas de'i bag chags kyi mthu las/ bar do'i skabs 'dir 'byung ba phra mo'i sa khams log pas ri zhig pa lta bu'i sgra dang*/ chu log pas rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa lta bu'i sgra dang*/ me log pas nags tshal mes bsregs pa lta bu'i sgra dang*/ rlung log pas yul thams cad g.yo ba dang lhan cig tu 'brug sgra lta bu'i sgra 'byung*/ sgra de dag la brten nas 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa skye ba'o/ /nges pa'i rtags rnams ni/ sngar rtsig pa sogs la thogs pa las da gang la yang thogs rgyu med/ sngar gtam smras pa mi gzhan gyis thos pa las da lta mi thos/ sngar nyi zla gza' skar mig gis mthong ba las da lta mi mthong*/ sngar rkang rjes sogs 'byung ba las da lta rjes mi 'byung*/ sngar lus la grib ma 'byung ba las da lta mi 'byung*/ sngar mngon shes med pa las da lta mngon shes phra mo khre'u rigs su 'char/

de yang khyed bar do na yod pa'i rtags yin/ nyi zla mi mthong bar snang min mun min du 'char ba 'di nang na khams dkar dmar med pas yin/ gzhan rnams thogs bcas kyi lus med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi yin no/ /ma nges pa drug ni/ gnas la nges pa med/ zas la nges pa med/ gos la nges pa med/ grogs la nges pa med/ spyod lam la nges pa med/ sems kyi 'char tshul la nges pa med de/ 'phral nas 'phral du 'gyur zhing 'gro ba dang*/ bya spu rlung gis bskyod pa ltar chod chod pa yod do/ /gzhan yang gcan gzan ma rungs pas bdas pa dang*/ las kyi rde'u dkar nag 'grems pa dang*/ kha char bu yug la sogs pas bdas nas skyabs 'tshol ba dang*/ gshin rje'i skyes bus 'khrid pa la sogs pa phal cher 'jigs skrag gi snang ba shas che ba'i 'khrul snang brjod kyi mi lang ba zhig yong ste/ skye ba snga ma ni shi phyi ma ma longs pa'i da lta bar do na yod par 'dug / gdams pas gnad nas bzung ste/ skabs 'dir grol ba zhig byed dgos snyam pas dran pa rgyun chags su sten cig/gsum pa bar do'i snang ba ni/ khyed la da lta rnam pa ma nges pa 'char ba de thams cad rang gi sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba las byung ba yin gyi/ phyi rol na don logs su grub pa med pas gzugs mdzes pa dang sgra snyan pa dang dri zhim pa dang ro mngar ba dang reg bya bde bar snang ba thams cad 'khrul ba yin pas ma chags shig /gzugs mi sdug pa dang sgra mi snyan pa sogs kyang sems kyi 'khrul snang yin pas yid la mi bde ba mi bya/ de bzhin du dgra gnyen du snang ba yang 'khrul snang yin pas dgrar snang ba la zhe sdang ma byed/ gnyen du snang ba la chags sems ma byed/ tsha grang du snang ba yang 'khrul pa kho na yin pas/ tsha ba'i snang ba shar kyang 'jigs skrag ma byed/ grang ba la chags pa dang 'dun pa byed mi nyan/ grang ba'i snang ba shar kyang de la 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal ma byed/ dro ba la smon pa dang chags su mi rung*/

rang bud med kyi snang bar shar te skyes pa la chags pa dang*/ bud med la sdang ba'i sems ma byed/ de bzhin du rang skyes pa'i snang bar shar na/ bud med la chags pa dang skyes pa gzhan la sdang ba'i sems ma byed/ chags sdang gi sems byas na mngal skyes su 'jug /bar do'i gnas skabs kyi skyes pa dang bud med du snang ba yang rang gi sems snang tsam yin gyi/ don la grub pa med pas chags sdang byed par 'khrul lo/ /sa phyogs dang yul phyogs dga' dga' ltar snang ba mthong byung na'ang 'khrul pa yin snyam gyis la dga' bar ma byed cig /dri ma mnams pas zhim snyam pa tshor yang med bzhin du snang ba yin pas chags par ma byed cig /gshed ma dang gcan gzan la sogs pa srog chags 'jigs su rung ba mthong yang*/ med bzhin du snang ba 'khrul pa yin par shes par gyis la 'jigs skrag ma byed/ de thams cad la rang gi rig pa so zin par dran pas bzung zhig /gzhan yang khyed rang chags sdang dang sdig pa'i snang ba byas na/ sngar gyi las ngan pa gsos thebs te ngan song gsum du skye bar the tshom med/ dad pa dang snying rje la sogs pa dge ba'i sems bskyed na/ sngar gyi dge ba rnams gsos thebs nas rab tu da lta grol bar 'gyur zhing*/ tha ma yang mtho ris su 'gro bar the tshom med do/ /des na khyed rang rdzas dang yo byad nye du sogs gang la yang ma chags pa ser sna'i blo ma byed/ 'di rnams la chags zhen byas kyang bral zin pa yin pas/ da 'grogs pa'i skal ba med/ chags na 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin pas blo thag chod cig /gzhan yang khyed la shul na yod pa rnams kyis dkon mchog la mchod pa/ skye bo la sbyin gtong*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa/ dge 'dun la zhabs tog /gzhan yang phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ smon lam 'debs pa/ sdig pa bshags pa/ cho ga byed pa sogs 'di ltar byed pa yin pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs po che 'dis khyed la phan 'dogs chen por 'gyur bas sdug bsngal mi 'tshal lo/

/bzhi pa gdams ngag ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ dang po nyid du bar do dngos yin snyam du shes pas gnas skabs 'dir ma 'khrul ba zhig byed dgos/ khyad par du yang skyabs gnas dang re sa gzhan med pas rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa che ge mo zhes bya ba de/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus su shes par gyis la mos gus dung dung bas gsol ba thob cig /gzugs su snang tshad bla ma'i sku/ sgra grag tshad bla ma'i gsung*/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad bla ma'i thugs kyi byin brlabs yin snyam pa'i sgo nas mos gus dang ma bral bar mdzod/ yang de bzhin du gnas skabs 'di bar do yin pas/ dag pa'i snang bar bsgyur dgos snyam pa gyis la/ khyed rang gi lus 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lta bu yi dam gyi sku gsal dwangs rnyog pa med pa 'ja' tshon lta bu dang*/ gzugs su snang tshad yi dam gyi sku/ sgra grag tshad gsang sngags kyi sgra/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig yin pas/ 'khor ba'i longs spyod cis kyang dgos pa med snyam pa dang*/ 'khor ba ni las las byung*/ las ni nyon mongs las byung*/ nyon mongs ma zad na 'khor ba mi zad/ nyon mongs spangs na 'khor pa las rang grol ba yin/ sngar yang nyon mongs 'dis 'khor bar 'khyams/ da yang 'di'i dbang du song na sdug bsngal la zad pa med snyam pa'i skyo shas nges 'byung dang*/ sems can thams cad la byams snying rje dung ba dang*/ las sdig pa las sdug bsngal dang*/ dge ba las bde ba 'byung ba la yid ches dung ba dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te dkon mchog rnams la blos ling gis khol zhigagazhan yang mngal sgo 'gegs pa zhes bya bar dgos pa yin te/ 'gro ba rigs drug pho mo thams cad la tha mal gyi snang ba mi byed par yi dam yab yum du sgom pa bskyed rim gyi mngal sgo 'gegs pa yin/

pho mo dang chags spyod kyi snang ba gang mthong yang gang shar de nyid sgyu ma lta bur shes nas dbyings su spros bral la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ 'od gsal gyi sgo nas mngal sgo 'gegs pa dang*/ mngal du skye ba len pa dang*/ 'dod chags kyi nyes dmigs shes/ tshangs par spyod pa'i phan yon mthong nas/ sems 'dod sred kyi dbang du mi gtong pa ni tshangs spyod kyi sgo nas mngal sgo 'gegs pa zhes bya ste/ gzhan yang tshe 'das kyi gang zag de gsang sngags nang gi nyams myong cung zad yod pa yin no/ /bskyed rim gyi skabs dbang len pa dang*/ 'od gsal gyi skabs rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs ngo sprod pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyi skabs nang 'dzag med kyi tshul khrims sogs tshul khrims la brten nas ngo sprad par bya'o/ /lnga pa gnas lugs ngo 'phrod nas grol ba'i tshul ni/ sngar gsang sngags nang gi ngo sprod gsum po des ngo 'phrod na logs su mi dgos kyang*/ dkyus ltar na'ang skad ces bya ste/ khyed rang la dgra'am gnyen dang 'phrad pa de na/ bde ba'am sdug bsngal du snang ba sna tshogs pa zhig snang ba de thams cad rang gi sems kyi bag chags 'khrul ba'i snang ba ma gtogs phyi rol na don logs su grub pa med/ sems la dga' sdug mtho dman chags sdang sna tshogs pa shar ba de yang rig pa phyir bltas su shar tsa na/ bde sdug gi snang ba sna tshogs bskyed pa dngos gnas la grub pa 'dra ba zhig byung yang rmi lam gyi dgras ded pa dang*/ sgyu ma'i chus khyer ba ltar 'khrul pa la 'khrul pa bsnan pa yin pas snang ba'i dus nyid nas yod ma myong pa yin/ gang shar ba de'i ngo bo la bltas pas rang bzhin med par shes tsa na/ chags sdang la sogs pa'i sems de yang ngos gzung med pa/ 'ja' tshon gyi rjes bdas pa lta bur 'dug /de la brten pa'i dga' mi dga' bde sdug thams cad kyang rang bzhin shes tsa na snang ba'i dus nyid nas rang grol ba/

bya lam rjes med dam chu la ri mo bris pa ltar shes pas chags sdang rang sar grol nas/ gnas lugs spros pa thams cad dang bral ba mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /gzhan yang khyed la kha dog lnga'i 'od zer sogs sna tshogs snang ba 'di legs par brtags na/ rang gi sems ye shes lnga'i rang snang yin pas rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o// sgra'i bye brag sna tshogs tshor ba 'di yang chos nyid don gyi rang sgra gzhom du med pa'i nā da brjod bral gyi dbyangs zhes bya ba de yin/ gzhan yang 'jigs skrag dga' sdug sna tshogs shar ba'i dus kyi ngos gzung thams cad dang bral ba'i sems gsal la rig pa ma 'gags pa ste/ chos dbyings brjod bral stong nyid thugs rje'i ye shes yin la/ chags thogs sred pa'i rang bzhin de la rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib spangs te bzhag pa na/ sems kyi re ba de snang du shar ba de ni lhan cig skyes pa 'gyur med bde ba'i rang zhal yin pas/ de rnams la rtsol bcas kyi spros pa spangs te mnyam par gzhog cig /gnas skabs bzhi'i bag chags rang sar dag nas rdo rje'i bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar don dam dbyings la mnyam par 'jog mi nus na yang mos pas bsgoms la/ 'di bcom ldan 'das 'di zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor du mngon gsum du 'jug pa yin la/ bdag gis kyang cho ga'i bya ba rgyud sde bzhi nas mngon par bsgrubs pa yin pas/ sems can thams cad la snying rje bskyed/ bla ma dkon mchog la mos gus bsgoms nas cho ga byas pa'i don rnams ma nor bar yid la gyis shig /ces brda sbyar la rang rang gi cho ga la 'jug go /dmigs yul bsgrub bya de gson pa'i dus su gsang sngags bla med kyi dbang sogs ma thob na/ 'od zer lnga ngo sprod pa man chad rdo rje bzhi'i ngo sprod rnams ma byas kyang chog go /de ltar bshad pa de rnams kyi tshig don gyi rkang rnams blo la nges par byas nas rgyas par yongs su rdzogs pa 'di bshad par bya la/

mdor bsdus kyi tshe ci rigs pa blangs te bshad do/ / zhes pa 'di yang don gnyer 'gas bskul ba'i ngor tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /zhus dag/maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /gsol 'debs dang brtan bzhugs sna tshogs kyi skor/ ༈ dpal ldan khyab bdag 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku/ /gzhom med sgra dbyangs brjod bral rdo rje'i gsung*/ /bde chen zung 'jug mnyam nyid rdo rje'i thugs/ / lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel// ༈ oṃ swā sti/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi mgon po grub brnyes gtso/ /dga' bzhi'i rol ldan spyod pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i snying po 'khor lo sdom/ /dbyer med sku bzhi'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro kun rab dga'i sa la 'god mdzad pa/ /stong nyid snying rje'i dbang phyug chos kyi rje/ /rigs kun bdag po'i dbang bsgyur skyes rabs 'phreng*/ /bcu gcig rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun ji bzhin gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa can/ /lhan cig skyes dga' snying po mngon gyur pa/ /sa steng 'gran zla bral ba sprul pa'i sku// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun nas dga' dang gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /snying po mchog gi byang chub ma thob bar/ /thugs rjes chen pos 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /

zhes pa 'di yang ban dpon ā nan+dha dzi ta bha dras bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas nye bar sbyar ba ste/ dpal stag lung thang gi chos grwa'o/ /shu bha mastu sarba dza ga tam/ / ༈ bde chen zab gsal 'gyur ba med pa'i sku/ /yan lag drug cu 'gag med chos kyi gsung*/ /chos dbyings ye shes mkha' ltar khyab pa'i thugs/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor las/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i 'od brgya 'gyed mkhas pa/ /snying po'i don ston rje btsun bla ma la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bdag /byang chub sems kyis bdag gzhan mnyam nyid dgongs/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gtso/ /gang snang kun khyab bde ba chen por gzigs// lhun grub 'phrin las bzang po 'gro ba'i mgon/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen pas shes bya'i gnas kun gsal bar gzigs/ / brtse bas phan bde'i dga' ston rgya cher 'gyed/ /nus pas snying po'i bstan pa gsal mdzad pa/ /sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshan tsam dran pas bar chad thams cad sel/ /gsol ba btab nas dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung*/ /gus pas bsten na dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /bsam 'phel nor bu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal ma bcos gnyug ma'i gdangs/ /gang shar : rigs [ ris ] med dag pa'i 'khor lo can/ /bla ma mchog gi zhabs lung mngon brnyes pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ khyod la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ / mgon po khyod kyis rtag tu rjes 'dzin zhing*/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar/ khyod kyi bstan la bya ba byed par shog / ces pa 'di ni tā ra nā thas rang nyid kyis bstod pa sna tshogs pa dag mi 'thor bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/

slob ma rnams kyi spyi khyab kyi kha 'don du dmigs nas legs par sbyar pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel// ༈ dpal ldan chos kun dga' ba'i rtser son te/ /lhan skyes snying po'i ye shes mngon gyur pa/ /srid gsum dbang phyug bla ma chos kyi rje/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ khams gsum dam pa'i chos kyis 'khor lo bsgyur/ /sku gsum mngon gyur bla ma rin po che/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i mgon po gang*/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la bsten par shog /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan pa dang*/ /'jig rten bde zhing phun tshogs 'phel ba dang*/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob cing bla ma dang*/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par byin gyis brlobs/ / zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas ma drin can gyi bka' ltar bkod pa'o// maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ// oṃ swā sti/ srid zhi'i dpal yon du ma 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgya cher spel mdzad cing*/ /mos ldan gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs mkhas pa/ / sprul sku mchog gi sku tshe brtan par shog khyod nyid skye ba'i 'phreng ba rab bzung ste/ /phyogs 'dir gang 'tshams gdul bya 'dul ba la/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad 'phrin rmad byung ba/ /ston mkhas sprul sku'i sku tshe brtan par shog /de lta'i mdzad 'phrin rnam par dkar ba la/ /bar du gcod pa nam yang mi 'byung zhing*/ / ji ltar bzhed pa'i don rnams mtha' ru phyin/ /sku tshe mdzad 'phrin 'gro don mthar phyin shog / ces rje btsun dam pa'i brtan bzhugs smon lam/ badz+ra karma pa rje drung dbang phyug rdo rje shwa ras spa nams su sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis/ ༈ rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i dngos/ /rab dga' la sogs bcu gnyis sa yi bdag /ngo mtshar bkra shis bgrang yas spro ba'i sku// zhing 'dir bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan par shog / ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅/ / rje btsun dam pa kun dga' snying po'i brtan bzhugs

bzhugs so/ / oṃ swa stī pra dza bh+yaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs kyi gsang mdzod 'dzin/ / dpag yas 'gro ba'i mig gyur rin po che/ /ma lus shes bya'i gnas la mkhyen pa rgyas/ /rje btsun bla ma zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /'gro kun dga' ba'i dam chos snying po'i don/ /bkra shis rgyal mtshan lan brgyar sgreng ba'i dpal/ / 'phrin las bzang po 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog /dpal ldan bla ma zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /bde chen spyod pa'i rdo rje sprul pa'i sku/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i srog shing chos kyi rje/ /skyabs mchog dam pa kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ / bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan gyur cig / sho lo ka 'di gsum bstod yul rang nyid kyis mdzad/ ༈ dpal ldan rigs brgya'i cod pan mthon po la/ /zhabs zung bkra shis 'khor lo legs bkod nas/ /'gro la ya mtshan bgrang yas stsol bzhin du/ /mgon khyod srid mthar zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /rgyal ba kun gyi dga' ba'i rang gzugs can/ /chos kun snying po bkra shis rgyal ba'i dngos/ /dge mtshan dpal 'byor bzang po 'bras stsol ba/ /mgon khyod srid mthar zhabs pad brtan gyur cig / sho lo ka 'di gnyis bsam sdings nas rje byams pa'i mtshan can gyis phul// ༈ dkon mchog gsum dang drang srong bden pa'i bka'/ /bka' bsrungs dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs dang*/ /chos dbyings 'gyur med bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /sprul pa mchog gi zhabs pad brtan gyur cig/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtshos phul// ༈ rgyal ba'i lung bstan rnal 'byor spyod pa yi/ /rnam 'phrul rim bzhin 'jam mgon grub pa'i rje/ /zhing 'dir gdul byar dgongs pa tā ra'i mtshan//bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas bstan la kun dga' ba'i/ /snying po'i bstan pa phyogs bcu yi/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi dpal mgon du/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin gsol 'debs//

// sho lo ka gnyis po 'di rdo rje 'chang chen po lha dbang grags pas phul/ / ༈ dus rnams kun du nad med tshe ring zhing*/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi nas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs kun/ /'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub par shog / ces pa'ang bstod yul rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ /shu bha// // ༄༅/ /las dang po pa'i rim pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti pra dzā bh+yaḥ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma dang*/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus btud nas/ /las dang po la nyer mkho'i phyir/ /spyod pa'i rim pa cung zad bshad/ / de la dang po'i las can rnams kyis nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len gyi rim pa la gtso bor bslabs pas/ lus sems cung zad las su rung bar gyur pa na/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa thams cad la nan tan du byas pas/ khyad par mchog rnams thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de la nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi spyod pa ji lta bu zhe na/ rang gis ji ltar blangs pa'i bslab pa la nan tan snying por byed pa nyid gzhir byas te/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig las nam gyi cha smad la bab pa na gnyid dang rmugs pa dang le lo spangs te/ /lus gnad bcas yid ma yengs par sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang gtong ba dang tshul khrims dang lha rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas/ dad pa bskyed pa dang*/ tshe 'di dang 'khor ba la yid nges par 'byung ba dang*/ thar pa'i lam gyi ngo bo dang phan yon yid la byed pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems drag tu sgom zh-ing*/ man ngag thob na bsam gtan cung zad bya'o/ /de nas skya rengs dang po shar ba na/ phyag 'tshal ba sogs yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa rnams bya zhing*/ nyin mo'i dang po la/ phyag 'tshal ba'am/ mchod pa 'bul ba'am gtor ma gtong ba'am/ mdo sde klog pa'am/ mchod rten la bskor ba la sogs pa thun mtshams kyi sbyong ba ci 'grub cig byas nas/

kha zas kyi bya ba la 'jug ste/ phud dang lhag ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa ma chad par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su gtsang sbra dang ldan pas yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bzhin du/ klog pa'am/ chos nyan pa'am/ bsam gtan la sogs pa gang rung zhig bya'o/ /nyi ma phyi phred kyi dus na dub pa bsang ba'i don du chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis rab tu dga' bar byas nas/ sāts+tsha gdab pa la sogs pa thun mtshams kyi sbyong ba ci rigs pa la 'jug go /dgong mo'i thun la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang 'byung po rnams la gtor ma rgya cher byin la/ smon lam gyi khyad par mang du gdab par bya'o/ /nam gyi cha stod la bsam gtan nam/ gsung rab 'don pa'am/ de dag gi don sems dpa' la nan tan du bya zhing*/ gung thun la dge ba'i sems kyis nyal bar bya'o/ /tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu bzhi dang*/ bco lnga dang*/ gnam stong rnams la chos ston pa po yod na mtshan mo hril gyis chos ston pa nyan pa'am/ nam phyed la thug gi bar du chos nyan bshad bya'o/ /de lta bu ma 'byor na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la mchod pa bya ba'am/ gang yang rung ba'i chos spyod kyi rim pas dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /ci ste sngags kyi theg pa la zhugs pa zhig yin na/ thun bzhir bzlas brjod dang*/ gsang sngags kyi don sgom pa'i rim pa la nan tan du byed pa ni/ lhag por bsgrub bya'o/ /gnas skabs gzhan dang gzhan du yon bdag la sogs pa'i bsod nams spel ba'i slad du yang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa dang*/ phyag mchod bshags pa rnams rgyas par bya zhing*/ bar skabs der mdo 'don pa la sogs pa'i rim pa rnams byas nas/ mjug tu smon lam gdab pa dang*/ bkra shis brjod pa rnams bya'o/ /yang na yan lag bdun pa bsdus pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mdo dang gzungs 'don pa byas kyang rung ngo*/ /da ni de rnams kyi rim pa brjod par bya ste/

dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ / bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs la/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid la phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka'/ /skyes bu'i don sgrub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor ba ga la 'gyur/ /srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro/ /dus kyi bsnyen nas rgyal po 'gro 'gyur na/ /longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*/ /skyes bu dag ni gang dang gang 'gro ba/ /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*/ /sred srid ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams/ /mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam gsum po/ /'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor/ /dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin/ /srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar/ /'di na 'chi med rab 'bar mgon med de/ /srid las byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs/ /bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin/ / zhes brjod cing don bsam mo/ / dal 'byor 'di ni zhes sogs tshigs bcad 'di rnams tshogs su ma brjod kyang rung ngo*/ / bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/

chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la= zhes tshar gsum brjod nas skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor gang 'grub bya/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur ciganye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la mchog tu gzigs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ / dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur zhing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ / dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams sgrol ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/

/phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas/ /nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas/ / dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol/ /gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi/ /de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyis mun bcom nas/ /mig skyon med rnams rol par gnas pas steng du ni/ /lta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin rlabs pa/ / bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing*/ / bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la= gang gi 'byung po kun la thugs brtse bas/ /sngon chad ma thos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /skyob pa lha dang mi rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /srid pa mthar phyin de la= gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe/ /sa chen 'di las gom pa bdun bor nas/ /nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs/ /de tshe mkhas pa khyod la= rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba/ /mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la= gang tshe thub chen zhing pa'i grong bzhud tshe/ /'dzam bu'i grib mas sku lus ma btang zhing*/ /lha bu gzhon nu

: drug gis £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· tshogs kyis £© btud gyur pa/ /de tshe mchod 'os khyod la= mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ / gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la= rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis/ / mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la= mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo sgyur mdzad cing*/ / kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs/ /dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas/ /mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la= chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la= sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug gtor thams cad skyobs/ /'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srung dang*/ /shākya thub pa go tam lha yi lha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la= mthun pa'i dge tshogs smon lam rmad byung zhing*/ /spyad pa spyod tshe nam yang mched gyur la/ /bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la= sngon tshe byang chub chen por thugs bskyed nas/ / tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drug khri lnga stong la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang mya ngan med/ /chos bsgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shākya thub/ /rgya chen smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la= nyi ma lta bur ma rig mun pa sel/ /zla ba lta bur nyon mongs gdung ba sel/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /baiḍūr+ya yi 'od la= 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ / sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la= byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing sreg /ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel/ /chos kyi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad pa/ dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la=

rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal ba rtag pa dang*/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje nyi ma dang*/ /pad+ma gar dbang rta yi rgyal po sogs/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rnams la= rgyal ba rigs lnga de bzhin gshegs yum bzhi/ / sems dpa' che dang khro bo'i dbang po rnams/ /rang rang rigs kyi lha mor bcas la sogs/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la= rdo rje phag mo bdag med sna tshogs yum/ /ye shes dbang mo rdo rje ro langs ma/ /rdor dbyings dbang phyug la sogs dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'khor los sgyur ba rnams la= 'dus pa bde dges sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ /gdan bzhi mā ya thod pa gshin rje'i gshed/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs sngags rgyud kyi/ /ye shes lha tshogs kun la= gsang sngags rigs sngags gzung sngags snying po dang*/ /phyag rgya'i rigs byung la sogs sngags kyi lha/ /zhi khro'i lha tshogs rgyud sde bzhi po las/ /gang gsungs rnams la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal/ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med la= phyag stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po stong*/ /spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong*/ /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /btsun po spyan ras gzigs la= dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi sras/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag 'dzoms mdzad pa/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin de la= lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ /gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje bsnams la= mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can/ /don yod zhags pa khro zhal rta mchog dang*/ /ral gcig ma dang khro gnyer can ma ste/ /'phags pa lha lnga'i tshogs la= dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog

/zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la= seng ge glang chen me sbrul chom rkun dang*/ /lcags sgrog rgya mtsho sha za'i 'jigs pa rnams/ /zhi mdzad zla ba'i 'od ltar mdzes pa'i sku/ /bcom ldan sgrol ma yum la= sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /gsung gi skyon spangs ka la piṅka'i dbyangs/ /thugs kyi skyon spangs shes bya mtha' dag mkhyen/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la= rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dbyug sngon can/ /stobs po che dang lha yi bu gnyis po/ / rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams la= 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*/ /nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la= so sor 'brang ma stong chen rab 'joms dang*/ /rma bya chen mo gsang sngags rjes 'dzin dang*/ /bsil ba'i tshal dang gtsug tor gdugs dkar sogs/ /'phrin las lha tshogs rnams la= gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin zhing dran pas kyang*/ /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob mdzad cing*/ /dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /lha mo 'od zer can la= rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba shā wā ri/ /lha mo gang gis bsgrubs pa'i nad gdon bgegs/ /kun tu zhi mdzad ma la= rgyal ba rgyal mtsho'i gsung rab rgya mtsho yi/ /rnam par 'phrul ba'i dpal las legs byung zhing*/ /sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ba/ /lha mo dbyangs can ma la= ye shes ha ya gri ba rta mchog dpal/ /'bar ba'i sku la ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /ma rig tshangs pa kha bub gnon pa'i lha/ /pad+ma rigs sngags rgyal la= chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku/ /ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams/

khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la= ye shes rgyal ba'i rigs kyi sprul pa ni/ /lha min 'joms shing bdud kyi klad pa 'gems/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed/ /'od chen khro bo'i rgyal= mthu stobs thogs med rdo rje rnam par 'joms/ /'phrin las lhun grub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sogs/ khro bo mngag gzhug pho nya'i dbang po rnams/ /rig pa'i tshogs dang bcas la= gtsug gtor 'khor los sgyur dang mthar byed bzhi/ /stobs chen mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang*/ /dbyug sngon hūṃ mdzad gnod mdzes rgyal po ste/ /phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal rnams la= lha klu gnod sbyin lha min tshangs pa sogs/ /'jig rten dregs pa kun gyis zhabs la 'dud// gdul dka' 'dul phyir dkyil 'khor sprul mdzad pa'i/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal gtso la= 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas/ /thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyed la= sems can smin zhing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*/ / chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyed la 'dud/ /sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa/ /ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/ / ye shes sgron me khyod la= sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa rnams/ / thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bcug ste/ /zhi ba rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon khyed la kun nas 'dud/ /sems can las kyi chu bor nub gyur rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*/ / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag khyed la= smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/

/so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ma/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la= mdo sde dbyangs bsnyan lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ /ched brjod gling gzhi rtogs brjod de ltar byung*/ /skye rabs rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab/ / gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul ni rab bzung nas/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad gyur pa/ /rab dga' la sogs sa la bzhugs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la= mi 'khrugs pa dang snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /rin chen 'od 'phro ri rab mu khyud dang*/ / 'od dpag med dang rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /mthu stobs chen po brgyad la= bzang skyong zla 'od gzhon nu yul 'khor skyongs/ /don zab dgongs 'grel kun 'dri chos 'phags dang*/ /blo gros ngag yangs don dam yang bdag 'phags/ /yon tan 'byung gnas rnams la= thub pa'i bka' 'khor shā ri'i bu dang ni/ /mauṅga bu dang kun shes nor sbyin 'dzin/ /nye bar 'khor dang ma 'gags rab 'byor sogs/ /dgra bcom grangs las 'das la= rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong la sogs/ /dgra bcom rigs gyur skyes su zung bzhi dang*/ /tshogs na spyod dang bse ru lta bu yi/ /'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la= bkra shis 'byung dang byang chub chen po dang*/ /chos 'khor cho 'phrul chen po lha las babs/ /dbyen sdum sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs/ /myang 'das mchod rten rnams la= ston pas bstan pa yongs gtad 'od srung che/ /kun dga' bo dang sha na'i gos can dang*/ /nye sbas dhi ti ka dang nag po dang*/ /legs mthong rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brtson pas/ /tshe gcig phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes/ /in+d+ra bhū ti sa ra ha la sogs/ /dpag yas grub chen rnams la= mgon po klu sgrub ār+ya de wa dang*/ /thogs med dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos kyi grags/ /chos skyong yon tan 'od dang dpa' bo sogs/

/'dzam gling rgyan mchog rnams la= sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho/ /brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal/ /blo gsal dbang po pad+ma'i ngang tshul sogs/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba rnams la= mi yi dbang po chos bzhin sa skyong ba/ /rnam dpyod blo can nges pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /dpa' mdzangs blon po tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /rgyal blon byang sems rnams la= bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med/ /zhu chen bsgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas 'dug pa'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba blo gros gsal ldan pa/ /lo tsā chen po rnams la= 'dzam bu'i gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs/ kha ba can du chos kyi sgron me sbar/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras gcig pu/ /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la= byang chub sems dpa' chos rgyal tshul 'dzin zhing*/ /gangs can khrod 'dir gdul bya ma lus pa/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad pa yi/ khri srong lde btsan zhabs la= rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhyen pa rgyas/ /sgrol mas lung bstan kha ba can du byon/ /lnga brgya'i dus su thams cad mkhyen par gyur/ /'gro mgon a ti sha la= ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa shākya shrī/ /rgya gar bod dang kha che la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs yul du dam chos rgyas mdzad pa'i/ / paṇa chen yab sras rnams la= gzungs sngags rtog pa bya rgyud spyod rgyud dang*/ / rnal 'byor rgyud dang rnal 'byor bla med kyi/ /dbang lung bshad pa lag len man ngag gi /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la= so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa dang*/ /'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde rin po che/ /legs par gsung dang de yi dgongs 'grel gyi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la= 'gro la phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde gshegs bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /'dzin dang spel dang bsrung dang rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams la= rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i thugs rje yis/

/sgrub pa po la ma yis bu bzhin skyong*/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la= sa bcu nyid la gnas pa'i sems dpa' yang*/ /gzi brjid me ltar 'bar ba'i khro tshul gyis/ /bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod/ / ye shes mgon po'i tshogs la= gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par mkhyen pa'i dpal/ /nye bar dgongs nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i/ /rdo rje chos skyong rnams la= nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*/ /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam bha la/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la= gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas/ /tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes shing*/ /sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i/ /gnod sbyin nor skyong rnams la= tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong bcu/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs gtsang rigs mgon po ste/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos/ /dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod/ /me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /sman gyi rnam pa gang zhig yod pa dang*/ /'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*/ /rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du/ /nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*/ /ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*/ /shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*/ /lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni/

/spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*/ /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*/ /gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan pa dag/ ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa/ /yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun/ /blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ / yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtse dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ /bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te/ /mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis/ /des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'di/ /bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi/ / sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su gzung bas na/ /srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan pa bgyis/ /sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*/ /sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba ltar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bris pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/

/rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ / de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o/ / de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis/ /'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi/ /stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang pa yi/ /dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i/ /me tog man dā ra dang pad+ma dang*/ /ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*/ /'phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ /spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi/ /bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul/ /zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi/ /lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi/ /gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi/ /rin chen sgron ma rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byug pa der/ /me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bya/ /gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phreng mdzes 'bar ba/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi/ /rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dbyibs legs blta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*/ /rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*/

/mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ /rin chen me tog la sogs char/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig / ces spyod 'jug nas 'byung ba ltar brjod nas mchod pa 'bul/ /slar yang bstod pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ / skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku/ /mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs ri dwags skrag mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' ltar/ / bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang*/ /rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i/ /bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*/ / dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/

/rgya gar skad du/ e ka gā thā/ bod skad du/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes bu khyu mchog khyod 'dra'i dge sbyong chen po gzhan dag lha yul sa la'ang med/ /'jig rten 'di na'ang yod pa ma yin rnam thos bu yi gnas na'ang yod ma yin/ /lha yi pho brang gnas mchog dag na'ang med la phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag na'ang med/ /ri dang nags su bcas pa'i sa steng rgyas pa kun du bskor kyang ga la yod/ /tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa rdzogs so/ /grags chen shes rab chen po ba/ /thub chen dpa' bo chen po ba/ /srid pa'i mya ngan brgal ba po/ /nyon mongs brgal la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sems can rnams la brtse ba can/ /phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can/ /mi 'bral bde ba'i dgongs pa can/ /phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /thub pas sgrib kun nges par grol/ /'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon/ khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab/ /thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul/ /nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la/ /brtse bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun gyi grub cing chags mi mnga'/ /thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni/ /mnyam par gzhag cing 'dri kun gyi/ /lan ldon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten dang brten pa bshad bya dang*/ /gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la/ /blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' ba/ /legs ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de/ /de dag skad kyis sems can gyi/ /'od dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la// legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus can rnams kyis khyod mthong na/ / skyes bu dam pa legs par 'tshal/ /mthong ba tsam gyis rab dad par/ /mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /len dang gnas dang gtong ba dang*/ /sprul dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la/ /mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*/ /theg chen nges par 'byung ba la/ /sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i/ /bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gzhan don du ye shes dang*/ /spangs dang nges 'byung gegs byed rnams/ /ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis/ /mi brjid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba/ /'khor gyi nang na bag rkyang gsungs/ /kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pa/ /'khor bsdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen khyod la rgyu ba dang*/ /gnas pa kun la rtag par ni/ / kun mkhyen min spyod mi mnga' ba/ /yang dag don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal/ / sems can kun gyi bya ba la/ khyod ni dus las mi 'da' bas/ /mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba/ /mi bsnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i/ / phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpyod pa dang ni rtog pa dang*/ /ye shes dang ni 'phrin las kyi/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum dag gi byang chub che/ /rnam pa kun brnyes thams cad du/ / sems can kun gyi the tshom dag /gcod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'/ /snyog pa med cing mi gnas pa/ /mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la/ /spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*/ /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ /chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa/ /tha dad don min don gcig min/ /spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// rtog pa'i dra ba rnam bsal zhing*/ /zab cing rgya che'i sku mnga' ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer dag /kun nas 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu brgyan can/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/

/spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun gyis brgyan/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron mes rab brgyan zhing*/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs po che la drag shul che// rigs sngags rgyal po dge ba po/ /gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul mdzad pa/ / rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems kyi gzhi rnams dang*/ /mchod rten rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mkhan po de bzhin slon dpon dang*/ /brtul zhugs mchog la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu//mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar skad du/ gā thā dwa ya dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas dang ni chos la brnyas pa dang*/ /le lo dang ni cung tsam chog par 'dzin/ /'dod chags dang ni nga rgyal spyod pa dang*/ /'gyod pa dang ni ma nges 'byed pa rnams/ /sems can rnams kyi sgrib par 'gyur ba ste/ /de yi gnyen po theg pa mchog bstan pa/ /'di yis bar du gcod pa de dag gi /nyes pa thams cad rab tu spong bar 'gyur/ /tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra prā kā rā badz+ra prā kā rā badz+ra tsakra diṣ+tā bha yā na ke a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ tsa le tsu le/ tsu lu ke tsu lu ke tsu lu tsu lu sarba bud+dhe swāhā/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs la ni/ tshig gam don gyi sgo nas gang sbyor ba/ /sems can dam pa blo dang ldan pa des/ / phan yon rnam pa bcu dag thob par 'gyur/ khams rnams mtha' dag rgyas par 'gyur ba dang*/ /'chi ba'i tshe na mchog dga' dam pa 'thob/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du skye ba dang*/ /thams cad du ni tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/

/sangs rgyas rnams dang phrad par 'gyur ba dang*/ /de bzhin de dag las ni theg mchog thos// mos par 'gyur ba blo dang bcas pa dang*/ /sgo gnyis dang ni byang chub myur du thob/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs rdzogs so/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa turgā thā/ bod skad du tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skur gyur pa ni thams cad la'ang*/ / mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' ba'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang*/ / gang du byang chub la reg dang*/ /zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /zag med mya ngan 'das pa dang*/ /bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang*/ /'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*/ /seng ge lta bur gzims pa ni/ /gnas de la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*/ /skur bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ / rkang gnyis dam pa shar dang ni/ /byang gi phyogs char bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal ba bsten dka' zhes bya ba/ /des na tshigs bcad 'di gsungs so/ /gang gis tshigs bcad 'di bzhi yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bstod byed na/ /bskal pa bye ba stong du ni/ /de ni ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa rdzogs so/ / gzhan yang phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don par spro na'ang skabs 'dir 'don zhing*/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis dam pa dag /thugs brtse thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs/ /gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /bzhugs pa bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gi sngon chad sdig pa'i las/ /shin tu mi bzad gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /pha ma dag tu mi 'dzin dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams su mi 'dzin dang*/ /dge ba dag tu mi 'dzin pas/ /sdig pa bdag gis gang bgyis dang*/ /phyug pa'i rgyags pas dregs pa dang*/

/rigs dang longs spyod rgyags pa dang*/ /gzhon pa'i rgyags pa'i dregs pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*/ /nyes pa'i dmigs su ma mthong bas/ /nyes par bgyis pa'i las dang ni/ /nyes par bsams shing nyes smras pa'i/ /sdig las bdag gis gang bgyis dang*/ /byis pa'i blo yi 'jug pa dang*/ /mi shes mun pa'i sems dang ni/ /sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang gyur dang*/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'khrugs sems dang*/ /rtsed mo dga' ba'i dbang nyid dang*/ /mya ngan dang ni nad dbang dang*/ /nor gyis ma chog nyes pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*/ /'phags min skye bo 'dre ba dang*// phrag dog ser sna'i rgyu dang ni/ /g.yo dang dbul ba'i nyes pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*/ /phongs dang rgud pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /'dod pa rnams kyi 'jigs rgyu dang*/ /phyug po ma yin gyur pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*/ /g.yo ba'i sems kyi dbang nyid dang*/ /'dod dang khro ba'i dbang dag dang*/ /bkres dang skom pas nyen pa yis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*/ /bza' ba dag dang btung ba dang*/ /bud med rgyu dang gos kyi phyir/ /nyon mongs gdung ba sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdig /nyes spyad rnam pa gsum bsags ni/ /'di 'dra'i tshul gyis gang bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang chos rnams dang*/ /de bzhin nyan thos rnams la yang*/ /gus pa ma lags gang bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /gang yang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang*/ /gus pa ma lags bgyis pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /dam chos smra ba rnams la yang*/ /gus pa ma lags bgyis pa dang*/ /chos la'ang gus par ma bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /bdag gis rtag tu mi shes pas/ /dam pa'i chos ni spangs pa dang*/ /pha ma rnams la ma gus gang*/

/de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /blun pa dang ni byis pa dang*/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*/ /nga rgyal dregs pas bsgribs bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /bdag gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten tu/ /stobs bcu rnams la mchod par bgyi/ /bdag gis phyogs bcu'i sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal kun las gdon par bgyi/ /sems can bsam gyis mi khyab kun/ /sa bcu la ni dgod par bgyi/ /sa bcu la ni gnas nas kyang*/ /thams cad de bzhin gshegs gyur cig /ji srid sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /de kun thar bgyi lus srid du/ /sems can re re'i phyir yang ni/ /bskal pa bye bar spyod par bgyi/ /gser 'od dam pa zhes bgyi ba/ /las rnams thams cad byang bgyid pa/ /zab mo dag ni ston pa 'di/ /sems can dag la bstan par bgyi/ /gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su/ /sdig pa shin tu mi bzad bgyis/ /lan gcig rab tu bshags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyur/ /gang gis las kyi sgrib pa rnams/ /myur du yang dag zad 'gyur ba/ /gser 'od dam pa dge ba yi/ /bshags pa 'di dag bshags nas ni/ /rin chen 'byung gnas mchog bcu po/ /sa bcu la ni gnas par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas yon tan snang bar bgyi/ /

srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho chu bo dang*/ /yon tan rgya mtsho zab mo 'di/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsam yas kyis/ /thams cad mkhyen tu rdzogs par bgyi/ ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong rnams dang/ /gzungs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab dang*/ /dbang stobs byang chub yan lag gis/ / stobs bcu dam par 'gyur bar bgyi/ /dgongs pa'i thugs kyis sangs rgyas rnams/ /bdag la rnam par gzigs su gsol/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /nongs par rab tu gzung du gsol/ /bdag gis bskal pa brgya rnams su/ /sngon chad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /de phyir bdag ni mya ngan sems/ / phongs dang mya ngan 'jigs pas gzir/ /sdig pa'i las la 'jigs par bgyi// yid ni rtag tu dman par gyur/ /gang dang gang du spyod bgyid pa/ /bdag ni gang du dga' ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thugs rje ldan/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'jigs sel bas/ /nongs par rab tu gzung du gsol/ /'jigs pa dag las bdag thar mdzod/ /bdag gi nyon mongs las rnams kyi/ /dri ma de bzhin gshegs pas gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag la ni/ /snying rje chu yis bkru bar gsol/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /sngon chad bdag gis gang bgyis dang*/ /da ltar bdag gi sdig pa gang*/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /nongs par bgyis pa'i las rnams kun/ /slan chad mi bgyid bsdams par bgyi/ /bdag gis nongs par bgyis pa gang*/ /sdig de bcab par mi bgyi'o/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum po rnams/ /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /lus kyis bgyis dang ngag gi las/ /yid kyis rnam par bsams pa dang*/ /las rnams bcu po bgyis pa dag /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so/ /mi dge'i las bcu spangs nas su/ /dge ba bcu po bsten bgyi ste/ /sa bcu la ni bdag gnas kyi/ /stobs bcu mchog tu 'gyur bar bgyi/

/ bdag gis sdig pa'i las gang dag /mi 'dod 'bras bu thob bgyid pa/ / sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ / 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir gang dag gang*/ /'jig rten khams ni gzhan dag tu/ / gang rnams dge ba'i las bgyid pa/ /de dag kun la yi rang ngo*/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang*/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang sgrubs pa/ /bdag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ /byang chub mchog la reg par bgyi/ /srid 'gro nyam ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /skye ba nyam nga srid pa nyam nga dang*/ /'jig rten nyam nga g.yo sems nyam nga bar/ / lus kyi spyod pa nyam nga sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag gis sdig pa gang bsags de 'chags so/ /byis pa blun byas nyon mongs nyam nga dang*/ /sdig pa'-i grogs dang phrad pa nyam nga dang*/ /srid pa nyam nga 'dod chags nyam nga bar/ /zhe sdang gti mug mun pa nyam nga dang*/ /ngal ba'i nyam nga dus kyi nyam nga dang*/ /bsod nams sgrub pa nyam nga dag gis kyang*/ /rgyal ba yang dag mngon sum mchis nas ni/ / sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ / zhes gser 'od dam pa las 'byung ba'i bshags pa 'don pa la nan tan bya'o/ / bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho dang*/ /bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las/ /gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams/ /mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du/ /thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyid/ /'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs ba lags par bzung du gsol/ /'di ni bzang po ma lags pas/ /slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyid/ /sems can thams cad phan mdzad pa'i/ /thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*/ /sems can phan par mdzad pa la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la/

/thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ / sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol/ / rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba ni/ /'gro 'di ldongs par mi 'god cing*/ /bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol/ /de ltar 'di dag kun byas te/ /dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*/ /des ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang*/ /rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang*/ /dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*/ /lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*/ /sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ /rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha' mtha' gtugs pa'i/ /sems can khams la rnam kun tu/ /thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du/ /bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyid cing*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la'ang*/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ / de ltar sho lo ka gsum po de lan gsum brjod pas sems bskyed blangs*/ deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas ris su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag deng gyur/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /bdag gis de ring skyobs pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro la bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis/

/lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las ni 'di dag gis/ / 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du 'tshang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing*/ /sems can sdug bsngal mang po'i gzir las sgrol/ / de dag ni yan lag bdun pa sems bskyed blang ba dang bcas pa yin la/ cung zad mdor bsdus pa la dga' ba'i tshe/ mchod 'phreng rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma'am/ mchod yon phal cher ma gang rigs re bya/ phyag 'tshal gong ma'i dod du/ bstod pa'i phyag 'tshal bcug nas/ mchod pa'i skabs bstod pa mi dgos so/ /shin tu bsdu na yan lag bdun pa bzang spyod nas 'byung ba kho nas kyang chog la/ bzhugs gsol yan chad dang*/ sems bskyed dngos gzhi gong ltar blang ngo*/ /gang ltar yang de rnams sngon du song nas/ yang dag pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa'am/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs sam/ mdo 'don pa'am/ gtor ma gtong ba'am/ gzungs sngags bzla ba'am/ bstod sgrub sogs ci nus su nyams su blangs te/ mthar/ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ṣa ṭa mu khi na ma dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor gyi khyams gnas gtsang ma'i steng*/ nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas pa rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu rnam par phye bas spras pa na/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs grangs med pa dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag khyed kyis 'gro ba thams cad la phan pa dang*/ bde ba'i phyir sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di zung shig /de ni 'di lta ste/ bdag 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ sdug bsngal gang ci myong ba de sems can thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du mi shes pa'i mtshan nyid du ma gyur cig /bdag gi 'jig rten pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba gang ci myong ba de sems can thams cad dang thun mong du yongs su spyod par gyur cig

/bdag la sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi sgrib pa gang ci yod pa de so sor bshags pa bla na med pas so sor ma bshags par ma gyur cig /bdag la bdud kyi las gang dag yod pa de dag yongs su shes pa bla na med pas yongs su mi shes par ma gyur cig /bdag gi pha rol du phyin pa dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'jig rten pa'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa yang rung*/ gang ci yod pa de'i 'bras bu bla na med pa'i ye shes su gyur cigabadag gi rnam par grol ba gang yin pa des/ sems can thams cad rnam par thar bar gyur cig /'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la bdag gnas par ma gyur cig tad+ya thā/ oṃ k+ṣa me k+ṣa me/ k+ṣan+te k+ṣan+te/ da me da me/ dān+te dān+te/ bha dre bha dre/ su bha dre su bha dre/ tsan+d+re tsan+d+re/ su tsan+d+re su tsan+d+re/ tsan+d+ra ki ra ṇe/ tsan+d+ra wa ti/ te dzo wa ti/ dharmā wa ti/ ya sho wa ti/ pra h+ma wa ti/ sarba kle sha bi sho dha ni/ sarba ar+tha/ sā dha ni/ sarba a nar+tha pra sha ma ni/ pa ra ma ar+tha sā dha ni/ kā ya bi sho dha ni/ wāk+bi sho dha ni/ ma naḥsaṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum brjod na/ de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur nas skye bar bdun gyi bar du des ni skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro//bcom ldan 'das dgyes shing de skad ces bka' stsal ba la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang*/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// // de nas 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa dang*/ byams pa'i smon lam dang*/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba sogs thams cad dam/

gang rung zhig gis dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'ang brjod do/ /gzungs kyi rigs rnams bzlas pa lan mang du 'don par 'dod na/ phyag 'tshal 'di sngon du bya ste/ 'jig rten ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gang gis thog mar rig sngags rnams/ /'dzam bu'i gling du gsungs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ltar byung dang 'das pa dang*/ /ma byon sangs rgyas gang lags pa/ /thams cad la yang bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de dag rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /'khor lo bskor ba bla med pa/ /mar mer mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'od mdzad pa/ /thams cad gnon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen pa grags ldan pa/ /pad+ma'i bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan dang ldan pa skyabs mdzad pa/ /rab mthor gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ded dpon bla na med pa po/ /grags pa'i bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma lta bur 'od mdzad pa/ /bde mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi me long ston pa po/ /don gzigs la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /dul ba'i tshul khrims 'jigs med pa/ /rgyal zhes bya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis dang ldan/ /skar rgyal la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal ldan pa/ /rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od can gzi brjid ldan pa po/ /gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs par mchod pa grags ldan pa/ /thams cad skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud dpung rab tu 'joms mdzad pa/ /log dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram ze dpal dang ldan pa po/ /gser thub de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can kun la thugs brtse ba/ /'od srung de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya seng ge 'od mdzad pa/ /gser mdog can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser sna med pa thugs rje can/ /byams pa la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal te/ /de dag la yang skyabs su mchi/ /gang dag gis ni chos bstan pa// sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la sangs rgyas gus mdzad pa'i/

/chos la'ang bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la phul na don che ba'i/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan thos shes rab mchog gyur pa'i/ /shā ri'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog gyur pa/ /moṅgal bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ / chos kyi gtam gyis 'jigs med pa/ /ka ta'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan thos sbyangs pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /'od srung la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa yi ni dbang gyur pa/ /ko di n+ya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mang du thos pa rig sngags 'chang*// kun dga' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus ngan dang ni yul 'khor srung*/ /mig mi bzang dang 'phags pa skyes po/ /phyogs bzhi kho ra khor yug gi /rgyal chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi ded dpon mchog /nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pha ma mkhan po slob dpon dang*/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /rig sngags rnams ni grub gyur cig /gang gi don du bya ba yi/ /don de bdag la 'grub gyur cig /sdang bar sems shing gnod byed pa'i/ /mi ma yin rnams gung du dengs/ /byams par sems shing phan 'dod pa/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis bdag la nyon/ / zhes brjod nas/ de'i rjes su gzungs mdo rnams 'don par bya'o/ /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs par 'dod na/ po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas/ /tāṃḥyig ljang khu las 'khrungs shing*/ /tāṃḥyig 'od kyis 'gro ba sgrol/ /sgrol ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ba/ /dpa' mo tā re tut+tā re/ /sangs rgyas zhal gyi pad+mo yi/ /ge sar las 'khrungs khyod la 'dud/ /ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi/ / dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ba/ /mchog sbyin phyag rgya ut+pa la/

/ bsnams pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i 'gro la tut+tā re/ /swāhā nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad/ /oṃ gyi ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed khyod la 'dud/ /'jigs pa chen po brgyad las ni/ /'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad/ /kun gyi ma ru gyur pa yi/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul/ /'phags ma'i tshogs rnams bzhes su gsol/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga/ /sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /so so skye bo la sogs pas/ /dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa'i/ /bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang*/ /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang*/ /blo yi bye brag ji lta bar/ /che chung thun mong theg pa yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stong bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yis/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi/ /sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /bdag gis bsod nams ci bsags pa/ /thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas/ /ring por mi thogs 'gro ba yi/ /'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig

/ de nas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig ci nus su 'don zhing*/ phan yon yang brjod par bya'o// 'jig rten gsum mgon yum gyur spyan yangs ma/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /gnyis med ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ / thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don sna tshogs mdzad/ /byams pa'i yum gyur khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog lja khu 'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad/ /yon tan rab rgyas bcu drug lon pa'i tshul/ /'gro la rab dgyes zhal ni 'dzum par mdzad/ /zhi ba'i spyan gyis 'jig rten gsum la gzigs/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang sems rang bzhin zla ba gdan du bting*/ /nyon mongs mi bskyod rdo rje'i skyil krung dang*/ /sgrib pa kun spangs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zag med bde rgyas zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ /zag med bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na bza' mchog dang rin chen du mas spras/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin sgrub la dngos grub ster/ /g.yon pa ut+pal skyon bral dag pa'i rtags/ /phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel/ /mtha' bral zung 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag stong spyan stong sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sman pa'i rgyal po sgrol ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /sman ltar nad 'joms sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thugs rje thabs mkhas sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa ltar rten mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu ltar bsil mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me ltar smin mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlung ltar rgyas mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi/ /sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol/ /de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun du yang*/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba mchog thob nas/

/thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa byed pa la/ /bar chad gdon bgegs rims dang nad la sogs/ /dus min 'chi bar gyur pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ /'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las ni 'das pa yi/ /bkra shis dge legs phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i don rnams ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /sgrub la brtson zhing dam chos 'phel ba dang*/ /rtag tu khyod bsgrubs zhal mchog mthong ba dang*/ /stong nyid don rtogs byang sems rin po che/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal ba'i mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /bdag gis tshe rabs sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las ma/ /sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhi dpa'/ /yum gyur ut+pal bsnams pa'i bkra shis shog / ces brjod do/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'don par 'dod na/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya seng ge 'jam dpal dang gsang bdag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs par mos la/ de dag la bstod par bsams nas/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs dang*/ gur gum mdog can phyag gnyis pa/ /at+pal steng na ral gri bsnams/ /glegs bam 'dzin pa chos kyi rje/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa ci nus su brjod/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa khungs dang 'brel ba ci rigs pas bstod la/ gang tshe lta bar 'dod pa'am/ /cung zad dri bar 'dod na yang*/ /mgon po 'jam dbyangs de nyid ni/ /gegs med par yang mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ /sems can kun don sgrub pa'i phyir/

/ji ltar 'jam dbyangs spyod mdzad pa/ /bdag gi spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /bdag kyang 'jam dbyangs bka' drin kyis/ /sa rab dga' ba thob bar du/ /rtag tu tshe rabs dran pa dang*/ /rab tu byung ba byed par shog /brtse ldan khyod kyis mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas/ /bka' dang bstan bcos ji bzhin rtogs pa yi/ /blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba stsal du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab bo/ /shes rab snying po'i mdo bsgrub bya bar 'dod na/ mdun gyis nam mkhar de bzhin gshegs pa bdud 'dul gyi phyag rgya can 'khor shā ri'i bu dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhu lan mdzad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun gyis bskor bar mos la/ stong nyid kyi don la sems bzhin du/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ / zhes sogs sher phyin kyi bstod pa gang rung zhig sngon du 'gro bas/ shes rab snying po'i mdo gang nus su bton la/ mthar spro zhing dgos na bden pa bdar la bdud bzlog bya/ mjug tu/ gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung sogs dang*/ smon lam bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ de rnams thams cad khrigs chags su byed na/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bstod pa dang*/ de nas brgyud 'debs kyi rigs dang*/ bla ma spyi bstod kyi rigs dang*/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dang*/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa dang gzungs kyi khyad par rnams bton la/ mthar bdud bzlog bya'o/ /gal te gnas brtan phyag mchod bya bar 'dod pas khrigs chags su byed na/ gzungs mdo'i rjes su bya/ 'di kho na gtso bor byed na/ sems bskyed kyi rjes la bya'o/ /lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /ljon zhing chu mtshos brgyan pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus/ /rin chen las grub gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i gdan steng du/ /thugs rjes rtsod pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams//rnam grol lam la 'god mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon/

/thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan chen po rnams/ /'khor dang bcas te gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*/ /shes rab me 'bar nyon mongs mtsho skem zhing*/ /rnam grol bsod nams zhing du bka' sdod pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i nyan thos dge 'dun bzhugs su 'tshal/ /yon sbyor mchod pa'i gnas su spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag /gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa'i/ /chos skyong dgra bcom chen po bzhugs su 'tshal/ /dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dus ldan rdo rje mo bu bzang po dang*/ /gser be'u bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog / 'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin/ /lam phran bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len/ /lam brtan klu ste sbed byed mi byed pa/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang*/ / gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin zhing*/ khyad par can gyi 'phrin las chos skyong ba'i/ /gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs/ /bde gshegs bka' lung gtsor mdzad bstan pa bsrung*/ /rang don dor nas 'khor ba'i nags tshal du/ /gzhan don sgrub mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug po/ /dam bcas thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs/ /dge bsnyen skyabs gsol bden pa'i tshigs mnyan pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs 'bring mchis so 'tshal/ /bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /mtshungs med blta bas mi ngoms shing*/ /gser gyi mdog can mdzes pa'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung bzhugs/

/sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ /bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang*/ £© /bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /thub pa'i bka' lung gtsor mdzad cing*/ /lha mi'i bsod nams dpal zhing du/ /bzhugs shing dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i/ /bden tshig mnga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i sku ྄tshe= /bstan pa rgyas par= /pri yaṃ ku yi gling na ni/ /'phags pa gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin/ /dgra bcom stong dang chig brgyas bskor/ /rin chen srog zhu 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la/ /'phags pa gnas brtan lam phran brtan/ /dgra bcom stong dang drug brgyas bskor/ /phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /shar gyi lus 'phags gling na ni/ /bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len/ /dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor/ /glegs baṃ lhung bzed 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na/ /'phags pa gnas brtan lam brtan ni/ /dgra bcom chen po dgu brgyas bskor/ /glegs bam chos 'chad mdzad phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /ri yi rgyal po ngos yangs la/ /'phags pa gnas brtan klu yi sde/ /dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor/ /bum pa 'khar gsil 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= bstan pa= /ri yi rgyal po bi hu lar/ /'phags pa gnas brtan sbed byed ni/ /dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor/ /phyag gnyis glegs bam 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /gangs can ri yi rgyal po la/ /'phags pa gnas brtan mi phyed pa/ /dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor/ /byang chub mchod rten 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /gangs ri chen po ti se la/ /'phags pa gnas brten yan lag 'byung*/ /dgra bcom stong dang sum brgyas bskor/ /spos phor rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= drang srong ri yi ngogs nags na/ /'phags pa gnas brtan ma pham pa/ /dgra bcom brgya phrag gcig gis bskor/

/phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug na/ /'phags pa gnas brtan nags na gnas/ /dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor/ / sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /'dzam bu gling gi zangs gling na/ /'phags pa gnas brtan dus ldan ni/ /dgra bcom stong dang chig brgyas bskor/ /gser gyi rna bskor 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /sing ga la yi gling na ni/ /gnas brtan rdo rje mo yi bu/ /dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor/ /sdig mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= bstan pa= /chu bo ya mu na gling na/ /'phags pa gnas brtan bzang po ni/ / dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor/ /chos 'chad mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /gnas mchog kha che'i yul na ni/ /'phags pa gnas brtan gser be'u/ /dgra bcom chen po lnga brgyas bskor/ /rin chen zhags pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= bstan pa= nub kyi ba lang spyod na ni/ / bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog /dgra bcom chen po bdun brgyas bskor/ /phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= /byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni/ /'phags pa gnas brtan pa ku la/ /dgra bcom chen po dgu brgyas bskor/ /phyag gnyis ne'u le 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa= / 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen dharmā ta/ /ral pa'i thod bcings glegs bam khur/ / snang ba mtha' yas mdun na bzhugs/ /rnga yab bum pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa rgyas par= /brtson par go gon mthu stobs ldan/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa legs skyong ba/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/ /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i= /bstan pa rgyas par= / zhes so/ / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bco pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ / byin gyis brlab tu gsol/
