sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos skyong zhing lha mi kun gyi bsod nams bsags pa'i dpal gyi zhing du/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bka' bsgos te/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten na mngon sum du bzhugs shing*/ /bka' lung gi rjes su sgrub pa 'phags pa'i tshig nges pas zhal gyis bzhes pa/ gangs ri chen po ti se la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung 'khor dgra bcom pa stong sum brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ drang srong ri'i ngogs nags na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa 'khor dgra bcom pa brgya phrag gcig gis bskor te= ri nags kyi ngogs lo ma bdun pa zhes bya ba'i ri phug na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs= zangs gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po dus ldan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i= sing ga la'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la= chu bo ya mu na'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bzang po 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i= kha che'i yul na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po gser be'u 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i= nub kyi ba lang spyod na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza gser can 'khor dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i= byang gi sgra mi snyan na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ba ku la 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i= pri yang ku yi gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i=

bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong drug brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i= shar gyi lus 'phags gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i= lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i= ri'i rgyal po ngos yangs la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i= ri'i rgyal po bi hu la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sbed byed pa 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i= gangs can ri'i rgyal po la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i= 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharmā ta la 'khor dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas/ oṃ mu ni mu ni mahā mu na ye swāhā/

zhes mang du bzlas/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /'gro ba'i don du bstan pa skyong mdzad pa/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos gnas brtan bcu drug gis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid gnas brtan bcu drug gi /'khor tshogs srid mtsho las brgal nyon mongs med/ khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems can kun gyi gsos gyur dgra bcom pa/ /rig dang zhabs ldan skye dgu'i sbyin gnas che/ /'phags pa'i gang zag chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lus rab spangs nas/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog /bsod nams rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par dag gyur cig /yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus kun rdzogs nas/ /'jig rten kun las khyad par 'phags par shog /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yis/ /'phrin las sgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med/ /skal ba nyams pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog gis bkra shis shog /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje yis/ /nyan thos tshul bzung srid pa ji srid bar/ /bstan pa skyong zhing 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi bkra shis shog / gzhan yang tshe dpag med kyi gzungs mdo dang*/ 'od zer can gyi gzungs mdo sogs 'don par 'dod pas kyang*/ so so'i bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas 'don par bya'o/ /gal te nyin zhag gcig la thun mang du byed na/ thun dang po la bstod pa'i phyag 'tshal dor ba'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ thun bar pa rnams la bzang spyod dang gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ thun tha ma la gong du bshad pa ltar gyi yan lag bdun pa 'bring po de bya'o/

/thun gnyis sogs la'ang de'i rigs 'gre'o/ /tshogs pas gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas kyang*/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sems bskyed sngon du song nas gtor ma btang ste/ mjug tu smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs su brjod do/ /kha zas kyi bya ba la 'jug pa'i sngon rol du dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo 'don te/ de yang*/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de ni bsod nams dag gi rgyu mthun pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams chud mi za ba/ bzod pas brgyan pa/ bsod nams kyi gter rnams kyi gzhi/ dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis spras pa/ mtshan rnams kyi me tog rgyas pa/ spyod yul ran par mthun pa/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ dad pas mos pa rnams la mngon par dga' ba/ shes rab zil gyis mi gnon pa/ stobs rnams la rdzi ba med pa/ sems can thams cad kyi ston pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyal po/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'gro ba rnams kyi ded dpon/ ye shes dpag tu med pa/ spobs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gsung rnam par dag pa/ dbyangs snyan pa/ sku byad blta bas chog mi shes pa/ sku mtshungs pa med pa/ 'dod pa dag gis ma gos pa/ gzugs dag gis nye bar ma gos pa/ gzugs med pa dag dang ma 'dres pa/ sdug bsngal las rnam par grol ba/ phung po dag las rab tu rnam par grol ba/ khams rnams dang mi ldan pa/ skye mched rnams bsdams pa/ mdud pa rnams shin tu bcad pa/ yongs su gdung ba dag las rnam par grol ba/ srid pa las grol ba/ chu bo las brgal ba/ ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang*/

da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes la gnas pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' la gnas pa/ sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i sa la bzhugs pa ste/ 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku che ba'i yon tan yang dag pa rnams so/ /dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos legs par gsungs pa/ yang dag par mthong ba/ nad med pa/ dus chad pa med pa/ nye bar gtong ba/ 'di mthong ba la don yod pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis so so rang gis rig par bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba legs par ston pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mi mthun pa med cing*/ 'dus pa dang ldan pa/ brten pa yod pa rgyu ba bcad pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun ni/ legs par zhugs pa/ rig par zhugs pa/ drang por zhugs pa/ mthun par zhugs pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi dpal gyi zhing*/ yon yongs su sbyong ba chen po/ sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa/ kun tu yang sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa chen po'o/ zhes so/ / sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /chos kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /dge 'dun yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la dad byas pa'i/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog ces brjod la/ oṃ āḥgu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa badz+ra nai we t+ya hūṃ/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ad+ya nut+pan+nā twa da/ oṃ āḥphaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas zas phud phul/ oṃ ha ri t+yai swāhā/ oṃ ha ri te mahā yak+ṣi ni ha ra ha ra sarba pā paṃ ni k+ṣiṃ swāhā/ oṃ a gra paṇ+ḍi a shi bh+yaḥswāhā/ zhes pas chang bu sbyin nas/

dran pa mnyam par bzhag pas bza'o/ /zos zin pa na/ oṃ u tsiṭ+ṭa piṇ+ḍa a shi bh+yaḥswāhā/ zhes pas lhag ma'i chang bu byin zhing*/ kha bkrus nas/ na maḥs man+ta pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te sam myaka saṃ bud+dha ya/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ ku mā ra bhū tā ya/ bo d+dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ni ra laṃ bhe/ ni ra bha se/ dza ya dza ya/ lab+dhe mahā ma ti/ dak+ṣi dak+ṣi ṇi/ me pa ri shodha ni swāhā/ gang gis bdag la kha zas byin pa de dag thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba thob par gyur cig /gang gis bdag la skom blud pa de dag dang*/ gang gis bdag la rim gro byas pa dang*/ bkur sti byas pa dang*/ bsti stang byas pa dang*/ mchod pa byas pa de dag thams cad kyang nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba thob par gyur cig /gang dag bdag la mi bde bar byed pa dang*/ brdeg pa dang*/ mtshon gyis 'debs pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du srog gcod pa'i bar du byed pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub kyi bde ba thob cing*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yis ni/ /'gro ba'i nang du rang byung sangs rgyas shog /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /skye bo srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo// gzhan yang grong khyer gnas pa dag /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /gang gi sbyin pa gang la byin/ /sbyin pa ji ltar mi dmigs pa/ /sbyin pa mnyam pa de nyid kyis/ /sbyin bdag de la yongs rdzogs shog /sbyin pas 'byung po dbang du 'gyur/ /sbyin pas dgra rnams med par gyur/ /pha rol gnyen yang sbyin pa nyid/ /de phyir sbyin pa gtso bor brjod/ /sbyin pa 'jig rten rgyan yin te/ /sbyin pas ngan 'gro ldog par byed/ /sbyin pa mtho ris skas yin te/

/sbyin pa zhi byed dge ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i longs spyod rnams/ /mi zad nam mkha' lta bu gang*/ /longs spyod de ni thob bya'i phyir// sbyin pa de ni yang dag spel/ /brtsams par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ / chos 'dul 'di la spyod gyur pa/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ / de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang rung zhig brjod nas/ mdo 'don pa sogs bya'o// thun rnams kyi mjug tu dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod par bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ 'gro kun dge rtsa ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*/ /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la/ /kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig /'jig rten thams cad ma lus sems can rnams/ /ji snyed rgyal ba kun gyis thugs chud pa/ /kun kyang mkhas pa kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /kun tu bzang po de bzhin 'gyur bar shog /phyogs rnams ma lus kun du ci byas pa/ /skyes bu dam pa de ltar yongs su bsngo/ /rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan rgyal bas gang gsungs pa/ /yongs bsngo dam pa mchog dang phul yang yin/ /de bzhin zhing rnams thams cad ma lus par/ /rgyu bzhin kun kyang khong du chud byas te/ /sems can ji snyed thams cad ma lus par/ /de dag kun kyang kun du bzang gyur cig /sbyin pas yongs bsngo ji bzhin red gyur cig /tshul khrims kyis kyang bsngos bzhin red gyur cig /brtson 'grus stobs kyis bskal par mi ldog cing*/ /bzod pa 'khrug pa med pa'i yid gyur cig /bsam gtan gyis kyang rtse gcig yid ldan zhing*/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi spyod yul shes gyur cig/ shes rab dus rnams gsum po thams cad du/ /'jig rten dag tu mthar dmigs med gyur cig

/lus dang ngag dang yid rnams thams cad kyang*/ /rnam pa kun du rnam dag mkhas gyur cig /spyod pa de dag thams cad ma lus par// kun kyang kun du bzang po red gyur cig /ji ltar chos dbyings rlom pa'i sems med cing*/ /de la spros dang chags pa med pa ltar/ /mya ngan 'da' dang sgrib pa med pa dang*/ /de bzhin sems la rlom sems med gyur cig /ches mkhas yongs su bsngo ba gang brjod pa/ /de ni rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bsngo ba ste/ / mkhas pas spyod pa ci nas 'grub 'gyur bar/ /dge ba de yang de yis yongs su bsngo/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis 'di la bslabs pa ste/ /ji snyed gang yod thams cad ma lus par/ /mkhas rnams kun kyang yongs su bsdu byas te/ /ci nas bde gshegs stobs la 'jug par bsngo/ / zhes rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i snying po dang*/ gzhan yang smon lam mang du btab/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag mtho ris na/ / rin chen rmad byung rgya chen mchog yod pa/ /des ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen la/ /cis kyang grangs dang bgrang dang char mi phod/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /zhi dgos bdud rtsi'i shin tu gya nom gang*/ /shākya thub pas mnyam bzhag thugs chud pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa yod min te/ /de mngon byas na phyin chad mya ngan med/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung = dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= rgyal bas gang dag gang zag brgyad gsungs pa// de dag rnams ni skyes bu zung bzhi ste/ /sby-in gnas de dag sa steng shin tu dkon/ /de dag rnams la byin na dpag med 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tu smad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis= dam pa gtso bo mchog sbyin gya nom pa/

/'od mchog dpa' bo dam pa mchog gi gnas/ /shes rab dam pa mchog ni dam pa mchog /mchog min mchog mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung = rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= ting 'dzin dam pa bar chad med pa gang*/ /mtha' yas blo ldan de bzhin gshegs gsungs pa/ /ting 'dzin de brtan rdo rje dper byas pa/ /ting 'dzin de dang mtshungs pa'i ting 'dzin med/ / ngo 'tshar shin tu rmad= ting nge 'dzin gyi rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis= ji ltar sgo gtan dam zhing rab dam ste/ /stobs chen rlung bzhi dag gis mi bskyod pa/ /de ltar mkhas pa bden bzhi mthong gnas pa/ /'jig rten smra ba rnams kyis 'dir mi g.yo/ /ngo mtshar shin tu= dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= thams cad zil gnon kun mkhyen thams cad gzigs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa stobs rnams kun dang ldan/ /kun gyi dam pa 'dzin pa kun dang bral/ /bsam pa kun mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig /ngo mtshar shin tu= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa= srid pa 'gog cing mi g.yo 'gyur ba med/ /skyon med 'jigs pa kun las rnam par grol/ /shin tu 'gag cing gya nom nges par 'byung*/ /shin tu dri med zhi ba blos mi 'phrog /ngo mtshar= dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen= ji ltar= bden pa= shin tu sdug bsngal bton zhing bde sbyin pa'i/ /bden rnams mthong ste gang dag bag yod pa/ /bden pa rin chen rnams la dogs bral ba/ /de dag skye ba brgyad pa phyis mi len/ /ngo mtshar= dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa= dam pa rnams kyi dam pa don dam mkhyen/ /mchog dang mchog min mkhyen zhing don dam brtson/ /gzhan gyis mi 'phrog dam pa thugs chud rtogs// shin tu sdug bsngal rnams kyi dpung gnyen mchog /ngo mtshar= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen= ji ltar=

bden pa= 'dun pa bskyed nas rnal 'byor ldan gyur cing*/ /gau tam bstan la rtag brtson rab grol zhing*/ /gzhan gyi mi dkri ba dag zhing der reg /'di la de reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar= dam chos rin chen gang zhig= ji ltar= bden= bden pa mthong bas brjed pa rgya lam na/ /gal te sdig pa 'ga' zhig byas gyur kyang*/ /de ni de 'chab pa yi 'os min te/ /chos nyid 'di ni mi g.yo gnas phyir ro/ /ngo mtshar= dge 'dun= ji ltar= bden pa= lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /sangs rgyas dang ni lhag pa'i mtshungs pa med/ /lha dang mi yi ston pa bla na med/ /ston pa ded dpon sman pa rnams kyi mchog /ngo mtshar= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas= ji ltar= bden pa= sa ga'i zla ba dang por thub pa yis/ /nags khrod chos kyi dam pa rab brnyes pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa'i lhag pa med/ /'di la de reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar= dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa= sdig pa rnying zad gsar du byas med la/ /rims nad med pas 'jigs med mya ngan bral/ /rtsa ba 'gags pas srid pa mi bskyed pa/ /bstan pa mar me bzhin du 'bar bar 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar= dge 'dun= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog/

gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs par bya ba ni/ rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol pa'i/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog / tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /'phrin las sgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med/ /skal pa mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i//mnyam med bla ma mchog gi= phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ / tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi nas/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ / nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi nas/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyas sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog/mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog / mtha' bral don rtogs thugs kyi bkra shis shog

/rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*/ /bzod pa sgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ston pa 'jig rten khams su 'byon pa dang*/ /bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang*/ /bstan 'dzin phu nu bzhin du mthun pa yi/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog / bar 'dir spro na thun mong ma yin pa'i bla brgyud sogs dang*/ gong gi phyag 'tshal la 'don pa bsgyur te/ yi dam gyi bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod/ rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsam pa dang*/ /gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi mthu stobs dang*/ /bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis/ /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*/ /rgyud ni nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*/ /snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshangs dang lha dbang bsrung ma'i byin brlabs dang*/ /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur pa'i/ /bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /sems can re ba bskong mdzad pa/ /bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*/ /mthun pa bsgrub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yi/ / bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad srung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/

/chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zab cing rgya cher gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor bsrung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /rgyal chen bzhi yi bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la'ang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi deng 'dir stsol/ de bzhin du nyin mo bde legs tshig gsum gyis mthar/ dam chos rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /dge 'dun rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /tshangs pa yis kyang deng 'dir stsol/ /lha yi dbang pos deng 'dir stsol/ /'jig rten skyong bas deng 'dir stsol/ /dkar phyogs skyong bas deng 'dir stsol/ / zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs par brjod do/ /'di bris pa yi dge bas kyang*/ /mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /sgrib sbyangs tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs te/ /rgyal ba'i srid la dbang 'byor shog / las dang po ba'i rim pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di ni shin tu mang po la phan par mthong zhing*/ don gnyer 'gas kyang bskul te/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas khrigs chags su bsgrigs pa ste rang lo so lnga pa la'o/ / 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / dge legs 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /gso sbyong gi cho ga dus bzang mchod pa dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal nas/ / las kyi mtha' las 'tsho ba yang*/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed blangs gyur pas/ /cho ga 'di la 'jug par bya/ /tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu bzhi dang*/ bco lnga dang*/ gnam stong la sogs pa dus bzang po rnams la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rnams bkram/ khyad par sangs rgyas gyi sku gzugs dang*/ bka' rtsod med kyi po ti gcig 'byor na nges par gal che zhing*/ 'byor rung ma 'byor rung maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa gcig bkod/ mchod yon gyi snod kyis sna drangs pa'i mchod pa rgya cher bshams/

dkar gtor 'brang rgyas lta bu zhig dang*/ zas sna mang po dang bcas pa dang*/ srung ma rnams kyi gtor ma zhig kyang bshams/ lus thams cad bkru ba'am/ kha dang yan lag lnga dbang po'i sgo rnams bkru/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes bzla/ snod gtsang mar dri bzang gi chu blug ste/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ ku shas gnas dang yo byad gang zag rnams la gtor/ na mo sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i stobs las/ dmigs pa'i rten 'di tsam la brten nas sa'i phyogs 'dir 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad 'byon zhing bzhugs pa'i gnas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa bde ba can lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang*/ gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad du yongs su rdzogs pa/ rdo rje rin po che seng ge'i khri dang*/ rin po che'i pad ma la sogs pa gdan gyi bkod pa phun gsum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ phyi nang thams cad du 'phags pa kun du bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bus yongs su gang ba rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid can/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ 'phags pa chos skyong pa ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung bar gyur cig /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bar gyur cig /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i zhing khams thams cad gang zhing rgyas par gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ

oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rol chen dang bcas/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sa ra pra ma rdan ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re mahā badz+re mahā te dza badz+re mahā bir+ya badz+re mahā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bo dhi man+t+ro pa saṃ kra ma ṇe sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swāhā/ de ltar mchod pa byin rlabs tshar gsum bya/ de nas 'grub na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la dmigs nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bshags pa rgyas par bya/ gzhan rgyas pa ma 'grub kyang phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don pa ni nges par bya dgos te/ de rjes bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la'ang*/ rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ / lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed blangs/ de nas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blang ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa spyan gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de rnams kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/

nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*/ /gzhan gyi nor ni blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ khri gdan che mtho mi bya zhing*/ /de bzhin du ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spongs/ /bla med byang chub gnas thob shog /sdug bsngal mang dkrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog / lan gsum brjod/ oṃ a mo gha shī la sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ mahā shud+dha/ £© satwa pad+ma bi bhu ṣe ta/ bhu dza dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a wa lo ki te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces tshul khrims yongs dag gi gzungs bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*/ / zhes sogs smon lam gdab bo/ /de nas spyan 'dren pa ni spos sbar zhing*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya cher dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/

/de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams sgrol ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa shākya'i tog /rgyal sras rig pa'i lha mo tshogs dang bcas/ khro bo'i rgyal po bka' sdod pho nya sogs/ /thams cad ma lus gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du gshegs nas kyang*/ /'dir bzhugs mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol zhing*/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha bha ga wān/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka e h+ya hi/ lan gsum/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis mi mthun pa rnams sbyangs/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ / bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gis mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /oṃ ga ga na sa ma ya hūṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus sol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta= bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyi na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ dbus su bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal po ni/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs phyogs bcu dang*/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas yum tshogs bcas/ /gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs rgyal ba'i sras/ /gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo'i dbang po dang*/ /rdo rje ma sogs byang chub sems ma'i tshogs/

/gaṇ+ḍa ri dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ /rig pa'i khro mo grangs las 'das pa sogs/ /g.yas kyi phyogs su 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /lha mo bzhi dang sems dpa' grangs med bcas/ /g.yon phyogs thugs rje chen po 'jig rten mgon/ /'phags ma sgrol ma la sogs 'khor gyis bskor/ /mtha' bskor ye shes mgon po lcam dral dang*/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang 'jig rten skyong ba bcu/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi yongs bskor te/ / bdag la rab tu dgyes pa bzhugs par gyur/ / de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ chu bo gang gā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /ar+gha'i rgyun yang mi chad de/ /bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul na/ /thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ dri zhim reg na bde ba yi/ /zhabs bsil rgyun yang mi chad de/ /bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul na/ /thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /de ltar bdag gis lha rnams la/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra artsi ta a mṛ ta swāhā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*/ /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog

/oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra waṇ+ḍa ye swāhā/ phreng ba rin chen se mo do shal dang*/ /rgyan gyi dam pa ma lus phul ba yis/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyan dang ldan gyur nas/ /bla med theg pa mchog la gnas par shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra a lang ka ra swāhā/ theg mchog bla re mgon skyabs gdugs dang ldan/ /bdud bcom rgyal mtshan ba dan ting 'dzin 'phan/ /bdag dang 'gro ba'i don du 'bul lags kyi/ /dbang mchog dam pa dus 'dir stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra u pas+tha na swāhā/ sna tshogs rol mo snyan pa'i sgra dag dang*/ /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par rab brgyan pa/ /theg pa mchog gis nges par bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra swa ra na da swāhā/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i/ lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra gan+dhe swāhā/ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+ya dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra puṣ+pe swāhā/ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+ya/ /dri yi rgyas pa lha yi rdzas/ /nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra dhu pe swāhā/ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+ya dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong*/ /sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra nai we t+ya swāhā/ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+ya dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ gnod pa 'joms shing bkra shis pa/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/

/oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra ā lo ke swāhā/ ā lo ka ā lo ka sarba bid+ya dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ pi waṃ ma dang gling bu ma/ /rdza rnga ma dang rdza rnga che/ /bzhad ma sgeg mo glu gar ma/ /me tog ma dang spos 'chang ma/ /mar me ma dang dri chab ma/ /me long ma dang ro 'dzin ma/ / reg bya ma dang chos ldan ma/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ na na a ra tsi ta s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ mthon mthing 'od chags rdo rje pi waṃ ma/ rgyud mang snyan pa'i skad kyis yid sgyur byed/ / rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra bī ni swāhā/ mchog gi gser mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma/ /snyan rgyud rin chen gling bu'i sgra dbyangs can/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol pa 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra waṃ se swāhā/ bim+pa ltar dmar rdo rje rdza rnga ma/ /skad snyan lha rdzas bzang po'i rdza rnga 'khrol/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol pa 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra mu ra dze swāhā/ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga chen ma/ /rnga zlum cher sgrog nam mkha' phyogs kun 'gengs/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ / oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra mṛ tang ge swāhā/ pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs can bzhad pa mo/ / 'dzum zhal rgyas pas gzhan gyi kun dga' bskyed/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra ha s+ya swāhā/ mthon ka chen po'i 'od can rab sgeg ma/ /rdo rje dril 'chang dkur brten snyan pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra la s+ya swā hā/

btso ma'i gser mdog rdo rje glu dbyangs ma/ /shes rab dbyangs can rna ba'i bcud len mkhan/ / rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra gī ti swāhā/ rma bya'i spu ltar sngo ljang gar mkhan ma/ / mnyen lcug yan lag mchog gus khro gar bsgyur/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra nirti swāhā/ ston zla ltar dkar rdo rje me tog ma/ /lha rdzas me tog bye ba'i char 'bebs byed/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra puṣ+pe swāhā/ sngo skya dud sprin lus can bdug pa ma/ /mkha' khyab dri zhim bdug pa'i spos sprin can/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra dhū pe swāhā/ gur gum gzhon nu'i lus can snang gsal ma/ /rin chen snang bas phyogs bcu'i mun sel byed/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ / rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra dī paṃ swāhā/ 'char ka'i mdangs ltar dmar skya byug pa ma/ /legs sbyar dri mchog dge bas rtog pa sel/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra gan+dhe swāhā/ kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar gzugs brnyan ma/ /rnam dag rin chen dngul dkar me long g.yon/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ / oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra rū pe swāhā/ leb rgan rtsi ltar lus dmar ro ldan ma/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan lha yi zhal zas 'dzin/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/

/oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra rā se swāhā/ dur ba'i 'dab ltar ljang ser reg bya mo/ /reg pa'i bde ba mchog ster na bza' 'dzin/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra spar she swāhā/ kun da ku mud rgyas 'dra chos dbyings ma/ /rgyal ba kun bskyed skye gnas phyag rgya can/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra dharma dhā tu swāhā/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra tsakra rat+na swāhā/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /dbul zhing phongs pa rgyun chad nas// 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra ma ṇi rarna swāhā btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun chad nas/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs te/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra wasti rat+na swāhā/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab ldan zhing*/ /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra mahā ta rat+na swāhā/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal zhing*/ /bla med theg pa rab zhon nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra hasti rat+na swāhā/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol zhing*/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra tu raṅga a shwa rat+na swāhā/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur te/ /phas kyi sgol ba tshar bcad nas/ /bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra khad+ga rat+na swāhā/

kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams/ / mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra rū pa kā ma gu na swāhā/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra dbyangs ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog rtsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra shap+ta kā ma gu na swāhā/ phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying dang*/ /a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra gan+dhe kā ma gu na swāhā/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra kā ma gu na swāhā/ /phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'brel chags pa/ /reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la= bzhes shig bla med= oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra pa ra kā ma gu na swāhā/ / bar 'dir spro na/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ / zhes pa nas/ brtul zhugs mchog la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar yang brjod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ / sogs dang*/ mgon po thugs rje sogs/ dkon mchog gsum dang*/ rigs gsum po'i bstod pa sogs 'don/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog /shin tu rgyas pa la spro na/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can sogs dang*/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs dang*/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bstod pa sogs dang*/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma dang*/ thub pa'i dbang po dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ sgrol ma'i sgos kyi bstod pa sogs dang*/

de bzhin du mtshan yang dag pa sogs kyang 'don par bya'o/ de nas gtor 'bul ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum sogs kyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ ā hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan mang pos phul/ bar 'dir yi dam dang*/ chos skyong dang gzhi bdag sogs sgos kyi gtor bsngo byed par spro na/ ji ltar skabs su bab pa yang bya/ spyi gtor 'brang rgyas de'i phud phul/ lhag ma rnams tsa ru'i bza' bar longs spyod/ slar yang mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ gong bzhin byin rlabs tshar gcig byas na legs/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon ni/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /zhing dang rgya chen zhing gzhan dang*/ /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang skyes yid byung rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /phyogs bcu kun na bdug spos ni/ /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong dang ldan pa/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu na/ /rin chen mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod pa/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas/ /phyogs bcu kun na gang yod pa/ /tshim byed yid 'od dang ldan 'di/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas// yon tan kun ldan gang yin de/ /thub dbang la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ / zhes sogs dang*/ na mo bha ga wa te/

badz+ra sa ra sogs kyis rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ / gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /'dir ni bya ba gang nongs pa/ /'di kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ dza ya dza ya/ swa sti swa sti/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wa naṃ/ 'jug tu smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyi'i mchod pa bya tshul yin la/ sgos kyi mchod pa ni/ rang rang gi gzhung bzhin shes par bya zhing*/ 'di dang sgos mchod rnams sbrail bar 'dod na/ spyi'i mchod pa ni song*/ tsa ru'i mchod pa ma phul ba'i bar der/ sgos kyi cho ga rnams bya'o/ / dus bzang mchod pa'i bya ba ni/ /theg pa chen po 'i khyad chos yin/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi thun mong yin/ /sngags la zhugs pa min yang sla/ /dkyil 'khor mthong na mchog tu bsngags/ /gus pa'i yid kyis 'di bsgrubs na/ /phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /dge bas de yang byang chub bsngo/ /zhes pa dus bzang mchod pa'i rim pa 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / maṅga laṃ/ dus bzang nyin zhag phrugs re la// tshul khrims lus bzang rab mdzes pas/ /dkon mchog mchod pa'i sprin phung 'dir/ /'bad las byang chub mchog thob shog/ zhus dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ sgrub thabs sna tshogs kyi skor bzhugs/ -PAGE 186--PAGE 367--PAGE 185- EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
